articleTitle: Sarcasm Detection using Hybrid Deep Learning framework based on Word-Emoji Embeddings
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Social media communication sometimes involves complex linguistic patterns like sarcasm and irony, which need a nuanced understanding of tone and context. But for newly updated social networks, it's not right to deduce sarcasm from text alone. Combining emoji and text data analysis can solve this problem. Our study presents an advanced approach to natural language processing called LSTM-AM. It uses long short-term memory with an attention mechanism to recognize and understand irony-sarcasm in social-network material with an outstanding accuracy of 99.86%. Our strategy is to develop new deep learning models that can detect sardonic or sarcastic utterances based on their nuanced signals, contextual dependencies, and mood changes. In addition, we investigate the possibility of enhancing the accuracy of irony and sarcasm detection by using multimodal data, such as pictures and emojis, and transferring learning from large language models. Our proposed models are rigorously evaluated against standard datasets and real-world content to demonstrate their efficacy. With their major contribution to our understanding of complex linguistic subtleties in digital communication, the findings of this study are of the utmost importance. Implications for emotion investigation, opinion excavating, and a better grasp of social-media dynamics are substantial, according to these results.

articleTitle: Phishtor: Phishing Detection Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Nowadays, the majority of people rely heavily on the internet. Online transactions, online sign-ups, and online purchasing are used by everyone. One kind of threat to websites is phishing, which is an illegal activity that involves obtaining user data, including credit/debit card numbers, passwords, and login credentials. An efficient phishing detection method based on ensemble learning is presented in this study. The technique proposed, which combines three classifiers (K-Nearest Neighbours, KNN, Support Vector Machines, and Gradient Boosting Classifiers, GBC) to achieve the highest accuracy performance, has been shown to yield positive results overall (97.4%). The proposed technique uses feature extraction for processing the Uniform Resource Locator (URL) and predicts the website whether it’s phishing or not. Therefore, it is preferable and used to employ the suggested technique to identify phishing using machine learning.

articleTitle: Decision Tree Based 5modular Redundancy Algorithm for Fault Identification in Full Adder Circuit
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper, implement the full adder circuit with fault analysis using decision tree algorithm additionally with Five Modular redundancy technique. Machine learning has many applications that it uses and interacts with every day. There are multiple ways to train the machine to predict, but the most common type is the decision tree algorithm. In the case of a decision tree, it consists of a graphical representation of all practical solutions to the decision that is based on some conditions. A full Adder circuit are most used binary circuits and has drawbacks like it does not add three-bit at a time to overcome this modular redundancy technique is used. Modular redundancy is technique to increase the reliability of systems. Based on fault analysis of triple modular redundancy, and took it a step further and designed it with five inputs to increase efficiency. Modular redundancy works on majority voting to get majority output when maximum inputs are also high or low. The presented work identifies the faults in the full adder circuit using the fused Decision Tree based 5MR using the HDL coding. The real time implementation is achieved by using the FPGA device. The parameters are verified for area, power and accuracy of the fault identification.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of the Gate Oxide Asymmetric Junctionless Double Gate MOSFET
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The manuscript contributes a performance analysis of gate oxide Asymmetric Junctionless Double Gate MOSFET (AJDG MOSFET). Here, asymmetry condition is considered by using Hafnium dioxide (HfO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) on one side of the gate and Silicon dioxide (SiO<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>) on the opposite side of the gate in designing the Junctionless MOSFET. The work mainly demonstrates a 3D simulation study performed by using commercially available TCAD device simulator to analyze the optimized parameters for studying characteristics of the AJDG MOSFET. A comparative analysis of drain current of AJDG MOSFET and Symmetric Junctionless Double Gate MOSFET (SJDG MOSFET) has been carried out to examine the effectiveness of asymmetry conditions. Further, device parameters such as transconductance (g<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">m</inf>) and gate capacitance (C<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">g</inf>) of AJDG MOSFET are analyzed and the results are compared with SJDG MOSFET. The comparison study indicates that AJDG MOSFETs have better performance capability than that of conventional SJDG MOSFETs, indicating improved future application efficacy.

articleTitle: Plant Disease Classification using Deep Learning Techniques for Smart Agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In view of the rising need for sustainable agricultural practices and the necessity to reduce crop losses caused by illnesses, there is a growing interest in utilizing modern technologies such as Deep Learning (DL) approaches to accurately identify and categorize plant diseases. This article introduces a novel approach to categorize plant diseases by employing sophisticated DL algorithms to support the adoption of intelligent agriculture techniques. The suggested Smart Agriculture Deep Learning (SMADL) model encompasses various essential stages. Initially, a thorough dataset consisting of images of plants in good condition as well as plants affected by different diseases is gathered and organised. Subsequently, a sophisticated DL framework, for instance Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), is used to extract unique features from the images that are entered. Following that, the proposed SMADL model is evaluated using appropriate criteria, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score. In order to showcase the efficiency of the suggested methodology, practical trials are carried out on actual plant disease datasets, and the model's performance is evaluated in comparison to established techniques. This aids in the enhancement of crop yield by enabling precise treatments and reducing crop losses. In summary, this research proposes a precise approach to automating the diagnosis of plant diseases by combining DL techniques and smart agriculture. This has the potential to improve crop health monitoring and optimise crop productivity in agricultural ecosystems.

articleTitle: Online Video Games based Mental Depression Prediction using Novel Recurrent Neural Network Over Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The goal of this study is to detect online gaming addiction in young individuals using two types of neural networks: a novel recurrent neural network and a convolutional neural network. The study will compare the performance of these networks to determine their effectiveness in detecting online gaming disorder in youth. The collection of data and training the model has to be done. The number of groups chosen for this study are two and the machine learning algorithms used for this approach are Recurrent Neural Network and Convolution Neural Network Each group contains 10 samples and it totals 20 samples. For SPSS calculation, a G power value of 80% is used. The parameters considered are CI and alpha, which were determined as p= 0.000 (p<0.05). The analysis of online gaming mental disorder or disability has been done using novel recurrent neural network and convolutional neural network models. A greater proportion of 94% accuracy is attained by novel recurrent neural networks which is larger than 89%accuracy attained by Convolutional neural networks. In light of the acquired outcomes the Novel Recurrent Neural Network gives better accuracy (94%) when contrasted with convolutional neural networks which provide (89%) accuracy.

articleTitle: 3D Segmentation of MRI Using Multimodal for Detection of Brain Tumour
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Determining brain tumors from MRI can be challenging due to several factors, and it typically requires expertise in neuroimaging and collaboration between radiologists, neurologists, and other specialists. Some tumors may have a subtle or a typical appearance on MRI, making them difficult to distinguish from normal brain tissue. Brain tumors can be highly heterogeneous in terms of silhouette, scope, and internal structure. Tumors can have different types of tissues, such as necrotic and enhancing regions, making it challenging to accurately delineate their boundaries. Brain tumors can be highly heterogeneous in terms of silhouette, scope, and internal structure. Tumors can have different types of tissues, such as necrotic, cystic, or enhancing regions, making it challenging to accurately delineate their boundaries. Deep learning has shown promising results in various medical imaging tasks, including the identification and classification of brain tumors, such as gliomas, from MRI images. In this paper, an attempt to design an ensemble model for the prediction of 3D brain tumor segmentation and performance is going to be evaluated using deep learning models such as UNET, FPN, and UNET+FPN. The above models are evaluated on the BraTS 2021 (Brain Tumour Segmentation) dataset, and comparing the metrics of each model reveals that UNET and, an enhanced model that combines UNET and FPN, UNET+FPN has the highest accuracy of 0.9959 and 0.9954 respectively.

articleTitle: Smart Control and Reduced Switch Based Switched Capacitor Twenty Nine Level Inverter for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: For high voltage submissions, this architecture is recommended since all of the switches utilized have voltages lower than their maximum output voltage. One advantage of this proposed configuration is that it can increase the input power sources' magnitude by utilizing switched capacitor units. Switching angle-based control has been used to decrease the number of components needed to offer the greatest number of voltage levels at the output and improve power delivery quality. The input DC source is converted into a 29 level output voltage using three DC sources, twelve switches, and one switched capacitor. Based on utilizing the maximum voltage on the power switches and utilizing less hardware, the proposed construction performed better, according to the data. The effectiveness of the recommended inverter is validated by obtaining several test results for the 29-level inverter. Finally, the proposed 29-level inverter would be a preferable choice for usage in solar systems. This project is developed using the Mat lab 2021a environmental software. When the inverters are compared, the Twenty Nine level inverter has a THD Value of 3.66% and the paper's total efficiency is 92.6%.

Author Keywords: Total Harmonic Distortion and PWM Generator

articleTitle: Impact of Different ETMs/HTMs on the Performance of MAPbI3-Based Perovskite Solar Cells: A Simulation Perspective
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Lead halide perovskite, both organic and inorganic, serves as the light harvester in perovskite solar cells (PCSs). Because of their superior optoelectronic qualities, organic-inorganic halide perovskites have drawn a lot of attention since initial report on a long-term-durable, 9.7% efficient, solid- state perovskite solar cell. Understanding solar cell performance and designing the best possible device for high-efficiency solar cells depend heavily on simulation research. Numerous factors can affect performance of a cell, including as design of device, thickness of different layers, materials used for charge extraction and photogeneration, energy band alignment at interfaces, doping density. This paper investigates the effect of electron transport layer (ETL) thickness as well as doping density on device performance. Utilizing Solar Cell Capacitance Simulator (SCAPS-1D), a numerical study of a planar n-i-p perovskite solar cell (PSC) based on organohalides are reported. By altering the absorber layer's thickness, FTO/ETM/perovskite/HTM/electrode PSC structure's performance is studied. Through the use of SCAPS modelling, it is determined how absorber layer's doping density influences PSC's performance. The performance of PSC is also examined for various electron/hole transporting materials (ETMs/HTMs), accounting for an absorber doping density of 1015 cm-3 and an absorber thickness of 220 nm. A few obstacles still stand in the way of its actual deployment. Simulation and optimisation of PSCs are desirable in order to build a highly efficient and ecologically benign device. Designing a solar cell without simulation work is not only unrealistic but also a waste of time and money. It reduces risk, time, and expense while also analysing roles and characteristics of the layers to maximise performance of solar cell.

articleTitle: The Intersection of Technology and Driving: A Review of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The paper analyzes the architecture of ADAS, highlighting the key components like sensors, perception layer, decision-making layer, and action layer. It illustrates the flow of information within the system and explains the role of sensor fusion in creating a comprehensive understanding of the vehicle’s surroundings. It further discusses various ADAS functionalities and their benefits, including adaptive cruise control, automatic braking, traffic sign recognition, and blind-spot detection. Furthermore, it addresses the challenges associated with ADAS implementation in India, such as system accuracy limitations, sensor limitations, and lack of consumer awareness. It explores potential solutions like the implementation of ADAS on re-configurable heterogeneous MPSoC architectures for efficient real-time performance. The article ends by highlighting the promising future of ADAS technology and how it may transform driving efficiency, increase road safety, and improve the driving experience in general. It highlights the need for continued research and development to address pressing problems and pave the way for the widespread use of ADAS in a range of traffic scenarios, especially in India.

articleTitle: Sustainable farming solutions: ai-based crop suitability prediction for agriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In India, where agriculture is pivotal to livelihoods, the economic progress hinges on farmers. Conventional farming poses challenges, necessitating a shift towards technology-backed solutions. To empower farmers, a model is developed to incorporate parameters like pH, EC, OM, OC, and nutrient levels to assess soil fertility. The model uses Decision Tree, Random Forest, and Artificial Neural Network algorithms to forecast crop suitability by analyzing various factors. The most precise algorithm is employed as the underlying mechanism for user interaction. Farmers input soil parameters, and the model provides tailored recommendations, aiding in optimal crop selection. This technological intervention aims to enhance agricultural productivity and support sustainable practices, crucial for India's economic development.

articleTitle: Image-Based Skin Diseases Detection and Classification Using Convolutional Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The outermost layer of the human body is the skin. Skin diseases can be caused by viruses, bacteria, allergies, fungal infections, and more. It causes serious physical, social, and psychological effects, even though some people do not pay attention to it. Several research studies have been conducted regarding skin disease classification. However, there are a few issues that those research studies fail to address in a way that yields easy and most accurate results. This research study is to design an easy and accurate system using a convolutional neural network to detect and classify skin diseases. The performance of the proposed system was then assessed using the accuracy, precision, recall, and F-measure metrics. The system has been conducted within three data splitting ratios which are 70/30%, 80/20%, and 90/10%. The accuracy of the result interpretation is 93.76%, and the precision, recall, and F-score all have a value of 93%. This indicates that the system has performed very well in detecting and classifying skin diseases, particularly with the 90/10% data splitting ratio. Overall, the results suggest that the system is accurate and effective in its classification performance.

articleTitle: Empirical Analysis of Unit Cell Structure Geometry on Radiation efficiency of Graphene Metasurface THz Antenna
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The metasurface based antenna designs are proving to be the thrust area in THz communications and applications. The design and construction of a compact, effective, reconfigurable antenna operating in the terahertz (THz) range are described in this paper. The analysis of a graphene-based microstrip patch antenna with slots loaded with a graphene metasurface (MS) as a superstrate configuration is presented in this design. The square-shaped unit cells of the MS are arranged on a silicon dioxide (SiO2) substrate with a periodicity of λ /10.4, which is often referred to as the lowest operating frequency. The proposed metasurface based antenna design is capable to work in a wide bandwidth of 9.96 THz spread across 6 resonant frequencies. The Realized gain (in dB) of the proposed antenna is between 7.46 dB to 12.09 dB for all the resonant frequencies. The average radiation efficiency of the resonant frequencies is 93.06%.

articleTitle: Unification of DC-DC converters to obtain Single-input Dual-Output for EVs
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The enlargement of the utility system, the Renewable Energy Sources (RES) is a part of technological enhancements to increasing their applications of DC-DC converters. The proposed unification of DC-DC converters frequently embraces the combination of a Super-Lift Luo Converter (SLLC) which can obtain to increase the voltage for the specified input. The buck-converter can allows a reasonable decrease in the voltage for the particular input. The output can be acquired for the Single Input Dual Output (SIDO) system it would be an instantaneous analysis for the allotted input of the step-up and step-down voltage. The proposed system is effectual enough and to minimum losses could be experienced when compared to the conventional converters. The proposed system does not comprehend any electromagnetic components or bulky transformers. Meanwhile the ripple in the output voltage is kept very low.

articleTitle: Design of a 13-Level PV Grid-Tied Multilevel Inverter for Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Recently, the use of renewable energy sources (RES) has grown in prominence as a way to guarantee sustainable growth. RES include geothermal, wind, biomass, and solar power. However, because of their minimal maintenance requirements and simplicity of supply, wind and solar power are the most often used RES. In order to enhance power quality for grid-connected networks, this work suggests and develops a dependable controller for a Boost converter that comprises a 13-level inverter. Several voltage sources are required for MLI, and because of inverter architecture and switching techniques, most MLIs have different loads that utilize the power sources. Employing a boost converter managed by a PI controller enhances PV output since it is more straightforward, useful, and provides superior power tracking. An asymmetric cascaded 13-level multilevel inverter (MLI) which is around 1.54% less THD and shows highest efficiency of 94.5% is presented in this work as a step across improving grid power quality (PQ) and converters. The sinusoidal PWM approach is used to regulate the inverter. The LC filter is used to feed the MLI output to the grid or load. MATLAB simulation is used to verify the suggested approach.

articleTitle: After-sales services and sustainability: A study of Ather and Bounce electric scooters in Bengaluru
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study looks at how sustainability and aftersales services affect buyer behavior in Bengaluru., India's market for electric scooters. A study comparing Ather and Bounce electric scooters was done to see what aspects affect consumer happiness. The study discovered that after-sales services, such as maintenance and repair, are critical to customer satisfaction and that buyers should take sustainable practices into account when selecting an electric scooter. The findings provide important visions for Bengaluru-based electric scooter companies looking to strengthen their aftersales services and sustainability practices in order to better fulfil the needs of their customers.

articleTitle: Array of Wide-band Highly-directive Microstrip Patch Antennas for DBS Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This article introduces a printed radiator developed for the Ku-band satellite applications, especially for direct-to-home service. The one-quadrant of the solitary radiator is obtained by truncating a square at one corner and including four cross-coupled narrow slots and concentric circles etched from the center. The generation of an uniform radiation pattern in the desired direction has been contemplated for a quadrilateral design. A dual-element linear array is also suggested to enhance the parametric results for specific satellite applications. When setting up an array’s feed network, the Wilkinson power divider is used to get a high degree of isolation. The array and antenna were made in CST Microwave Studio (v2019) using a dielectric material that is inexpensive, very efficient, and has a low profile: PCB laminated FR-4 (ϵ<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">r</inf> = 4.4). At a frequency of 12.50 GHz, the one radiator not only has a wide impedance bandwidth of 1.63 GHz, but it also produces a notable gain of more than 10 dBi. Moreover, the array provides an increase of over 13 dBi gain and an impedance bandwidth of 2.61 GHZ at the specified frequency. In addition, both radiators exhibit excellent radiation efficiency, low cross-polarization suppression, satisfactory aperture efficiency, and negligible EMI/EMC effects. Both antennas are highly suitable for direct broadcast satellite, especially for direct-to-home applications in the Ku-band frequency range.

articleTitle: Image Forgery Detection Using Machine Learning Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The prominent use of social networking services had led to the ease of manipulating images using various image editing tools, AI tools which has led to the rise of forged images, due to this a threat has been created in the society. As a result of this many cybercrimes have evolved. One of them is deep face masking in which fake images and videos are used. With the help of deep face masking technique one can superimposes one’s identity. The combination of image forgery and deep face masking could make the risks that are associated with cybercrime and privacy violations. There are many deep learning (DL) models which have been trained using convolutional neural network architecture for detecting forged images. The proposed system uses analysis of Machine Learning (ML) models with the help of error level analysis. This paper mainly describes about various image forgery methods and later it shows the comparison of different machine learning algorithms out of which Random Forest performed well with an accuracy of 93.25%.

articleTitle: Object oriented RFID with machine learning and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Object-oriented radio frequency identification (RFID) with machine learning (ML) and the internet of things (IoT) can be used to predict demand for products and services. RFID is a technology that use radio waves to the communicate between a reader and a tag attach to objects, allowing for the identification and tracking of that object. By using object-oriented programming principles, RFID data can be systematized and analyzed in a more effectual manner. To establish the same a prototype is built by interfacing RFID sensor with Node MCU software kit. Incorporation of RFID and ML have found that the system is enable for automatic product reordering and real-time inventory level monitoring.

articleTitle: Hess DC Microgrid System with Novel Ann Based Droop Control
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In recent times, hybrid energy storage systems (HESS) have emerged as a global alternative for supplying ongoing, dependable, and sustainable energy for electronic gadgets. For effective power management, the ideal Artificial Neural Network Based Droop Management for HESS based direct current microgrid is created in this study. The voltage control loop and current control looping of the battery and SC are controlled by three Artificial Neural Network controllers, sequentially. The voltage control loop adjusts grid voltage, whereas the current control mechanisms mitigate for power imbalances between the SC and the battery when the source and load vary. Bidirectional Buck Boost Converters (BBC) are modeled, analyzed, and designed. The best Droop-ANN controller is built for a BBC with a battery and a SC for retention. With modifications in source and load fluctuations, the efficiency of the proposed optimum Droop ANN-controller-based HESS is examined. With modifications to the supply and load, the controller successfully adjusts the DC grid voltage. The recommended optimum ANN controller's efficacy is compared to the traditional PI controller technique for HESS. Mat lab 2021a software is used to validate the proposed work. The comparative table shows that the recommended converter has a settling time of 0.2 seconds.

articleTitle: Equal Current Sharing Between Parallel Connected Second Order and Interleaved Boost Converter in micro grid
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Power and energy are two key requirements in today's contemporary environment. As the need for energy grows by the day, the final answer to this type of issue is to implement renewable energy sources. Since the various renewable energy sources have varied energy levels at different time durations, it is impossible to connect them all to a single DC bus in nature. Furthermore, this single device is inadequate and inadequate for energy delivery. This sparks the concept of Regional Energy Sources. This gives rise to the idea of Distributed Energy Sources. Thus, dispersed electrical power is described as the substitution of one UPS unit with numerous smaller UPS units operating in addition, increasing the supply method's dependability as well as energy capabilities. A Second Order boost converter helps to increase the PV system's output voltage. The Second Order boost converter raises the PV organization's output voltage. An Adaptive Neuro Fuzzy (ANFIS) based Maximum Power Point Tracker (MPPT) technology is used to track the maximum power from PV system. A PWM generator raises the duty sequences on time when the productivity reference signal is given to the dc-dc converter. The PV system's output voltage is increased using the Interleaved Boost Converter. Droop techniques are used in parallel-connected DC to DC converters to distribute power fairly. The droop factor is adjusted to balance the charge levels of energy storage battery devices. Through the use of a bidirectional battery converter, the excess energy from the PV system is stored in a battery and promotes equitable current sharing. An approach known as proportional integral (PI) controller is used to maintain an infinite dc link voltage. The proposed strategy is validated through simulation using MATLAB 2021a /Simulink software. In this paper the comparison between the accuracy of the converter has 92.4%, voltage gain has 10V and the ANFIS tracking efficiency has 93.5% is predicted.

articleTitle: Simulation of a Novel Meta-surface assisted Ultra-wideband Millimeter-wave Window
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A novel meta-surface assisted window was designed, simulated and analyzed for its bandwidth performance. The window consists of a plane disk dielectric window with two of its plane surfaces defined as periodic pattern of cylindrical pillars. The simulation result showed that the bandwidth achieved at allowable return loss of -17dB is 32.1 GHz in the frequency range of 28.37 – 60.47 GHz and the % bandwidth is 72.26% for the operating circular TE0,1 mode. The center frequency of the operative band was 44.42 GHz. The bandwidth performance of the proposed window is also compared with a meta-surface assisted window having square-pillars with cylindrical-tip.

articleTitle: A Study of Language Identification and ASR for Telugu and English
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Language identification and automatic speech recognition (ASR) play pivotal roles in enabling effective communication and interaction with speech-driven technology. This research paper presents a comprehensive study focused on the accurate identification and transcription of speech in Telugu and English. We curate a unique speech dataset comprising utterances from 0 to 9 spoken by 25 speakers for each language, from which we extract Mel-frequency cepstral coefficient (MFCC) and various temporal and spectral features. Our experimental framework encompasses two critical stages: the initial stage of language identification, followed by ASR modeling in the identified language. For the language identification stage, we employ three different classifiersSupport Vector Machine (SVM), Gaussian Naive Bayes, and Decision Tree. The accuracy of each classifier is meticulously evaluated, shedding light on their relative performance in distinguishing between Telugu and English speech. Subsequently, we delve into the second stage, where we employ Gaussian Mixture Model/Hidden Markov Model (GMM/HMM) modeling to transcribe the speech into text, paving the way for robust speaker independent ASR systems. This paper’s findings and analysis are anticipated to contribute to the field of language technology and speech recognition by offering valuable insights into the selection of effective language identification classifiers and the implementation of ASR for Indian languages.

articleTitle: Privacy Preserved Transparent Supply Chain Management Using Cloud with Secured Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The conventional paradigm in various industries, especially the agricultural sector, heavily relies on smart contracts for intricate transactions involving farmers, Village Cooperative units, distributors, and consumers. However, the current approach utilizes traditional transaction methods with intermediaries, leading to inefficiencies and potential security risks. Transparency and privacy issues persist in these transactions, exacerbated by delays and vulnerabilities introduced by intermediaries. In our innovative approach, present a novel system that leverages smart contracts as digitally signed cryptographic agreements, eliminating the necessity for intermediaries. Blockchain technology is harnessed to ensure transparent and secure data transactions, thereby elevating the efficiency of smart contracts. The system introduces decentralized data sharing, facilitating seamless tracking of supply chain activities. Specific agricultural transactions with Cooperatives serve as intermediaries our proposed system utilizes smart contracts as digital signatures to authorize transactions. Meticulous logging of activities ensures a traceable record of transaction origins. In our proposed system marks a paradigm shift in supply chain management by seamlessly integrating smart contracts and Blockchain technology. The transition from the existing system promises to revolutionize agricultural transactions, offering heightened transparency, security, and efficiency, thereby reshaping the landscape of supply chain management.

articleTitle: Enhancing Crowd Image Analysis Through Facial Landmark Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Face identification and recognition play a crucial role in various security applications, providing essential capabilities for our daily lives. The growing interest in computer vision stems from genuine concerns about public security in today's interconnected world. Facial features offer a straightforward means of distinguishing individual identities. Recent advancements in this field, fuelled by the availability of extensive datasets and advancements in deep learning techniques, have been noteworthy. Commonly, digital cameras are strategically positioned on rooftops of residences, buildings, and storefronts to monitor events and incidents on adjacent streets. Often, these cameras capture images featuring groups of people at a particular location. In the event of an unusual incident, security services must swiftly identify the responsible party. If these services possess images of potential suspects, a comparison and matching process can be initiated to identify the actual perpetrator. Typically, crowd analysis involves three key processing steps: preprocessing, object detection, and event/behaviour recognition. In this context, the goal is to recognize an individual from a crowd by utilizing a single image of the person to be identified. This process integrates face recognition and face detection modules, leveraging the advancements in these technologies to enhance security measures.

articleTitle: Probabilistic Neural Netwrok-Based Battery Energy Management Systemm for Grid-Tied Hers System for EV Charging
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Global warming and other negative environmental effects have been caused by the mining of fossil fuel resources as a result of the sharp rise in the demand for power around the world. By using electric vehicles (EVs), which have a number of socioeconomic and environmental advantages, several governments are attempting to transform conventional forms of transportation into green transportation systems. These EVs don't directly use fossil fuels, but they do use more of them because of the electricity they receive from the fossil fuel-based power distribution infrastructure. Because of this, scientists are trying to create more affordable and ecologically friendly renewable sources of energy in an effort to reduce the difference between the availability and demand of electricity. Here, we employ a grid-tied method based on hybrid renewable energy sources (HRES) to charge EVs. Uneven voltage, frequency, and supply-demand are all consequences of EVs and the grid, which affect the overall power system. To solve these problems, this project presents workable optimization strategies. Utilizing a Probabilistic Neural Network (PNN), the lithium-ion battery's state of charge (SOC) is calculated when it is first charged utilizing hybrid renewable energy sources. In this study, voltage is increased or decreased by a bidirectional BIFRED converter that is Perturb and Observe (P&O) MPPT(maximum power point tracking) regulated. Power is removed from the grid if the demand for EV charging is greater than the amount of power produced by HRES; if the demand for EV charging is less than the amount of power produced by HRES, excess power is fed back into the system. PI controllers are also used to control active and reactive electricity and synchronise the grid. MATLAB simulation is used to validate the proposed approach.

articleTitle: Lung Diseases Detection Using Deep Learning On NVIDIA Jetson Nano
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In this study, deep learning techniques were employed and provide a complete framework for the detection of lung diseases, with a particular emphasis on COVID-19, tuberculosis (TB), and pneumonia. The performance of a transfer learning-based classification task for identifying COVID-19, tuberculosis (TB), and pneumonia was explored using two separate pre-trained models, ResNet18 and GoogLeNet, which were optimized for real-time processing on the NVIDIA Jetson Nano 4GB Developer Kit. Transfer learning speeds up model training by fine-tuning recently learned weights on a fresh dataset, significantly reducing the processing requirements associated with training from scratch. Excellent performance results were achieved on ResNet-18 and GoogLeNet, with accuracy of 95.08% and 93.91%, respectively.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Multiuser NOMA using Non Orthogonal Spreading Sequence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The requirements of the wireless communication system have progressed consistently over previous several years. The growing fame and utilization of wireless multimedia approaches have driven the advancement of the wireless system. The fifth generation (5G) wireless communication has evolved to serve users with enhanced proficiency, low latency, reliable communication, and lesser battery exhausts. The non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA) technique is an efficient multiple access scheme to fulfil the requirements of a 5G mobile system. NOMA permits the allocation of multiple users with similar frequency, code and time domain multiplexing. NOMA enables a remarkable enhancement in system performance as well as the ability to connect devices. This paper presents, a Zadoff Chu non-orthogonal spreading sequence to enhance the NOMA systems performance. Here transmitting symbols are precoded using the Zadoff Chu spreading sequence. Simulation results represent the enhancement in the bit error rate (BER) performance of the NOMA system over fading channels compared to the traditional NOMA system.

articleTitle: Precision Agriculture Meets AI: Utilizing Deep Learning Models for Accurate Tomato Leaf Disease Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Accurate identification of plant diseases is crucial for effective crop management and food production. This research aimed to develop image classification models to detect tomato leaf diseases. Over 30,000 tomato leaf images depicting ten plant diseases and one healthy class were utilised. Models based on DenseNetV2, ResNetV2, and MobileNetV2 architectures were developed and comparatively evaluated. All models leveraged transfer learning, using ImageNet pre-trained weights before fine-tuning to the target task. For model development, images were divided into training and validation sets. Data augmentation and normalisation were performed using ImageDataGenerator. Models were then trained by adding customised layers to base architectures while freezing pre-trained layers. DenseNetV2 had additional pooling, dense, dropout, and classification layers added. ResNetV2 and MobileNetV2 had global pooling and fully-connected layers appended. Models were trained for ten epochs with categorical cross-entropy loss optimisation. The models achieved test accuracies of 90.5% (DenseNetV2), 90.2% (ResNetV2), and 90.0% (MobileNetV2). Confusion matrices and architecture diagrams were analysed to compare model performances. The DenseNetV2 architecture demonstrated superior discriminative capabilities over critical tomato leaf diseases versus the other models, potentially attributable to its connectivity pattern capturing informative feature correlations. The deep learning models developed could accurately classify most of the tomato leaf diseases investigated. The findings demonstrate the feasibility of utilising imagery-based machine learning for automated and scalable plant disease recognition under both laboratory and real field conditions. Further work should explore model optimisation and evaluation of additional plant species.

articleTitle: Efficient Tamil Character Recognition: A Comparative Study of Learning-Based Algorithms with ResNet-50, DenseNet121, and EfficientNet Architectures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Computer vision finds practical application in handwriting recognition, a technology widely employed to interpret handwritten characters on documents, bank cheques, and postal addresses. Several studies have explored the identification of Tamil characters. Deep learning techniques have been used recently to implement Tamil character recognition. This research presents a comparative analysis of Tamil language character recognition using ResNet, DenseNet, and EfficientNet. Architectural enhancements like skip connections, designed to mitigate the problem of small gradient value and facilitate training of deeper networks, are commonly integrated into these models. The experiment encompassed diverse datasets, and model Performance was evaluated with the use of criteria including recall, accuracy, and precision. The EfficientNet architecture achieves the highest precision (99.1%), recall (97.2%) and accuracy (98.7%) value when compared to other models.

articleTitle: Practical Implementation and Performance Evaluation of LoRaWAN Gateway
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The advent of the Internet of Things (IoT) has significantly increased the number of applications using sensor technology, which has redefined sensor networking. Short-range wireless technologies offer high data rates and frequently use unlicensed spectrums. On the other hand, cellular technologies provide a more extensive range and a higher data rate, and they operate in the licensed spectrum. To bridge the gap between these two technologies and provide a cost-effective, long-range solution capable of connecting numerous scattered devices, Low Power Wide Area Networks (LPWAN) were developed. LPWANs utilize unlicensed spectrums and can transmit data over long distances, providing connectivity for devices located in remote or challenging environments. Long Range (LoRa) continues to draw attention due to its flexible specification and the accessibility of hardware with guarantees to provide kilometers of coverage in adverse situations. It is a long-range, energy efficient low power technology that is used to connect wireless sensor devices in an Internet of Things (IoT) network and is widely used in a variety of wireless communication applications. This paper aims to describe the implementation and coverage testing of a multichannel Long Range Wide Area Network (LoRaWAN) gateway for this technology. This implementation aims to increase LoRa coverage in New Chandigarh, India, and to allow open access for testing a range of IoT devices. The spreading factor 7 facilitates a maximum transmission distance of 3.1 km.

articleTitle: A Smart Approach Towards Sustainable Development Through An IoT-Powered Recycling Bin
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A clean environment is essential for the progress of any nation because untidy leads to immorality for both living beings and the environment. The proposed system creates smart trash, maintaining a clean and eco-friendly environment for all living beings. Since technology is becoming increasingly intelligent, the system uses a microcontroller-based smart dustbin that provides information when the trash is full. This will help to keep the environment clean and avoid unnecessary visits by municipality personnel when the trash is not full. The ultrasonic sensors fitted at the top of the bin will provide information about the trash level in the bin. The proposed smart bin will always be kept closed to avoid the spread of airborne disease. It consists of a proximity sensor and a servo motor that automatically opens the trash cover when the person is about to dump the trash in the smart bin. The system is equipped with an ultrasonic sensor to monitor the trash level; basically, it senses the distance from the top to the bottom of the bin when the trash reaches its maximum level, and it identifies and provides information via GSM. The prototype of the proposed smart bin has been successfully verified, its working is better, and it promotes cleanliness.

articleTitle: India’s Camel Load Curve: A Study of Indian Electricity Demand Scenario
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: India stands in 3<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">rd</sup> position in the world ranking with respect to the production and consumption of electricity. Electricity consumption does not remain the same and depends on the sector of usage like industry, domestic, etc., along with the time of the day and the weather season. Three-fourths of the Indian electricity demand is met by fossil fuels, especially coal. The electricity demand pattern analysis of a nation is very much needed in policy-making in the energy sector and the installation of new renewable power sources, especially solar. The duck-shaped load curve of California was an eye-opener for many countries, especially those planning the rapid installation of solar-based power generation. In India, the solar energy installation initiatives, and adoption of Electric Vehicles(EVs) by the people must be well monitored to reduce the stress on the operation of the Indian Grid. In this paper,a study of India’s load curve in the last five Financial Years (FY), starting from FY 2019-2020 till the First Half of FY 2023-2024, is carried out. The load curve turns out to be camel-shaped for India in contrast to the duck-shaped curve of California.

articleTitle: FPGA-Optimized Eight-Term Karatsuba Multiplications for Large Integer Multiplications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Karatsuba-like multiplication is one of the most efficient multiplication algorithms, but is mostly avoided due to complex sub-multiplications. This paper introduces FPGA-based optimized implementation of eight-term Karatsuba multiplier (ETKM) architecture on FPGAs. Thus, efforts has been made to implement eight-term Karatsuba Multiplication (Method-I), i.e., ETKM-I in terms of speed and hardware utilization. The overall performance of the proposed design method (ETKM-I) are noted by calculating Area-Time-Product (ATP) and compared with conventional eight-term Karatsuba multiplication (CETKM) and existing state-of-the-art. Hardware implementations of the proposed ETKM multiplication architectures are done using Virtex-7 FPGA device in Xilinx ISE platform. Compared with other state-of-the-art designs the performance of the proposed eight-term Karatsuba multiplication (Method-I): ETKM-I based on ∆AT P<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> is 6.227%, 76.402% and 33.668% better than Direct Multiplication (DM), Traditional Schoolbook Multiplication (Traditional SBM), and CETKM respectively for 1024-bit inputs. However comparing the proposed ETKM-I, it can be inferred that ETKM-I is 33.668% better than CETKM thus proving its area-time-product efficiency.

articleTitle: An Optimized, Sophisticated Technological Approach for Savvy Car Parking Framework for Smart Car Parking System Futuristic Metropolis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Smart metropolises have gained a lot of traction in recent years. The recommended smart auto parking method uses a module to conceal and signal the presence of a single parking space. This design offers a defined frame for an effective and practical niche vacuum by looking at the niche Parking the cars is an easy process. The research also displays the frame design from an strange state of mind. The design first conducts an investigation of the operational framework in the form of an application case supporting the proposed system.

Author Keywords: IoT based parking space identification system

articleTitle: Conservation of Water in Urban Gardening Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The rate of urbanization in India largely surpasses the pace of providing basic amenities like water and electricity, thereby causing scarcity of resources. One such water intensive activity is urban gardening. Earlier studies examine scarcity of water as a major challenge in urban gardening, and use of technologies to improve efficiencies. This paper presents managing the use of water as per plant need in urban gardening through the use of Internet of Things (IoT) and Machine Learning (ML) models. The approach aligns with the Goal 11 - Sustainable cities and communities of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. The Transfer Learning model on Tensorflow Lite was used to classify plants types. A modest dataset consisting of 124 72x72 pixels images of 16 indoor plant species was used to train the model to classify the plants into three watering frequency categories viz. frequent, regular and infrequent. This model was deployed in a smart system to classify plants and efficiently schedule watering. Thereby, significantly minimizing overwatering and water wastage.

articleTitle: Lung Nodule Segmentation using Alexnet and Recurrent Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Combining a RNN (Recurrent Neural Network ) with the popular AlexNet architecture to increase lung nodule segmentation accuracy. The initial step of the approach involves preprocessing a data set of lung images with labelled nodules, which includes normalizing, augmenting, and scaling for best training results. As an additional step, leverage the fact that AlexNet excels at picture classification jobs by utilizing its architecture to extract features. A lung nodules data set is used to fine-tune the pre-trained AlexNet or to start from scratch if the size of the data set permits. Recurrent neural networks are strategically used to manage temporal interactions and enhance segmentation accuracy. The RNN helps to extract sequential patterns from the data so that the background context of lung scans can be better understood. Combining the strengths of both architectures, RNN and AlexNet provide a powerful structure for lung nodule segmentation that allows medical imaging databases' areas of interest to be defined more accurately and quickly

articleTitle: Smart Filtering Strategy for Enhancing ECG Signal Quality via Improved Kalman Filter for Gaussian Noise
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The electrocardiogram (ECG) signal, which represents the heart's electrical activity, is vulnerable to several types of noise, making it challenging to accurately identify certain features. Traditional filters, which are intended to remove undesired frequency components, frequently prove inadequate in effectively processing polluted ECG signals. Noise reduction in biomedical data poses a challenge due to the unexpected characteristics of these signals, rendering fixed-coefficient filters less efficient. In order to resolve this problem, the implementation of an adaptive algorithm is essential. The recommended filter greatly improves the quality of the ECG signal by utilizing the model of state space in addition to autocorrelation using the least-squares technique are utilized for estimating state variables, like the Gaussian noise estimation, from the initially recorded ECG signal. values, showcasing strong convergence characteristics. Validation of the results is conducted by utilizing the MIT-BIH arrhythmia database and MATLAB tools.

articleTitle: PFC Controlled Active PWM Rectifier for Wireless Ev Charger Applications with Interleaved LLC Synchronous Rectifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: EVs use rechargeable battery packs to store electrical energy, which must be periodically recharged. Efficient and fast charging of EV batteries is essential to make them practical for everyday use. There are various methods of charging EV batteries, ranging from slow charging through household outlets to fast charging at public charging stations. With advancements in technology, the development of sophisticated charging systems has become a focus of research and development, with the aim of improving charging efficiency, reducing charging times, and prolonging battery life. This project proposes interleaved High frequency inverter based Isolated EV charger. The design of a single phase high frequency inverter using pulse width modulation (PWM) control circuit which eliminates the use of complex circuitry to generate sinusoidal pulses for transistor switches. Here are implementing Power Factor Corrector (PFC) converter and synchronous rectifier for driving renewable applications. This control approach intensely enlarges the adjustable output voltage range and smoothly output the target voltage. The isolation transformer provides a protective measure through electrical separation. The interleaved parallel topology based synchronous rectifier reduces the high frequency rectification losses. The capacitive filter decreases the ripple voltage contents of the output voltage. The performance analysis of this technique is implemented in MATLAB/Simulink environment. In this paper the comparison between the rectifier efficiency is 83.5% and settling time is 0.28seconds is mentioned.

articleTitle: IoT based Energy Analyzer and Tampering Detection System for Smart Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A software-driven solution that simplifies the generation and management of energy bills for customers is an automated energy billing system. Utility providers, property management firms, and other organizations that charge consumers for energy use can greatly benefit from this kind of system. In order to automate energy metering, billing, and tamper detection, this paper lays out a hardware design and implementation for controllers that are based on the internet of things. The proposed system enhances energy management precision and safety by integrating smart metering technology with remote monitoring and control capabilities. It also decreases the amount of labor needed for meter reading and billing, identify energy meter tampering, send SMS notifications to the necessary authorities, set consumption limits, inform consumers when limits are exceeded. System updates regarding power usage and tariff information can also be sent to customers via SMS.

articleTitle: Recurrent Neural Network Based Fault Identification System For PV System Interfaced Three Phase Multimachine Grid System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: It is suggested to implement a novel safety mechanism for three-phase grid-tied solar systems that use a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) technology to detect various kinds of grid failures. The approach involves the extraction of distinctive characteristics from three-phase voltages at the point of common coupling by means of multi-resolution singular spectral dynamics. To get information and approximations parameters of RNN, the three-phase voltage signals are divided. Then, by combining spectrum evaluation and multi resolution analysis with unpredictability as the result, numerous characteristics between various types of grid faults may be recovered. To recognize and categorize different kinds of problems, an RNN classifier (shows highest accuracy of 94%) uses the created features vectors as the input information. The findings show that the suggested intelligent approach performs swiftly in recognizing electrical problems in a grid-connected solar system, in addition to successfully identifying various types of grid faults. In addition, a graphical analysis is carried out to see how various kinds of grid disturbances affect PV functioning, emphasizing the need for sophisticated protection techniques to safeguard PV installations. The nine-bus gridconnected PV system, based on MATLAB, is used to verify this concept.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Neural Network in Audio Recognition
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The objective of this paper is to summarize the performance of deep learning techniques specifically neural networks in Audio recognition systems. The focus is on classifying audio data from the UrbanSound8k dataset, a diverse collection of urban environmental sounds. The neural network model is designed to recognize and categorize these sounds automatically. Presented are the key findings, demonstrating the potential of deep learning for audio classification tasks.

articleTitle: Digital Stress Effect on Employee quality of life: Overcoming barriers Towards Sustainable Development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Businesses nowadays are realizing more and more how important social, ethical, and environmental goals are. Organizations are concentrating on performance and development that is environmentally friendly, socially conscious, and individual-friendly in addition to financial success. Sustainable Human Resource Management is one field that is supporting "green" businesses (SHRM). The organization's human capital must embrace new ecological practices and include creative sustainable methods in order to meet the sustainable development goals (SDGs). As new technologies emerge, mental health-related aspects of workspaces are being considered more than before. Research has demonstrated that Digital stress is one of the elements influencing workers' productivity inside an organisation which further hinders organizational sustainable growth. The quality of one's work life is another significant component that influences the improvement of work environment conditions and organizational efficiency. This research paper delves into the intricate relationship between technology and employee well-being, specifically focusing on the impact of digital stress on the quality of life and mental health of employees. Furthermore, the study aims to uncover the barriers hindering effective coping mechanisms and stress management in the digital age to achieve sustainable development. The findings of this research have implications for both employers and policymakers seeking to create healthier and more productive work environments.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of FTRL algorithm for Dense and Deep Model of Music Mood Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The music mood classification problem is finding a lot of utility in the development of recommender systems designed related to health, exercising, listening and many others. Music induces change in the emotion or mood of a person. Analysis of effect of music on human electroencephalogram EEG reveals the stimulus induced. However, classification of the mood of the music is the preliminary step towards analyzing the effect of music. The preferred choice for such problems in Machine learning algorithm is KNN (K -Nearest Neighbors) Music mood classification is generally solved using the ADAM optimizer, and experimentation using FTRL is not done extensively. However, due to the fast convergence of FTRL, it can be tested for dense and deep networks too. This paper explores the performance of FTRL algorithm in music mood classification problem for calculating accuracy and loss. The results obtained in the paper are encouraging and matches the efficiency of KNN the performance of other optimizers like ADAM with an additional advantage of faster convergence.

articleTitle: Integrated ZetaConverterPV-battery system with fuzzy logic MPPT and regenerative braking in EV’s
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Electric Vehicle is a contingent solution for endurable augmentation of transportation. To augment the operational efficiency of Electric Vehicles (EVs), a pioneering methodology is enacted, whereby the amalgamation of photovoltaic (PV) power generation with a sophisticated Permanent Magnet Brushless DC (PMBLDC) motor system is orchestrated. Theamalgamation of a zeta converter regulated by a robust fuzzy protocol achieves ascended efficiency by cohesively orchestrating Maximum power point tracking (MPPT) and boost conversion within a unified stage. This scrutiny accentuates on storing surplus energy of the Photovoltaic (PV) system and energy produced during regenerative braking in a Lead-Acid battery using a bidirectional converter. Regenerative braking in a BLDC motor ameliorates energy efficiency by transmuting excess kinetic energy into electrical energy during deceleration, enriching overall sustainability in electric propulsion. This system embodies the potential to advance future sustainability within the transportation sector, fortifying the commitment of the National E-Mobility initiative to revolutionize mobility and optimize battery storage efficiency. This assertion is substantiated by outcomes derived from a simulation executed in the MATLAB/Simulink environment, meticulously delineating the intricate functionalities of the system.

articleTitle: Detection of Mishap and Myocardial Infraction
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Mishap is the most common cause of death if not detected in time. Myocardial infractions lead to a heavy loss to an individual’s family. The proposed system is a kind of health monitoring system with a location tracking facility that is used to identify if there are any accidents prone to the user or if the driver suddenly gets any high or low BPM. The system immediately senses the situation and sends information to the registered mobile number. The designed system uses a microcontroller chip, a GSM module, a gyroscopic sensor, and a pulse ox meter sensor to detect the user’s health condition. In the present scenario, lots of people are suffering from heart-related diseases. In order to reduce this, a technology using the Node MCU and GSM Module Track has been introduced. This will be processed when the driver gets a sudden cardio attack, a higher heart rate, or a lower heart rate. It will detect the oxygen level and give an alert to the user, admin, police, and the nearby ambulance. The goal of this research is to automatically assess a person's heart rate. This method can categorize, process, and evaluate key physiological information for long-term health monitoring applications.

articleTitle: Optimal Placement of BESS System using GWO Algorithm in a Standard Radial System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: As the energy landscape continues to evolve, Battery Energy Storage Systems (BESS) are increasingly recognized as essential technology for building a more sustainable and resilient energy. The ability to store extra energy produced by renewable sources like solar and wind energy is one of the main advantages of BESS because renewable energy sources are intermittent. In this paper to improve the effectiveness of distribution systems that heavily rely on distributed generation (DG), the implementation of Grey wolf optimization technique has done for identifying optimal location and size for battery energy storage systems (BESS) installation. According to the findings, the optimal installation of BESS could effectively lower system costs, enhance voltage profile, minimize power losses, relieve reverse power flow, and accomplish peak shaving with PSO and SSA being shown to be the most competitive algorithms. The results were contrasted and compared, the running costs of the microgrid with and without the ESS, it was shown that the BESS operation may results in operational cost reduction of 64.5%.

articleTitle: Tuberculosis and Pneumonia Detection Using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Artificial intelligence, particularly machine learning, is revolutionizing numerous fields by either supplementing or replacing human efforts, leading to enhanced efficiency and autonomy in systems. Healthcare stands as a notable domain ripe for collaboration with AI and machine learning, offering smoother and more efficient operations. In the context of the modern era, characterized by a scarcity of quality radiologists, the demand for AI-driven solutions in chest X-ray-based disease detection has become increasingly imperative. The subject of this paper is the classification of two major chest diseases, Pneumonia and Tuberculosis, through the implementation of advanced neural network architectures, specifically VGG19 and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN). The system provides diagnostic opinions to users, aiding medical professionals in making prompt and informed decisions about the presence of diseases. In comparison to prior research, this proposed model showcases the capability to detect two types of abnormalities, accurately discerning whether an X-ray is normal or exhibits abnormalities associated with pneumonia and tuberculosis. The VGG19-based CNN achieves remarkable accuracy of 96.87% for Pneumonia and 99.52% for Tuberculosis, surpassing previous models. This advancement underscores the potential of leveraging state-of-the-art neural network architectures for precise and efficient disease classification, addressing the critical need for accurate diagnostic tools in the medical field.

articleTitle: A Dynamic Deep Learning Model for Detection and Stage Categorization of Diabetic Retinopathy on Retinal Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Diabetic Retinopathy (DR) is a prominent problem over diabetics, as a result that follows functional a drop of eyesight among those people. There is becoming no treatment to restore vision if this aberration is not detected early. As a result, the only way out of these irreversible difficulties is to recognize and treat this sickness early. To keep patients' vision, ophthalmologists use human eye with another human naked eye, on the other hand, costs time and money and may occasionally result for errors due to subjective disagreements and concerns among ophthalmologists. Because of this deep learning technology is Fundus,OCT images are often used to diagnose diabetic retinopathy.Within this research, CLAHE is used to pre-process both fundus pictures and OCT datasets of diabetic retinopathy for enhancement and noise reduction. After that, the vessels are retrieved from the pre-processed retinal pictures by applying vessel enhancement filters and morphological processes. The associated features are extracted after the vessels have been removed. Convolutional Neural Networks are used to classify retinal pictures based on the retrieved characteristics and feature selection. Following that, the phases of mild, moderate, and severe were identified based on the severity prediction. Finally, statistical characteristics like as sensitivity, specificity, PSNR, Accuracy, and MSE were calculated.

articleTitle: Run-Time Detection of Hardware Trojan Attacks on Program Counter in RISC-V Processor
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Protection against hardware security issues like Hardware Trojans (HTs) in Integrated Circuits (ICs) is a major concern. Safeguarding crucial assets of the microprocessor has become vital in order to protect its functionality so that adversaries do not have any illegal privileges over the system. One such crucial asset is Program Counter (PC) and in this paper a run-time detection mechanism is presented to detect attacks against PC. The common drawback observed was not being able to detect those trojan attacks that caused the processor to crash and thereby the system to hang, which is addressed by the proposed mechanism. Those HTs that affect the execution of the instruction flow are also detected with the same mechanism. Implemented on a single-cycle RISC-V processor, the detection latency measured was one clock cycle. Area overhead, change in power consumption, change in working frequency were measured and the types of HTs that could be detected using this detection mechanism were analysed.

articleTitle: FPGA-based Sentimental analysis on English words using Decision Tree Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper presents a new method for building a trained classifier integrated circuit from a completely automated dataset. The dataset is constructed using a 5-bit binary number, with 32 words assigned to each value, 21 of which are positive and 11 of which are negative. To classify them into positive or negative words, a machine-learning decision tree algorithm is utilized and real-time implemented using FPGA. For the considered data set, the values of entropy, the root node, and branch nodes are evaluated and the flow of the decision tree is derived to develop the Verilog code using the behavioral model. The developed Verilog HDL code is verified using the Xilinx Vivado Tool for the proposed design. The IC layout for the proposed design is designed using the cadence software with 90nm technology. The INCISIVE tool is used for the front-end part of the design. GENUS and INNOVUS tools are used in the back-end part of the design. The proposed method is analyzed for the parameters of power, area, and speed.

articleTitle: Closed-Loop Control of Dual-Sided LCC Compensated Wireless Transfer System using a Front-End Controller
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The main aim of this research is to design and study the behavior of Dual Sided-LCC compensated system under open-loop (OL) condition and explain the essentiality of closed-loop (CL) control to achieve Constant Current-Constant Voltage (CC-CV) battery charging of EVs. The CL operation is performed using a front-end controller which does not require a feedback communication link. Quadrature Demodulation (QD) technique and Phase-Shifted Full Bridge Inverter (PS-FBI) are used to estimate the load parameters indirectly. The DS-LCC compensation topology has inherent CC load characteristics and a system power factor of one. By varying the phase delay angle of the PS-FBI, the inverter output voltage and the current are varied to control the battery load parameters. A 3.2KW,400V, 8A WPT system operating at 85KHz resonant frequency is designed, studied and the simulation results match the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Controlled Trans-Z Source Inverter Fed PMBLDC Motor Drive
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Ongoing advancements in converters have offered a pathway for the Trans Z Source Inverter (TZSI) for control of PMBLDC-Motor-Systems. TZSI can be found between photovoltaic voltage and direct current load of WMS. The objective of this work is to identify a controller and improve time response of PMBDLC Motor Control System. In the existing drive-system, the Trans Z Source Inverters (TZSI) are used only for open loop control and the TZSIs are used for high level buck-boost operations. The TZSI is a one stage power conversion circuit. In the proposed system closed loop of TZSI fed 3000 watt- PMBLDC motor drive is simulated bydifferent controllers. The PMBLDC motor's speed is adjusted with the help of the Trans Z Source Inverter. Using TZSI, flexible speed control of the motor is achieved. Precise control over the rotor for detection of rotor position is achieved using Hall Effect Sensors. Under closed loop condition PI-PI, PI-FLC, FLC-PI, FLC-FLC are used for current and speed control respectively. The novelty of the article is to enhance the dynamic response of PV-TZSI-PMBLDC using fuzzy logic controller. This work has proposed TZSI for controlling PMBLDC motor. DSPIC based prototype of the TZSI-PMBLDC system is fabricated, tested and the simulation output is also validated with the experimental results

articleTitle: A Review on Algorithm of State-of-Charge of Li-Ion Batteries
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: State-of-Charge (SoC) is a prominent area in Battery management system. This paper presents an improved machine learning approach for analysing SoC in Electric Vehicle. This proves its prominence in safety and reliability of a system. Various models so far have given good approach of estimating SoC but somewhere lacks in meeting the precision of one or the other parameters in a specific model. This model called Random Forest Regression (RFR) along with Differential Search Algorithm (DSA) help develop an excellent model which tests the battery under various variations like voltage, current and temperature under three different temperature conditions. The experimental results proves the precision of SoC tested on LiNCA and LiNMC batteries.

articleTitle: A Survey on SRAM Bit Cell Architectures and its Performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: CMOS devices are constantly being downsized to achieve the most outstanding performance concerning speed, power consumption, reliability and size. About 60% of VLSI circuits are SRAM. The emerging market for cell phones and electronics powered by rechargeable batteries requires minimal energy chips. The speed of operation, level of integration and explosive development of battery products make the energy system a priority. Static access time, power consumption and speed are important for SRAM memory design. This paper explores various SRAM technologies employed to enhance speed, reduce delay, minimize power consumption, and optimize the chip area. The methods used include Gated VDD and MT-CMOS to achieve these improvements.

articleTitle: Study of Different System Parameters for Four-Wave Mixing in Holmium Doped Fiber Amplifier (HOFA) in Multi-Channel System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Four-wave mixing (FWM) is a highly dominant performance degrading nonlinearity in multi-channel systems. In holmium-doped fiber amplifier (HOFA), the emergence of FWM was not thoroughly studied in the literature unlike erbium-doped fiber amplifier (EDFA), and considered an insignificant phenomenon. However, the use of HOFA is prominent in the sensing applications which are very sensitive to the carrier spectrum. Therefore, in this research article, a detailed investigation of FWM in multi-channel systems has been performed at diverse input power levels, HOFA length, and Ho ion density. Results revealed that -10 dB input power, 3 m HOFA length, and 15.6×10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">23</sup> m<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">-3</sup> Ho ion doping are optimal for generating the least FWM

articleTitle: Design and Analysis of an Automatic Load Sharing and Power Theft Management
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
