abstract: With electric assiduity witnessing the change, increased attention is being concentrated on power force reliability. Power providers and druggies are concerned about trust ability without any interruptions/disturbances. Electricity theft plays a vital challenge experienced by power companies. This principally stops the power companies from making money from the sale of electricity. Different types of faults (symmetrical and unsymmetrical) are simulated and their effects on the 3-phase grids are dissembled. A simulation study on cargo sharing in the 3-phase systems is also done in the case of failure of a particular line due to the circumstance of any of the below-mentioned faults. In this design, an attempt has been made to design an automatic cargo sharing when a line fails and a power theft detection system using Arduino MEGA 2560 and ACS712 Current Detectors. 5V DC relays and 5V/12V, 1A Bridge Rectifiers and 230V/12V, 1A AC Transformers are also used in the system mode.

articleTitle: Cascaded Fuzzy Logic Controller for DVR Based Power Quality Improvement Voltage Sag/Swell Mitigation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Customers' demands for excellent power quality have greatly grown recently. Conventional electrical gadgets, sometimes referred to as D-FACTS devices, that guards sensitive loads against voltage fluctuations in distribution networks includes D-STATCOM, DVR, and UPQC. Two types of manufacturing procedure repercussions may be distinguished: increased sensitivity to intermittent failures (such voltage sag in distribution systems) and nonlinear and unbalanced loads. The DVR is a piece of equipment that was linked in series and controls the loading voltage by supplying the system with voltage. DVRs are typically placed in networks of distribution between sources and feeders of sensitive loads. The primary responsibility is to prevent any disconnections during disturbances by quickly supporting the load voltage (using a fast detection algorithm). The cascaded fuzzy logic controller techniques presented in this study are widely employed in voltage transmission and distribution systems to compensate for voltage sag and swell. This project describes a dynamic voltage restorer based on the average identifying methodology for single-phase power systems, in addition to discussing the usage of DVR to restore voltage sag and swell in distribution infrastructure using an alternative per-unit value approach (average detection). The results of the three-phase voltage sag and swell simulation have been given by SIMULINK/MATLAB. The Settling time obtained using Cascaded FLC controller is 0.15s and overall efficiency of the paper is 91.9%.

articleTitle: Brain Magnetic Resonance Image Reconstruction using Compressive Sensing and Denoising Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the framework of Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI), conventional techniques acquire a huge quantity of raw data leads to longer scan duration and increased exposure to the magnetic field. Compressive Sensing (CS) provides the prospective to acquire less measurement though enabling high-quality image reconstruction. MRI data frequently affects from noise and denoising methods assist to get better quality of reconstructed images. The blend of CS and denoising technique is a commanding strategy for MRI image reconstruction, especially in the fewer measurement scenarios, where noise may have a considerable impact. This paper focuses to explore the relevance of CS technique that enables image reconstruction with reduced set of measurements combined with Denoising algorithms to improve the quality and efficiency of MRI reconstruction. The objective is to develop a robust and accurate framework that can reconstruct high-quality MR images from sparse measurements while effectively suppressing noise artifacts. In this research, the concepts of compressed sensing and De-noising techniques have reviewed on MRI image reconstruction. The data is extracted from DICOM file and used multiple python Libraries to create reconstructed image and displayed it in different perspective with different sampling ratios. The performance of the denoising techniques is evaluated using metrics such as Normalised Mean Squared Error (NMSE), Peak Signal-to-Noise Ratio (PSNR), and Structural Similarity Index (SSIM). This study gives insights into the application of basic form of Compressive Sensing and Denoising algorithms for MRI reconstruction, showcasing their potential to improve imaging techniques and contribute to advancements in the field of medical imaging.

articleTitle: Weathering the Storm: Advancements in Rainfall Forecasting Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Rainfall prediction is vital for agriculture, water management, and disaster readiness. Machine Learning (ML) in this area has gained traction for its potential in enhancing accuracy. This study aims to create a predictive model using historical rainfall data, meteorological factors, and advanced ML algorithms. Regression or classification models like catboost algorithm Random Forest algorithms, Support Vector Machines, or Neural Networks uncover intricate data patterns to forecast rainfall. Feature engineering, data preprocessing, and model evaluation ensure robust and precise predictions. The resultant model offers accurate short-term and long-term rainfall forecasts, aiding decision-makers, farmers, and disaster response teams in planning and managing rainfall impacts. Continuous refinement and validation against real-time data bolster its reliability and practicality. This model represents a valuable tool for proactive measures in handling rainfall variability across various sectors.

articleTitle: Fault Identification of Solar Panel Using Image Processing and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Solar photovoltaic systems have emerged as a prominent source of renewable energy. However, their performance can be hindered by various factors, including faults within the PV modules or the overall system. Rapid and accurate detection of these faults is crucial for maintaining optimal energy production and ensuring system safety. This project proposes a novel approach for Solar Fault Detection using Convolutional Neural Network algorithm. The proposed system leverages the power of deep learning techniques to automatically analyse images of solar panels and identify potential faults. A comprehensive dataset of annotated solar panel images is used for training the CNN model. To account for real-world scenarios, the dataset includes images captured under various lighting conditions and angles. The CNN architecture is designed to extract intricate features from the images, allowing for precise fault identification. The model is trained on a diverse set of fault types, including but not limited to, micro cracks, hot spots, shading effects, and soiling. Transfer learning techniques are also employed to improve model performance and reduce training time. To account for real-world scenarios, the dataset includes images taken under different lighting circumstances and angles. The results demonstrate high accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity in detecting faults. Additionally, the system exhibits robustness to environmental variables such as weather conditions and time of day. In this user-friendly interface is developed to facilitate easy integration of the solar panel. The interface provides real-time feedback on the status of solar panels, highlighting any detected faults and their severity levels. This project presents a state-of-the-art approach for solar fault Detection using CNN algorithms, offers a best maintenance for the solar panel damages and fault. The proposed system holds significant potential for the solar panel damages and fault. The proposed system holds significant potential for widespread adoption in the solar energy industry, contributing to increased energy efficiency and sustainability.

articleTitle: Neuro Fuzzy Logic Algorithm Based WECS-PMSG Interfaced Water pumping System Along with Battery-Energy Management System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This project is about developing an effective way for ensuring optimal flow of electricity in a renewable energy-powered water pumping system. This work intends to find a worldwide monitoring method with an ideal modification of the DC bus power augmentation in this setting. A Neuro fuzzy logic algorithm is used as the primary optimizer of the supervision power transfer in the proposed study to enhance the diverse power flows shared between the network's components. The proposed configuration also eliminates the undesired capacitive feedback cycle, as well as the undesired conductivity through the body transistor of the inactive switches in the earlier established Bridgeless Isolated Cuk converter. This enhances the charger's performance greatly. A wind turbine (WT) is obligatory as the primary renewable energy basis, and it is linked to a battery energy storage system (BSS) to maintain the electrical supply stability of an induction motor pump unit. The proposed converter's improved effectiveness and power indexes are studied to verify its excellent charging performance under all operational situations. In this paper the comparison graph between the MPPT tracking efficiency of the proposed controller obtained value is (93.2%) and the efficiency of the proposed converter obtained value is (91%).

articleTitle: Speed control of PMSM using Fuzzy logic control with PSO technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In many different industrial applications, there is an increasing need for accurate and efficient management of electric machinery. This study investigates combining the Particle Swarm Optimization (PSO) and Fuzzy Logic Control (FLC) techniques to optimize speed control in a Permanent Magnet Synchronous Machine (PMSM). The goal of combining FLC with PSO is to improve PMSM performance, namely in the areas of energy efficiency, speed response, and stability. Fuzzy logic is used in the suggested control technique to simulate the intricate and nonlinear linkages present in PMSM dynamics. Fuzzy rules offer a flexible and adaptable control approach by capturing the behavior of the system under various operating conditions. The software MATLAB/Simulink was used to model for optimizing the Speed performance in PMSM-based Electric vehicles by Fuzzy Logic control with PSO Optimization.

articleTitle: Exploring the Capability of Terahertz Imaging for Oral Diagnosis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Terahertz (THz) regime encompassing frequencies between 0.1 and 10 THz, has emerged as a promising frontier with numerous revolutionary applications across various domains. Its unique properties, including nonionizing nature, high sensitivity to water content, and spectral fingerprints of biomolecules, make it a versatile tool for various applications. In this present work, the THz imaging technique has been extended to human tooth sample with dental caries with a motive to explore the capability of the THz imaging technique for oral diagnosis. From the THz images acquired at different frequencies from 0.1 THz to 0.7 THz, it is evident that THz imaging can be employed for the precise location of the infected region in the tooth. It can also help infer regions of low density pertaining to the detection of weaker roots in their earlier stages.

articleTitle: Cloud Based Real Time Waste Management Using Dijkstra’s Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Efficient waste management is essential for smart city administrations, emphasizing eco- friendly practices. This paper introduces a route optimization technique for waste collection vehicles (WCVs) using a modified Dijkstra's algorithm. The goal is to prevent spillage from dustbins in various city locations. In typical scenarios, dustbins experience varying fill rates due to factors like demographic density, goods and services availability, season, time, festivals, and economic status. Traditional deterministic models struggle to capture this randomness effectively. The proposed system employs Internet of Things (IoT) sensors, wireless networks, and cloud servers to provide real-time information on dustbin status. This technological aid assists city municipalities in making informed logistic decisions, optimizing waste collection routes, and addressing challenges such as overflowing bins or logistic underutilization. This holistic approach leverages modern technologies to enhance waste Management efficiency in urban environments

articleTitle: Assessing Fitness of An Individual with IoT Based Enhanced Deep Belief Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The challenge of accurate fitness assessment, emphasizing the inadequacies of conventional methods. Machine Learning (ML) offers a solution by efficiently processing diverse sensor data to capture nuanced patterns in individual movement, ensuring more precise fitness evaluations. Existing applications, such as traditional regression models and basic neural networks, face limitations in capturing complex correlations and adapting to diverse routines. In contrast, our proposed Enhanced Deep Belief Network (EDBN) integrates IoT technology, surpassing these limitations by leveraging sophisticated deep learning techniques. The EDBN model exhibits a substantial enhancement in accuracy of 91.7% which is more reliable than other existing applications and algorithms. Added with these remaining factors measured through improved predictive precision, providing a promising avenue for advancing personalized fitness management.

articleTitle: Design and Evaluation of FPGA-Optimized Symmetrical Three-Term Karatsuba Multipliers
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This work proposes symmetrical three-Term Karatsuba multipliers for large integer multiplications. The overall performance of the proposed multiplication design methods (SThTKM-I and SThTKM-II) are also noted by calculating Area-Time-Product (ATP) and compared with conventional symmetrical three-term Karatsuba multiplication (CSThTKM) and existing state-of-the-art. Hardware implementations of the proposed SThTKM multiplication architectures are done using Virtex-7 FPGA device in Xilinx ISE platform. Compared with other state-of-the-art designs, the performance of the proposed SThTKM-I based on ∆ATP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">1</inf> is 22.093%, 80.395%, 33.148% and 5.287% better than Direct Multiplication (DM), Traditional Schoolbook Multiplication (Traditional SBM), CSThTKM ans SThTKM-II respectively for 1024-bit inputs. Similarly the performance of the proposed SThTKM-II based on ∆ATP<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is 17.744%, 79.300%, 29.416% and -5.582% better better than Direct Multiplication (DM), Traditional SBM, CSThTKM and SThTKM-I respectively for 1024-bit inputs. However comparing both the proposed methods of SThTKM (SThTKM-I and SThTKM-II), it can be inferred that SThTKM-II is 3.127%, 9.276%, 6.150% and 5.582% better than SThTKM-I for 128 bits, 256 bits, 512 bits and 1024 bits respectively, thus proving its area-time-product (ATP) efficiency.

articleTitle: Modeling Blockchain For Manufacturing Industry in Developing Economy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Blockchain technology is one of the building blocks of smart technologies that are finding their way in different industries across the globe. Blockchain is believed to revolutionize the way businesses are conducted today. The major reason for the lack of penetration of emerging technologies like blockchain in the industries whose core competencies are not technology development or usage, for example manufacturing, is lack of awareness and knowledge about the blockchain. This study aims to provide an initial standpoint to the practitioners of the manufacturing industry to make informed decisions and better strategies for blockchain implementation. This study employs DEMATEL technique to analyze the crucial IT artifacts of blockchain technology that will help make various manufacturing processes efficient and sustainable. The role of blockchain technology in Industry 4.0 is also discussed. The study concluded with the grouping of chosen Blockchain IT Artifacts being classified into two groups: "Cause" and "Effect". After analyzing the responses, it has been observed that out of the 12 IT artifacts, 6 were classified as "Cause" and the remaining 6 were classified as "Effect."

articleTitle: Customer Segmentation and Retention Strategies for Bank Using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Customer churn is a pressing problem faced by banks, affecting their revenues and customer satisfaction. To solve this problem, this study explores the use of machine learning, specifically Naive Bayes, Decision Trees, and AdaBoost classifiers, to predict and reduce customer churn. By leveraging these complex algorithms, banks can gain insight into customer behaviour and take proactive steps to retain valuable products as customers. The process starts with pre- processed data, model design and coding. This optimization can solve many problems such as excessive priority, missing data, categorical features, etc. Additionally, Data Analytics (EDA) and visualizations to gain a deeper understanding of customer segmentation; This allows to uncover important trends and good standards. When evaluating performance in the model, Focused on simple metrics such as recall and ROC- AUC scores. These metrics provide insight into the model’s ability to accurately identify past customers while minimizing false positives. To improve the performance of model, hyperparameter tuning was performed to ensure that we achieved the highest accuracy. The Model adopt ROC-AUC curve to see the balance between true positive and negative value. This analysis provides a better understanding of the performance model, allowing to make informed decisions and strategies to manage the customer’s quality. Actual and estimated loss status is displayed as an estimate of Customer’s final model. This valuable information provides banks with the strategies necessary to identify potential credit losers and take the necessary steps to maintain their trust.

articleTitle: A certain analysis of solar home based lighting system for smart city designed for sustainable development
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper shows the better alternative to devices such as kerosene lamps, the main problem is that not all parts of the world have access to the electricity grid and therefore the population does not have access to metered energy. Either it is due to, or to the complicated geographical situation that does not favor the commissioning of electrical installations, or to the fact that the power company will not commission the connection because it is not possible to recover the amounts.

articleTitle: A Novel Approach for Plant Diseases Detection and Identification Using EfficientNet-B2
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Crops are a major factor in a nation's economy. The most important factor in food production is crop yield. Good crops come from healthy plants. The plants are diseased, food production may suffer as a result. Microorganisms are the primary cause of plant illnesses. A change in the leaf's colour or form indicates the presence of malady on the plant. It becomes grave to recognize plant illnesses as soon as possible to prevent any impact on food production. One crucial step in this direction could be the use of technology for the detection of plant diseases. By utilizing Deep Learning techniques for this purpose, this research may discover plant diseases through exploitation. In this work, the disease identification of potatoes, tomatoes, and apples is done using EfficientNet-B2 with Transfer Learning. CNN, RestNet152V2, VGG-19, Xception, DenseNet169, and EfficientNet-B2 performance are contrasted. At 98.32%, EfficientNet-B2 yielded the best results in the identification of plant diseases. The model identifies 17 kinds of distinct plant diseases. Models can be trained in other courses to extend the work.

articleTitle: Dynamic Resume Evaluation a Comprehensive Approach to Part-Based Weightage Assignment and Score Generation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Navigating the dynamic landscape of today's employment market to identify suitable opportunities can be challenging. The advent of AI has empowered candidates to be ranked for a job role processed by computers. While conventional methods can quantify certain elements of positions and applicants, the conversion of unstructured data from job descriptions and resumes often leads to the loss of crucial information. Recently, Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional performance in text-based data domains within the AI field. Inspired by the prowess of LLMs in natural language understanding, this study exploits their capabilities to capture information previously lost during the conversion of unstructured data. In this innovative approach, traditional methods are surpassed by integrating web scraping techniques to extract valuable insights directly from resumes. By systematically gathering unstructured data from resumes, the LLMs are enriched with a diverse range of information, ensuring a more comprehensive understanding of candidates' skills and experiences. The acquired information is then utilized through a self-developed ranking mechanism tailored for the recruitment process, effectively ranking candidates based on their skills and capabilities.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review of Automation in Agriculture using Artificial Intelligence
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study aims to review the automation in Agriculture with Artificial intelligence. The paper mainly emphasizes the reasons, impacts, and developments of the red-collar workers. With a special focus on agricultural operations, and what are the changes in the lives of the farmers and the production of crops nearly has happened. To, know the operation, methods, and advancement of automation, the study material, discussion, and lecture on AI Automation are collected to draft the thesis. The contribution of AI automation helps far-stretched to reduce the risk of farmers while the seasonal changes with the help of forecasting weather, so that can be helpful to reduce the risk of crop loss. So, through the investigations of newly formed machines, tools, and vehicles, Automation in Agriculture is promptly trying to develop the life of red collars, which are closely associated with nature. The study paper is trying to elaborate main goals, contributions, and attempts to make economic development thoroughly.

articleTitle: Area-Efficient Fault-Tolerant 8T SRAM Cell for Space Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In this study, a new 8T memory cell that is made to be more reliable in areas with a lot of radiation, by combining physically unstable parts with the best transistor sizes is suggested. Utilizing the Tanner EDA tool, simulations demonstrate the cell’s resilience to both 0-to-1 and 1-to-0 single-node upsets, albeit with a slight increase in read/write access times. The 8T cell emerges as a favorable choice for aerospace applications, achieving a balanced performance in terms of area efficiency, power conservation, and reliability when compared to alternative radiation-hardened memory cells. The design showcases robustness through advanced upset physical mechanisms, addressing the challenges posed by radiation. Even though there is a small trade-off in access times, the 8T cell is a great choice for aerospace memory operations because it strikes the perfect balance between functionality and environmental extremes. The research findings contribute to advancing the field of radiation-hardened memory cells, providing a good understanding of the trade-offs involved in achieving optimal functionality in extreme environmental conditions. The 8T memory cell, with its carefully engineered features, emerges as a promising candidate for aerospace applications, promising a good level of performance, low power, and reliability in the face of challenging radiation scenarios.

articleTitle: Performance Analysis of Machine Learning Algorithms for Covid-19 Detection using Cough Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: With an alarming rate of Covid-19 cases worldwide, the challenge for early detection of this disease is growing. There are many methods available for the detection of Covid-19 but they can be tiresome and difficult. The more common method of testing is reverse transcriptase-polymerase chain reaction (RTPCR) testing which requires direct contact with the patient during the testing that further causes more chance for disease spread. But, the method of testing that uses coughing sounds was found to be more safe method of testing as this does not require the presence of patient in the lab rather the pre-recorded audio wave is enough to perform the testing. Machine Learning algorithms are a great promise for detection of Covid-19 disease. There are many different approaches for detection involving wide range of inputs. Likewise, this paper shows about the possibility of detecting Covid-19 using cough sound of the patient, by extracting required input features from the audio file using short time Fourier transform method. Simulation results shows the performance of different classification algorithms in terms of Accuracy, Precision, Recall and F1-Score for the detection of Covid-19. This paper has developed a web application which can detect the presence of corona virus. The audio recording of cough is loaded as the input in to the app which is then sent to deep learning model at the back end that returns the Covid infection result at the front end of the application. This also shows the accuracy of various algorithms in the web application.

articleTitle: Urban Hydrology and Storm-water Management for Smart Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study explores the complex interplay among urban growth and the field of hydrology with a special emphasis on storm-water control techniques. The hydrodynamic patterns in our cities have been drastically altered by urbanization, creating enormous barriers to the management of water resources sustainably. In this paper we examine the effects of urbanization on hydrological processes in urban settings using a thorough examination of the literature, observations in the field, and hydrodynamic modelling. We investigate several storm-water management methods, including conventional infrastructure and cutting-edge green alternatives, and evaluate how well they reduce the discharge from cities and improve water quality.

articleTitle: EMD inspired Spectral Peak Sequence-based Features for Speech-Music Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Speech and music segments differ in pattern in the spectrogram. However, the differences are more in higher frequencies as compared to lower frequencies as speech signals are band-limited to 4 KHz. This motivated us to extract spectral peak sequences (SPS) from low-order Intrinsic Mode Functions(IMFs) decomposed using Empirical Mode Decomposition. In the first stage, IMF-SPS features are extracted from the first five IMFs to capture the high-frequency components. Further, these IMFS-SPS features are used to derive statistical features like imfSPS-Mean, imfSPS-StandardDeviation, and imfSPS-Gradient. These features are then used to train three different classifiers - Support Vector Machines, Decision Trees, and Gaussian Naive Bayes Classifier. The results are validated on three datasets (Slaney, GTZAN, and BITM) and compared with previous benchmarks. We achieved the best classification accuracy of 98.3%, 91.4%, and 98.3% with SVM, GTZAN, and BITM datasets respectively.

articleTitle: Coverage Analysis of 5G mmWave Base Station: A Case Study
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Nowadays, 5G research and development is in full swing across the globe. It is offering tremendous research opportunities to Academia and Industry people. A huge enhancement in deployment of BSs is expected when 5G shall be deployed functioning in mmWave. In this paper all types of Antennae like Parabolic, Horn, Sector and Cavity are analyzed in actual scenarios of mmWave Base Stations. It is found that Horn Antenna has better directivity in comparison to others. Also, a case study is performed here for MG Road, Bengaluru considering the minimum number of BSs required without compromising with SINR. It is also found that 05 BSs are sufficient to cover the target with a best value of SINR of 18.

articleTitle: An Innovative Analysis to Improve the Performance by Blocking the Pop-ups of Web Applications with XGBoost Algorithm over K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The focus of the research is to utilise the XGBoost algorithm in comparison to the K-Means algorithm is to prevent pop-up windows from showing up on a web application. The K-Means Algorithm and the XGBoost Algorithm are two examples of two groups that are used. The sample size for each group is 10, and the significant value of the data set is predicted using SPSS values with an 80% G-power. Their accuracy levels are determined and contrasted using various sample data sizes. Different sample data sizes are used to achieve and compare each accuracy. The difference between these groups has a significance value of 0.001, which is less than 0.05 (p<0.05), indicating that there are statistically significant differences between them. XGBoost Algorithm with mean accuracy of 71.70% and standard deviation is 1.16, K-Means has a mean accuracy of 82.60% and standard deviation is 1.07. When compared to the XGBoost Algorithm, the suggested K-Means algorithm offers greater accuracy.

articleTitle: Secured Data Transfer for Wireless Sensor Networks Using Homomorphic Cryptosystem
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: WSN gains a lot of attention towards extraordinary applications due to their self-configuration, protection, and scalability capabilities. These networks are configured with large number of nodes to transfer the information in the community. These networks are generally characterized on the basis of low bandwidth, limited strength, restricted energy components and memory, which ends up with a mandate for the surroundings to ensure protection. The objective is to achieve the statistical protection of the community with the aid of the Homomorphic Cryptosystem (HC). The proposed approach has two levels of security, so that it will cozy records transmission of WSN. The first is with ease clustering and the routing operation which are accomplished by means of ‘Multi-goal Believe-Primarily Based Bat Optimization Algorithm (MOTBOA)’. In next, information safety of WSN is progressed with aid of the improved HC to provide secure verbal exchange in Sensor Networks. It is far completed with the aid of the usage of the HC methodology for the procedure of encryption and decryption over the statistics for the duration of conversation many of the nodes. The detection charge, put off, throughput, routing load, and Packet transport Ratio are evaluated. In the implemented MOTBOA method the detection rate is 62.9%, the delay is 7ms, throughput is 77.9%, the packet delivery ratio is 93.7%, and routing load is 0.46 for the network when compared to the trust based DSR (TDSR), Monarch-Cat Swarm Optimization (MCSO), and secured QoS Energy Efficient Routing (SQEER).

articleTitle: Smart Limb Technology: Bluetooth Integration in Prosthetic Arms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Exploring the transformative influence of Bluetooth integration in prosthetic limbs, this discussion delves into the enhanced capabilities and control it brings to individuals with limb loss or impairment. For those with limb loss or impairment, the integration of Bluetooth technology into prosthetic limbs has ushered in a new era of capability and control. This examination delves into prosthetic limbs with Bluetooth functionality, high- lighting its impact on wireless communication, control systems, and user experience. Modern prosthetic limbs leverage Bluetooth for smooth wireless connectivity with external devices, enabling users to update settings, receive real-time feedback, and personalize their prosthetic limbs. With the integration of Bluetooth, users experience improved control, connectivity, and sensory feedback, enhancing their natural interaction with prosthetic limbs and significantly contributing to the field of prosthetics.

articleTitle: Hyper Parametric Analysis of Multi-Layer Perceptron for Music Genre Classification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Machine Learning has played a pivotal role in enhancing user experience in the field of entertainment. A gamut of music related software and applications incorporate machine learning at its core to provide an exceptionally unique user experience. An important aspect of design of such a recommender system is the classification of music. Deep Learning has proven to be really efficient in classification problems of music. However extensive parametric analysis of deep learning methods like Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP) can yield accuracy of up to 84.1 % and it can give researchers a greater idea of the tuning they can use for quick and efficient classification. This paper presents an extensive analysis of hyper parameter tuning of MLP which can be used as a benchmark for designing more accurate system design.

articleTitle: Comparison of Novel Random Forest Algorithm over Gaussian Naïve Bayes for Improving Accuracy in Software Bug Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Aim: This research work focuses on analyzing the performance of a proposed random forest method with that of Gaussian Naive Bayes in predicting software problems. Materials and Methods: The dataset utilized in this research was gathered from the Kaggle repository and contained information about software projects and their bug reports. A total of 20 samples were used in this study, with two groups formed and 10 samples randomly selected for each group. Group 1 was used for training and testing the Gaussian Naive Bayes algorithm, while Group 2 was used for training and testing the novel random forest algorithm. Python and relevant libraries such as scikit-learn were utilized for implementation. The dataset was preprocessed to remove irrelevant features and perform feature engineering. The algorithms were tested on the training set, and their performance was assessed using accuracy metric on the testing data. A statistical power of 0.8 was set, and alpha and beta qualities of 0.05 and 0.2, respectively, were used with a confidence interval of 95%. Results: The accuracy of the novel random forest approach was 78.59% on average, whereas the accuracy of the Gaussian Naive Bayes approach was 75.57% on average. The p-value for the statistically significant difference in accuracy between the two approaches was 0.001 ( p<0.05). Conclusion: The findings suggest that the novel random forest approach could be a useful tool for software developers and project managers to predict and prevent potential bugs in their projects.

articleTitle: Non-intrusive Emotional Development Monitoring of Pre-Primary Children Using Image Processing and Machine Learning Model
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The development of emotions begins in a child from infancy and continues into adulthood. The pre-primary experiences are unique to each child and the learning environments in early life often serve as the source for behavioral outcomes as they grow. The study is mainly based on detecting the emotions of children to have an insight of their behavior with respect to the external environment. The approach aligns with the Goal-3 Good health and well-being of the United Nations Sustainable Development Goals. It provides with the behavior pattern in better understanding of the child emotions both by parents and teachers of the student. Emotion recognition model using image processing enable understand how the emotions of children change and affects their lives with the human interaction. The model uses Transfer Learning model. Many students sit in front of their computers and can easily analyze their interaction with the system. The technology is evolving and using this model, can analyze human interaction and their behavior patterns in a given particular situation.

articleTitle: Advanced Computational Techniques In Stroke Prediction: Analyzing Cardiac And Vascular Bio-Signals
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Stroke is a potentially fatal or disabling condition, making it crucial to promptly identify the early warning signs. Ischemic and hemorrhagic strokes are clinically differentiated, necessitating immediate management with thrombolytic or coagulant medication. Initially, it is imperative to identify the prompt indicators of a stroke, which may differ across individuals and necessitate the involvement of a specialist and admission to a hospital. Previous research has primarily focused on post-stroke treatment rather than stroke prevention. Recent research has shown a growing dependence on image processing, specifically MRI and CT scans, to identify and forecast prognostic indicators in individuals who have suffered from strokes. Identifying such processes in real time poses difficulties, and assessing these processes incurs costs and time constraints. This work introduces a multi-modal bio-alert system that utilizes photoplethysmography (PPG) and electrocardiogram (ECG) data to diagnose and evaluate cognitive stroke prognostic indicators in older individuals. We have created a stroke prediction gadget that uses a combination of regression algorithms to accurately estimate the occurrence of stroke infections in real-time, even when the user is walking outdoors. Elderly individuals can conveniently transport bio-signal sensing devices due to the meticulous apparatus that captures bio-indicators while walking at a sample rate of 1,000 Hz, either from the three conductors of the ECG or the forefinger for PPG. The performance and efficiency of the accurate prediction were proven through the real-time study of stroke patients in the senior age group.

articleTitle: Decoding of Morse Code from Eye Blinks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This report provides a step-by-step approach to decoding Morse Code using eye blinks as a means of communication. Morse Code is a system that represents letters, numbers, and symbols using dots and dashes. By assigning specific durations to blinks, such as short blinks for dots and longer blinks for dashes, individuals can communicate messages through eye movements. This project emphasizes the importance of familiarizing oneself with Morse Code and establishing clear communication protocols. It also highlights the need for practice to improve proficiency in decoding Morse Code using eye blinks. While this method offers an alternative means of communication in situations where speech or hand movement is restricted, it requires careful attention to blink duration and pauses between blinks to accurately interpret the transmitted messages.

articleTitle: Enhancing Spatial Steganography for Optimal Data Concealment with Image Quality Preservation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the domain of steganography, the act of concealing data within an image poses a significant challengebalancing between the precision of the carrier image and the capacity for embedding information. This article introduces an innovative spatial steganography approach employing evolutionary algorithms. Proposed method introduces novel approaches to strengthen the matching of the LSB between the carrier and the concealed image. This process leads to an up-scaled concealing efficiency while minimizing deformation. The technique involved optimized pixel traversal in both row and column wise directions, pixel relocation, pixel swapping confidential bits, and inverting confidential data. A generic steganography model rooted on evolutionary algorithms is formulated to explore optimal solutions. Experimental investigations of the RECS [11] and SDID [16] method confirm that the performance of the proposed method is comparatively better than the traditional methods in terms of higher Embedding rate by 29%, PSNR by 19%, and SSIM by 15% respectively.

articleTitle: Prevention of unauthorized intrusion to electronic gadgets with Scrambled keypad
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the context of the growing threats of security breaches and unauthorized intrusions, safeguarding personal information, especially PINs for electronic devices, has become a paramount concern. Various hacking techniques, such as thermal imaging, fluorescent masking, and chemical interventions like phenolphthalein, pose serious risks to the security of sensitive information. This paper introduces a novel approach to address these challenges through the implementation of a graphical keypad based on the Graphical User Interface (GUI) technique. The system generates an icon- based keypad on an LCD screen, providing UART output. The key innovation lies in employing a Random Pattern Development (RPD) Algorithm to dynamically scramble the keypad pattern after each use. This constant variation makes it significantly more difficult for hackers to compromise the authentication key. Unlike traditional methods where passwords are static and vulnerable, the proposed system VSK (Virtual scrambled keypad) enhances security by reducing the chances of password interception by third parties. The key layout-shuffling concept adds an extra layer of protection, making it challenging hackers to predict or exploit the password even if they observe the user entering it. By leveraging technology to create a graphical keyboard with a dynamic layout, the system not only fortifies security but also ensures user-friendly operability. This innovative approach aims to counteract the prevalent methods of ATM PIN hacking, offering a secure system that is resilient against sophisticated hacking techniques while remaining user-friendly and accessible.

articleTitle: High Gain KY Converter For Grid Tied Clean Energy PV System Using Cascaded Neuro Fuzzy Logic MPPT Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)

authors.preferredName: V V Satya Sai Naga Geethika Baladari

abstract: Power systems worldwide are looking into new ways to generate electricity as a result of the depletion of fossil fuel-based energy supplies worldwide. The major emphasis of attention is on clean and renewable energy resources (RES), of which wind and solar are two of the best. Although it is sporadic, solar energy is abundant in tropical regions. Therefore, connecting it to the grid is the best way to use it as a dependable power source. If it utilized as a stand-alone power source, measures to address its dispatch ability problems (resulting from its sporadic availability) must be taken to ensure that it continuously provides enough power to its linked loads. The suggested system is said to be interactive since it can function in both islanded and grid-connected modes. Additionally, load management is provided when operating in island mode under low illumination conditions. The proposal outlines a two-stage solar PV system, the first of which uses a KY converter (shows voltage gain 1:12) to maximize power extraction and function as a voltage booster. Cascaded ANFIS controller is employed to tune the parameters of the converter. A two-leg inverter that feeds the available electricity into the grid operates in the second stage. This work is developed using Matlab 2021a simulation.

articleTitle: Optimizing 802.11 MAC Protocol: A Design and Implementation Approach for Improved Throughput, Efficiency, QoS, and Reduced Latency in Low Contention Networks for Voice and Video Communication
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study suggests modifications to the already existing IEEE 802.11 MAC protocol, by proposing the elimination of the back-off period following collisions and recommending the use of Distributed Inter-Frame Space (DIFS) for post-collision waiting. The revised protocol is validated using the Network Simulator which involves simulations with six nodes setup in a wireless medium. The Network Simulator will act as an important step in evaluating and analyzing the findings of this study. The primary objective of this research is to transform the detection of collision events by relying solely on the DIFS time instead of using the conventional back-off period along with DIFS time. Expected advantages include improved network speed, reduced contention, and optimized channel access. The insights from this study may further contribute to the ongoing development of the wireless communication protocols based on IEEE 802.11.

articleTitle: Cherry and Berry plant leaf disease classification using Modified AlexNet
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The agricultural landscape encounters difficulties, particularly the requirement for prompt and precise identification of plant diseases to guarantee worldwide food security. This article utilizes sophisticated deep learning methods, notably utilizing the improvised AlexNet framework, to tackle the intricacies of diagnosing illnesses in cherries and berries. With the global population projected to surpass 10 billion by 2050, the need for enhanced food production becomes of utmost importance. The use of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNN), such as the AlexNet model, signifies a significant change in plant pathology. This paper highlights the crucial significance of deep learning in transforming plant leaf disease detection procedures. The experimental configuration, carried out on a computer with precise hardware specifications, entails both quantitative and qualitative evaluations to thoroughly verify the model's functionality. The new AlexNet model is compared to known approaches such as YOLO, ResNet150 in a comparative study. The assessment criteria, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 score, offer a detailed comprehension of the model's effectiveness in detecting cherry and berry plant leaf diseases. The research on the AlexNet model enhances one’s understanding of its possibilities and adds to the existing information on utilizing advanced technology for sustainable and efficient agricultural operations.

articleTitle: Comparative Analysis of Solid Insulating Spacers for Uniform and Non-UEFs in N2:SF6 Gas Mixture under AC Voltages - An Experimental Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Due to the rapid development in area of compressed gas insulated systems (GIS), it is necessary to enhance the transmission and distribution system which led to search for better gas insulation. The Sulphur hexafluoride (SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf>) is the most popular insulating gas having good electrical, thermal and chemical properties and used in the electrical power equipments. It has been recognize as a greenhouse gas (greenhouse effect), which contributes to global warming potential in modern years. Hence attempts have been made to find suitable substitute to SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas. In this direction N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>:SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas mixture has been identified to be one of the most promising one, because N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf> is an odourless, colourless, inert-gas and nontoxic and it has no-greenhouse effect. Solid insulating spacers are most vital components influencing the reliability performance of GIS, which gives mechanical support to the conductor. It is important to explore the novel insulating spacers such as Polymethyl methacrylate (PMMA), NYLON and Polypropylene (PP) and its blending hybrid spacers to study the surface flashover performance in different electrode configuration such as uniform (Plane – Plane) and non-uniform (Needle - Plane) electric fields in compressed N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>:SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas mixture under AC voltages. In this article, the effect of floating particles in N<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</inf>: SF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">6</inf> gas mixture has been studied and the obtained experimental results are compared. The results shows that, NYLON individual spacer has better flashover voltage (FOV) for both uniform and non-UEFs and in case of hybrid spacer the PMMA+PP and PP+PMMA combination gives more FOV for both uniform and non-UEFs. With the effect of conducting floating, the individual spacer PMMA has less reduction in FOV for both uniform and non-UEFs compared to other spacers and in case of hybrid spacer PP+NYLON has less reduction in FOV for UEF whereas for non-UEF NYLON+PMMA shows less reduction in FOV values.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Literature Review on Core Local Interrupt Controller in RISC-V Processors
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The emergence of an open-source instruction set architecture (ISA) widely known as RISC-V has opened a new era of innovation within the realm of embedded systems. Interrupt handling is a crucial aspect in RISC-V-based processors enabling the timely response to external events and ensuring efficient task management. However, it is important to acknowledge that there are still certain gaps between the current interrupt capabilities of RISC-V and the evolving requirements of emerging computing scenarios. The Core Local Interrupt Controller (CLIC) has emerged as a crucial enhancement in RISC-V processors addressing the limitations of the Core Local Interruptor (CLINT), the default interrupt controller, in interrupt prioritization and pre-emption. This paper provides a comprehensive review of the CLIC, delving into its functionalities, key components, and methodologies, leveraging various research papers and publications. Drawing insights from various research papers, journals, articles, and publications, the comprehensive analysis herein sheds light on the critical role played by the CLIC in overcoming challenges related to interrupt prioritization and pre-emption in RISC-V-based processors. Furthermore, this paper concludes by identifying open research challenges and emerging trends in the field of CLIC implementation and utilization.

articleTitle: The Agro Predictor – A Smart farming approach using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The prime focus of this Agro-Predictor system which relies on the key learnings of the Internet of Things and Deep Learning Approach, to benefit the agricultural sector, placing its undivided attention on critical areas. Analysis of soil types and different weather conditions affecting, recommendations based on all the predictions made for the best production and farming. The integration of advanced technologies like Deep Learning, Data Mining, IOT and etc, has influenced agricultural sector transformation in various ways. The potential of deep learning models has been demonstrated to revolutionize farming practices by collecting the required data set, training and segregating the following, and predicting the required outcomes with the best recommendations. The work highlights the need for innovative solutions to address the growing global demand by identifying problem areas that require further research for sustainable agriculture by predicting various factors to reach the required solutions in farming.

articleTitle: Comparative Performance Analysis of Intercalated Graphene Nanoribbon and Cu Interconnect
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In this work, the performance of graphene nanoribbon interconnect (GNR) and Cu interconnect in terms of speed and power estimation has been studied for IC design. The analysis is performed using 16nm technology with five different interconnect materials (e.g. Cu, pristine GNR: undoped materials, intercalation GNR-Li: doped materials, intercalation GNR-AsF<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">5</inf>: doped materials, intercalation GNR-Fecl<inf xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">3</inf>: doped materials). A five-stage CMOS inverter circuit was employed to assess the performance of these interconnect materials. The results indicate that intercalation GNR-Li interconnect materials outperform the others in terms of delay, showing ~3.68 × less delay than Cu, ~2.67 × less than pristine GNR, ~1.54 × less than intercalation GNR-AsF5, and ~1.12 × less than intercalation GNR-Fecl3. Additionally, intercalation GNR-Li exhibits lower power consumption (0.38 nW) compared to Cu (5.34 nW), pristine GNR (2.34 nW), intercalation GNR-AsF5 (1.23 nW), and intercalation GNR-Fecl3 (1.11 nW). This analysis provides valuable insights for the design and modeling of advance artificial intelligence (AI) enabled and IoT based chip for future technology.

articleTitle: Emotion Recognition from Recorded Speech
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A complicated and subjective part of the human experience, emotion includes a wide range of sensations and responses to different stimuli. Emotion Recognition from Recorded Speech stands out as a commonly utilized approach for emotion identification. In this project, the chosen dataset for emotion recognition consists of four different datasets, with the focus placed specifically on the Ravdess dataset. The methodology of recognizing and categorizing human emotions from audio data is explored in this research. Machine learning techniques including decision tree models, support vector machines, random forest multilayer perceptrons, and convolution networks are used for such categorization. Impressive precision in the classification of emotions is seen in the collected testing results. The evaluation of the emotion recognition from recorded speech system's performance and its limitations is covered through a discussion involving different classifiers.

articleTitle: Cascaded H-Bridge Multilevel Inverter with Multicarrier Pulse Width Modulation Technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Multilevel Inverters (MLI) are extensively used due to their adequate rated output power, decreased harmonic, and much less electromagnetic interference. MLI has more switches and DC sources, which raises complexity and expense. The suggested multilayer inverter generates 31 output voltage levels while utilizing the fewest switches possible. More levels are produced by asymmetric topology when the number of sources is decreased. The switching pulses are made using the Multicarrier pulse width modulation [MCPWM] method. The harmonics drop as the number of levels increases because the harmonics also decrease. As the MCPWM technique is used, the total harmonics distortion (THD) gets reduced. Thus, the projected topology appreciably reduces the complication of the control circuit, cost, and lower order harmonics and thus effectively reduces THD. The simulation and results in output voltage, current, and harmonics of 31-level multilevel inverter with high-quality power are noticed. A comparative analysis of newly proposed topology and IEE papers has been made regarding THD, the number of switches, DC voltage sources, and output levels. MATLAB/Simulink and hardware will test the topology.

articleTitle: PSO Optimized Improved PFC Converter for Grid Tied EV Charging Station with Multisource Inverter
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The rise in popularity of electric cars (EVs) has resulted in a growing need for ecologically responsible and effective charging facilities. There is a need for efficient and reliable power management systems that can integrate multiplesources of power to charge EVs. This project aims to address the challenges of integrating multiple sources of power for charging EVs while ensuring high power quality with reduced harmonic distortion. This aims to develop a systemthat combines multiple power sources using a novel multisource inverter and feed theminto the grid with both linear and non-linear loads. A PSO (particle swarm optimization) adjusted PI (proportional integral) controller controls an enhanced PFC (power factor correction) converter that serves as an AC supply and a charging station for electric automobiles. Another input source battery converter is also fed into the system. The multiple power sources are then combined using a four-leg inverter that is controlled by a PI controller with DQ theory transformation. The system ensures that the power fed into the grid is of high quality with reduced harmonic distortion. This project has potential applications in industrial, commercial, and residential power systems where multiple power sources are required to beintegrated into the grid. The entire work for enhancing chargingcapacity of the EV through improved MS is carried out in MATLAB 2021 and simulation responses are obtained. This proposed work has a THD Value of 1.24% when the papers arecompared and the Settling time obtained using PSO-PIcontroller is 0.25s.

articleTitle: Impact of Cluster Attack on Wireless Sensor Network
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Wireless Sensor Networks (WSNs) are widely used for various applications, including environmental monitoring, healthcare, and industrial automation, due to their scalability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of deployment. However, the security of these networks remains a critical concern, as they are vulnerable to a variety of attacks. Cluster attacks, in particular, pose a significant threat to the integrity and availability of WSNs. The impact of cluster attacks on WSNs focuses on their detection, prevention, and mitigation.Cluster attacks target the hierarchical structure of WSNs, which typically consist of sensor nodes organized into clusters with a centralized cluster head. Such attacks can disrupt communication, compromise data confidentiality, and drain the energy resources of cluster heads, leading to network degradation or even failure. Understanding the mechanisms and implications of cluster attacks is essential for developing robust security solutions.Research reviews of existing cluster attack models, categorize their impact on WSNs, and survey the state-of-the-art detection and prevention techniques. It also describes the trade-offs between security and resource constraints in WSNs, as these networks often operate in resource-constrained environments. This concludes by highlighting the need for a holistic approach to secure WSNs against cluster attacks, combining intrusion detection, encryption, and energy-efficient protocols. By shedding light on the challenges and potential solutions related to cluster attacks in WSNs, this research aims to contribute to the development of more resilient and secure WSNs, ensuring their continued effectiveness in various applications.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of High Throughput and Efficient FIR Filter Architectures Using Parallel Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Parallel Processing systems are multiple-input multiple-output (MIMO) system and it can be used for improving speed and reducing power consumption of a system. In parallel system, throughput of any system is increased as it process multiple outputs in parallel. In this research, a high throughput and efficient parallel system of block size 4 is developed for 11tap (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>order) Finite Impulse Response (FIR) filter. For designing this parallel system VHDL (VHSIC Hardware Description Language) is used and Artxi7 Basys3 FPGA board is used for implementation. This MIMO system operates at 1200KHz frequency and inputs for this MIMO system are generated by a serial to parallel converter circuits at frequency of 4800KHz. Vivado 2015.2 tool is used for doing synthesis, simulation and MATLAB is used for finding 11tap (10<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">th</sup>order) FIR filter coefficients. Designed and implemented parallel system is compared for area and speed with existing serial and parallel FIR filter architectures.

articleTitle: Early Detection of Sleep Apnea by Non-Invasive Method : A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The term "Apnea" describes a medical disorder where breathing stops momentarily or reduces significantly during sleep. Obstructive sleep apnea (OSA) and central sleep apnea (CSO) are the two main forms of apnea. Both cause a considerable reduction in sleep quality, which can result in daytime weariness, cognitive impairment, and other health problems. The cost and time required for the analysis of apnea are high, therefore, a non-invasive method is preferred to reduce these costs. A study is carried out to compare the different noninvasive methods with the conventional methods to propose a new model for early detection of apnea.

articleTitle: Comparative analysis of different plant leaf disease classification and detection using CNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Increasing threat to global food security, efficient and timely detection of plant diseases is crucial for ensuring agricultural productivity. The paper deals with a comparative analysis of the accuracy of the CNN applied for leaf disease detection in two major crops: maize and soybean. The preferred methodology utilized the ability of deep learning to improve the accuracy and speed in identifying diseases, thereby aiding farmers in making informed decisions for crop management. The study employs a dataset comprising annotated images of maize and soybean plant leaves affected by various diseases. A deep dive into the architectural nuances of CNNs is undertaken, with a focus on optimizing model performance for both crops. Transfer learning techniques are explored to harness pre-trained models, enhancing the network's ability to generalize across diverse disease patterns. The training process involves fine-tuning the CNN models on the plant-specific datasets, optimizing hyper parameters, and employing data augmentation strategies to address limited training samples. The comparative analysis extends to evaluating the model's performance specifications such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, to ascertain their productiveness in disease classification. Additionally, the research investigates the robustness of the models against environmental variations. The authors explore the impact of model interpretability on decision support for farmers by visualizing the areas of interest within the leaf images that contribute to disease prediction. The results reveal insights into the relative strengths and weaknesses of the CNN models for maize and soybean disease classification, offering valuable guidance for stakeholders in precision agriculture.

articleTitle: Patterns Recognition using Machine Learning and Preserving the Patterns using Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This project addresses the critical need for safeguarding patterns identified in datasets during their transmission to a destination. The process involves two key steps: first, employing advanced pattern recognition algorithms, such as AdaBoost Classifier and Random Forest Classifier, to extract meaningful insights from the dataset; second, implementing robust encryption techniques, specifically RSA encryption, to secure these patterns before delivery. The integration of these steps into a seamless pipeline facilitates the secure transmission of patterns to their designated destination. Considerations for key management, performance optimization are also addressed. Rigorous testing and validation methods ensure the effectiveness and reliability of the pattern recognition and encryption processes. By combining advanced pattern recognition with robust encryption techniques, this project provides the best solution for protected data transmission, ensuring that valuable insights gleaned from dataset are delivered with utmost confidentiality and integrity.

articleTitle: A Literature Survey on Floating Point Coprocessor with Extended Instruction Set
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Mathematical operations like square root, minimum, maximum, and comparison are included in the RISC-V Single Precision Floating-Point (RISC-V SP-FP) instruction set. With single-precision floating-point values, the square root instruction determines an operand's square root. It is possible to compare two operands and determine which is greater or lesser by using the maximum and minimum instructions. Comparative instruction, on the other hand, compares two operands and produces a binary output that is either equal to, greater or lesser than the other operand. Applications ranging from scientific simulations to graphics processing can benefit from these instructions' efficient and accurate numerical computations. Capitalizing on the simplicity and adaptability of the RISC-V architecture, the SP-FP instructions enhance the overall efficiency and adaptability of computing systems that follow the RISC-V specifications.

articleTitle: Reel Picks: Smart Movie Suggestions
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A movie recommendation system is an application which filters or predicts user preferences according to their selections. Several different items, like music, movies, books, news, research articles, uses recommendation systems. Its goal is to identify patterns in a dataset in order to deliver the most relevant data to a user dataset. Using a content-based filtering algorithm and the Python programming language, and can create this application. To accomplish the recommendations, content-based filtering looks for similarities between users and items. A data set comprising the user ID, ratings, item number, and time spent is included. Match user ID and ratings with these data using a mapping technique and correlation concept. The user's rating of the films they've watched should determine the next movie recommendation.

articleTitle: Visual Sort: A User-Friendly GUI for Tree Canopy Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Graphical User Interface (GUI), is a visual way for users to interact with software, utilizing graphical elements like icons, buttons, and windows instead of text commands. It enhances user experience by providing an intuitive, user-friendly interface for navigation and control. A tree canopy refers to the upper layer of branches, leaves, and stems formed by the crowns of trees when viewed collectively, which shows difficulties in VHRS (Very High-Resolution Satellite) images due to its complex and dense structure, which makes it difficult to accurately detect and classify objects beneath it. The proposed model employs a interactive GUI system that leverages a novel semantic segmentation approach for detecting and classifying objects covered by tree canopies within the VHRS images. The input image is preprocessed using pre-processing techniques and uses U-Net with the backbone of ResNet34 for improving tree canopy mapping by detecting and classifying objects into buildings (white), roads (red), and water bodies (blue) and got accuracy of 84

articleTitle: A Fuzzy Logic Approach for Enhancement of Maximum Power Extraction in Solar Photovoltaic Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This research presents a unique fuzzy logic controller approach to maximize energy extraction from solar PV devices under varying irradiation. The DC/DC converter in the PV system is connected to a DC load. The output DC voltage and power are the characteristics used to analyse the MPPT controller's performance. The device's dynamic responsiveness and steady state voltage under varying solar irradiation are taken into account while defending the controllers' overall efficiency. MATLAB/SIMULINK software is used to design and setup the device, and the results are verified. The results are compared with Perturb and observe technique.

articleTitle: Warning System as Parking Assistance for Blind Spot Elimination in Vehicles
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the recent years, there has been an increase in demand for more features in cars that has led to development of smart cars. Still, it is very difficult for the driver to judge the clearance while parking cars due to limitation in the field of view available in cars. While parking, lack of visibility for the driver due to presence of blind spot leads to rubbing off the body of the car with other vehicles. This paper provides approach, implementation, and demonstration details of proximity sensor-based warning system as parking assistance for blind spot elimination in vehicles.

articleTitle: RNN Controller Based Harmonics Mitigation System in DFIG FED WECS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Renewable Energy Sources (RES) are critical to meeting the creation's upcoming energy demands. The present power system design, which is built on electrical components, has various non-linear loads and distributed generators RESs, which has resulted in the emergence of several PQ difficulties. This study presents a Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) approach for a Wind Energy Conversion System (WECS) based on Double Fed Induction Generator (DFIG). To eliminate stuttering in the excitation system, an advance controller organization is used for adaptive modification of the intermittent control amplitude though maintaining the tightly coupled system's resilience. The Artificial Neural Network controller one provides increased reliability and monitors the supreme power from the Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) rectifier. The modeling of the engine and the DFIG will be given first. The rotor scales are then modified using the proposed RNN controller to achieve vector management of the active and reactive power. The purpose of the converter is to function at a constant power factor while providing input currents with an acceptable harmonic content. Extract as much real power as feasible at the interface of the power electronics converter and the DFIG. Subsequently will run a collection of numerical simulations with the MATLAB 2021a / Simulink program to evaluate the recommended controls. The comparison graph has the proposed RNN controller THD value is 0.92% and ANN controller settling time is 0.29seconds is obtained.

articleTitle: Audio Spoof Detection using Deep Residual Networks based Feature Extraction: Unveiling Synthetic, Replay and Mimicry Threats
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: With the increasing prevalence of artificial intelligence-driven audio systems, the vulnerability to adversarial attacks, specifically synthetic, replay and mimicry, has become a critical concern. This paper has proposed a deep Residual Network as a feature extractor to resolve this problem. This proposed approach is divided into two phases: Frontend and Backend. During the initial phase, the audio data underwent Mel spectrogram generation, and a modified ResNet50 architecture has been employed for feature extraction from the resulting Mel spectrograms. Subsequently, Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA) has been applied as a dimensionality reduction technique to optimize the complexity of the extracted features. In the second phase, the features selected by LDA have been utilized to train machine learning (ML) algorithms, including Support Vector Machine (SVM), Random Forest (RF), K-Nearest Neighbour (KNN), and Naive Bayes (NB). The training process involved utilizing the ASVspoof 2019 Logical Access (LA) and Physical Access (PA) training partitions, while the proposed model's validation and evaluation have been conducted using the development and evaluation partitions of the same dataset. Also, the Voice Impersonation Corpus in Hindi Language (VIHL) dataset has been used to detect mimicry attacks. The proposed model has achieved an EER of 2.4%, 2.2%, and 4.1% for synthetic, replay and mimicry audio attack detection, respectively.

articleTitle: Species Density Analysis Using Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The primary objective of this project is to develop a machine learning model, specifically Convolutional Neural Network (CNN), to count the density of several particular species in an audio clip. The model is trained on a dataset containing calls of the specified species and other species. This innovation has significant implications for wildlife monitoring and ecological research, as it can help researchers track and understand the behavior of organisms in forest regions more efficiently. Manual effort in audio analysis can be reduced by machine learning, thereby saving time. By improving and broadening techniques, algorithms, and training methodologies, researchers can uncover more about animal behavior and contribute to our collective understanding of ecosystems. The application of this technology can be useful for analyzing the total number of species in a certain rainforest region, eventually reducing the burden on researchers and streamlining the entire process. Overall, this project has immense potential to pave the way for more efficient and accurate wildlife monitoring and ecological research that can ultimately benefit our planet's biodiversity.

articleTitle: Next-gen 32-bit Arithmetic Logic Unit: Harnessing Cellular Automata using Quantum dots (QCA) Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the domain of VLSI technology, the validity of Moore's Law is presently being put to the test due to the intricate nature of augmenting the number of transistors in CMOS VLSI technology. To overcome these limitations, a novel technology called Quantum dot Cellular Automata (QCA) has surfaced, providing, in the context of nanotechnology advancement, a more inventive and efficient framework than CMOS. Information transfer between charges in this technology relies on coulombic interactions. Considering its favorable combination of energy efficiency and high processing speed, QCA technology stands out as the most promising substitute for traditional CMOS circuits.
