The emphasis in this endeavor lay in the development of a 32-bit ALU, a core component embedded in computing frameworks such as Central Processing Units (CPUs), Floating-Point Units (FPUs), or Graphics Processing Units (GPUs). This cohesive ALU design automates arithmetic and logical computations on binary data sets, emphasizing compactness and energy efficiency for optimal operational speed. According to the QCA expert tool's analysis, the outputs from using the QCA configuration tool show that the present architecture is superior to the current design, resulting in better space usage and increased power efficiency.

articleTitle: Improved power quality in DFIG based wind energy conversion system using whale optimization technique
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In order for the globe to meet its energy requirements in the future, renewable energy sources (RES) are essential. Many dispersed generations like RESs and non-linear loads are features of the power electronics-based current power system design, which has caused a number of power quality (PQ) issues to arise. Regarding a double fed induction generator (DFIG) driven wind energy conversion system (WECS), this research suggests an optimal control mechanism. In this paper, the benefits of a metaheuristic optimizer, WOA, are applied to determine the optimal tuning of the PI controllers in the study's control system. The sophisticated controllers system is used for the adaptive modification of the discontinuity control gain, reducing the phenomenon of chattering in the stimulation network while maintaining the resilience of the closed-loop system. The PWM rectifier's highest possible voltage is tracked by the PI Controller, which also provides increased dependability. Initially, the DFIG and turbine modeling will be introduced. The rotor dimensions are then changed to achieve vector control over both the reactive and active power when utilizing the suggested whale optimization tuned PI controller. The converter's objectives are to deliver input currents with a reasonable harmonic content in order to run at a power factor of one. Extraction of maximum real power occurs at the interface between the DFIG and the powers electronic converter. When compared to other controlling schemes, the WOA shows highest accuracy of 94.34% and less THD value of 0.98%. Lastly, it's going to use the MATLAB 2021a / Simulink program to do a number of computational simulations in order to verify the suggested controls.

articleTitle: Process development for MMIC based RF modules for reliable and better performance
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This article describes parameter optimization of novel packaging techniques for packaging of MMIC dice in aluminium housings. The developed packaging processes are implemented in aerospace modules for overcoming various challenges. The MMIC die is hermetically sealed and interconnected to the microstrip lines on alumina substrate. RF & DC feedthrus are soldered to aluminium housing to provide hermetic electrical I/O connections to MMICs. Thermosonic ribbon bonding process is used to interconnect the ribbon to MMIC die. The ribbon bonding process parameters are optimized to achieve required pull strength. The wire and ribbon effects on insertion loss are measured practically and compared. Also, RF connectors are ribbon bonded to 50 Ω lines as compared to conventional soldering process. Parallel gap welding technique is used for ribbon interconnection on RF connector pin. The developed processes are qualified and used in RF modules of aerospace systems.

articleTitle: Simulation based Study of Azimuthal and Axial Periodic Interaction Structure for a Wideband Gyro-Travelling-Wave Tube
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A novel azimuthal and axial periodic interaction structure for a gyro-travelling-wave tube (gyro-TWT) was designed, modelled, simulated and analyzed for examining its characteristics for dimensional control on the lower cutoff frequency, around which the device is operated. In comparison to the smooth-wall circular waveguide, a dispersion control is observed with the proposed interaction structure that in turn would be useful for broadbanding a gyro-TWT. It was noted that the lower cutoff frequency of the proposed interaction structure increases with the increase of axial length of the vane, vane angle, radial height of vane and number of vanes, and decrease of axial periodicity. The axial periodicity and number of vanes were, respectively, the parameters for maximum and minimum control on the lower cutoff frequency of the proposed interaction structure. Thus, the proposed structure was found to be a potential candidate for an interaction structure of a broadband gyro-TWT.

articleTitle: A Web and Mobile Application for Citizen Protection Service
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In contemporary societies, ensuring the safety and well-being of citizens is a paramount concern. Nowadays many kinds of occurrences are happening in front of our eyes but because of proper communication facilities, we can’t take any immediate action against this. To resolve this kind of problem we developed our project citizen protection service. This project aims to create a web and mobile application for citizens to report issues and incidents in their neighborhoods. Users of this project can choose a location on a map and submit a report instantly, which is then forwarded to the closest police station for immediate action. This system aims to improve communication between citizens and law enforcement to encourage more effective and efficient community problem-solving. For the project’s interactive user interface and to find the closest police station, technologies like app development frameworks and mapping API will be used. This makes it possible to respond faster and take better action to solve the issue. Additionally, citizens can keep of the status of their reports. Our main goal is to provide a user-friendly interface and real-time tracking features. A good tool that encourages citizens to take an active part in securing the security and well-being of their neighborhood is the Citizen Protection Service Application.

articleTitle: Design of an Ultrasonic Repeller to Protect Tea Gardens from Red Spider Mites
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The manuscript aims to design an ultrasonic pest repeller specifically targeting Red Spider Mites (RSM) in tea gardens, scientifically known as Tetranychus urticae. The repeller is used to utilize specific frequencies of ultrasonic sound waves to repel red spider mites. The circuit of the repeller is based on the 555 timer astable multivibrator that can generate rectangular pulses to create ultrasonic sound signals. A Second order LC low pass filter is used to convert rectangular wave to desired sinusoidal waveform which will be amplified and later on fed to multiple speakers. The speakers will be positioned in various locations in the tea garden in order to shield a sizable region from RSM. The suggested work has the potential to provide tea garden owners and farmers with an effective and sustainable solution for pest control. The proposed design has been implemented and a well agreement is observed with the predicted response as the circuit generates ultrasonic waves in the range between 30 and 50 kHz by using the oscilloscope probe.

articleTitle: Design and Analysis A High-Performance Parallel Decimal Multiplier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper presents a novel approach to addressing the demand for efficient decimal arithmetic units in critical applications such as tax calculation, accounting,banking, and currency conversion, with a specific focus on the multiplication operation. The proposed design methodology emphasizes power consumption analysis without compromising performance, decomposing a digit multiplier using techniques inspired by Karatsuba algorithms. The multiplicand and multiplier are partition into various sizes, including multi16-8, multi16-4, multi16-2, and multi16-8-4, and the traditional Ripple Carry Adder (RCA) is replaced with a more efficient Carry Increment Adder (CIA). The study evaluates the designed multipliers using Verilog HDL and the Xilinx ISE tool, analyzing delay, area, and power consumption. The results, based on 16-digit operands, highlight the effectiveness of approach in achieving a balance between computational performance and power efficiency in radix-10 arithmetic units.

articleTitle: SOBOT: Design And Development of UV Sterilization Ostensible Doctor Robot for Clinical Purposes Based on IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Pathogen-borne diseases are a major source of human illness and mortality. The risk of contracting infectious diseases exists in every hospital around the world and is a universal fact. Patients who have had surgery are currently affected by hospital infections. As a result, daily pre-operative is one of the finest infection control measures used to reduce the count of bacteria, dust, and organic material in the environment and food items. Furthermore, doctors often must work in emergency departments and hospitals. But no physician can be available all the time in every place. There is a rise in the number of elderly people who should be able to care for themselves but require close monitoring in an emergency. As a result, smart robots powered by IoT are becoming more popular for resolving these difficulties. Based on the Internet of Things, this study developed a Virtual Robot for sterilization and health monitoring to address these problems. This highly developed real-time health tracking robot can detect common health issues like temperature, heart rate, and blood pressure. These detected health parameters are transferred to doctors through an internet module. Also, this robot sanitizes the hospital premises, electronic widgets, veggies, and fruits given to patients with ultraviolet radiation.

articleTitle: Connecting Cities: IoST Innovation for Smarter Cities
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The Internet of Things (IoT) is becoming the next big thing in the history of the Internet. It is important to figure out what areas IoT can be used and what study problems these areas offer. IoT will be important in every part of human lives, from smart towns and healthcare to smart farming, smart living, smart shopping, and intelligent environments. Even though IoT-enabling technologies have come a long way in the past few years, many problems still need to be fixed. Turning a city into a "smart city" is very difficult, but it can be done with the help of technologies that enable the Internet of Smart Things (IoST). The Internet of Things (IoT) idea grew out of different types of end systems, so there will be many study problems to solve. This paper talks about how the growth of smart cities will be achieved by improving general infrastructure with the help of IoT and what problems this might cause.

articleTitle: Design and Implementation of Low-Cost Smart Monitoring System for Micro-Grid PV Applications Using LoRa Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In this paper, an innovative smart monitoring system has been developed with a low cost for micro-grid photovoltaic systems using LoRa technology. This research addresses traditional monitoring solutions' limitations and explores the advantages of using LoRa technology in micro-grid PV systems. The literature review comprehensively highlights all aspects of micro-grid PV systems and underscores the significance of monitoring for performance enhancement and troubleshooting. The methodology section discusses the proposed system architecture, sensor selection, data collection, LoRa communication use, and data visualization. In the results sections, a real-life view of the effectiveness of a low-cost smart metering system is illustrated concerning issues such as the accuracy of data, transmission range, and energy consumption rate. Examples from real life are used to illustrate how the system improves performance, simplifies maintenance tasks, and helps identify problems in micro-grid PV systems. This research provides insights into exploiting LoRa technology to realize low-cost but efficient smart monitoring solutions in renewable energy microgrids.

articleTitle: Artificial Intelligence Methods to Support People Management in Organizations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The research paper showcases in-depth research on AI technology and its direct impact on organizations and people. Along with this research paper also discussed how AI technology can support organizations in streamlining their business processes, improving their decision-making skills, enhancing staff engagement, and raising the rate of production with the help of machine learning and natural language processing. Besides this, it is examined in this paper that AI technology can also be applied to automate the entire screening method, shorten the timetable, and manage the available resources needed for new staff recruitment.

articleTitle: A Compact High Selective UWB Bandpass Filter using Interdigital Coupled–lines
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The design of an ultra-wideband (UWB) microstrip bandpass filter (BPF) with increased off-band performance is presented in this paper. The aim of using three-line capacitively loaded transmission line in the circuit is to shift the transmission zero (TZ) to high frequency, and thus suppressing a wide range of spurious frequency band. In addition, an appropriate tapering is done to the two outer lines of the three-line coupled system to compensate the group-delay in the passband produced due to the additional capacitive-ended open stubs. Designed UWB covers a frequency range of 5.38−13.76 GHz with excellent out-of-band performance. It demonstrates the upgraded off-band property, i.e., broadened upper side stopband with sharp rejection skirts outside the passband with a selectivity factor (SF) -0.93. The physical implementation area of this filter is 0.25x0.23λg<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>.

articleTitle: Performance Comparison of Machine Learning Techniques in Detection of Primary users for Cognitive Radio
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: With the help of cognitive radio technology, the users can utilize the idle resources of the system without affecting the ones licensed to use it. One of the most important factors that a cognitive radio network needs to consider is the spectrum's availability. This will allow it to effectively utilize the available spectrum and prevent channel interference. The objective of this technology is to enhance the efficiency of the users' spectrum usage. The authors utilized various machine learning techniques, such as Linear Discriminant Analysis (LDA), Logistic Regression (LR), K-Nearest Neighbours (KNN), Naive Bayes (NB), Classification and Regression Trees (CRT) and Support Vector Machines (SVM), to identify the primary users. The algorithms used for analyzing the results were evaluated according to the number of users who used the service, namely, 10, 100, 500, and 1000. The results indicated that the variations performed well for the users of 500 with a maximum mean accuracy of 85%.

articleTitle: Enhanced Transformerless Single-Phase Grid- Tied Inverter for Photovoltaic Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Currently, the solar sector requires transformerless based grid-tied inverters as a primary requirement due to their advantages over transformer based inverters. In order to enhance the inverter's performance, new topologies should be implemented to further improve THD. Additionally, there is a need to address the leakage current problem between solar panels and the grid. Two upgraded single-phase grid-tied transformerless inverter topologies for solar applications are shown in this research. We look into the inverter's performance as well as the impact of leakage current and common mode voltage. By means of simulation and Matlab/Simulink tools, the study of the suggested topologies is carried out.

articleTitle: Survey on Graphical Password Authentication Examining Methods, Safety Precautions, and Views from Users in Contemporary Systems
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: One of the biggest security issues in the current era of the internet's rapid growth and development is user authentication. It is the most important component of information, network, and cyber security. Passwords consisting of text are a common method of authentication. Graphical passwords are a promising substitute for alphanumeric passwords. Images are used in these passwords, which are simpler for people to remember than lengthy character sequences found in alphanumeric passwords. Users click on images rather than typing alphanumeric characters when using graphical passwords. In order to improve password security and usability, a number of graphical password schemes have been developed thus far. This paper aims to conduct a thorough analysis of the various graphical password strategies that have been proposed over time in this paper.

articleTitle: South Indian Sign languages Recognition and Classification using Deep Learning Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Sign language is an interactive language with complex and unique linguistic rules that depends on eyesight. It is mostly utilized by those who find it difficult to communicate or to express their feelings, ideas, and thoughts through different body parts. Conventional approaches to gesture and sign detection suffer from issues with lighting sensitivity and poor performance in congested contexts. Thanks to developments in computer vision and pattern recognition, people with disabilities now have a great opportunity to enhance their quality of life. A crucial consideration in developing an automated system for individuals who primarily converse with SISL is the incorporation of both single- and double-handed gestures. Images of single-handed motions were divided into 35 categories using pre-trained CNN models, such as Inception-V3, ResNet-50, and VGG-16, whereas photos of double-handed gestures were divided into 10. The CNN models are tweaked to improve classification performance while taking into account the quantity of picture classes. The Inception-V3 model fared better in the classification test than the other two CNN models, with a standard classification accuracy of 93.45% for single-hand SISL and 88.45% for double-hand south Indian sign languages. Excellent results were obtained from all of the examined CNN models.

articleTitle: A Review on Low Complexity Deep Learning Based Techniques for Acoustic Scene Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: For the past few years, research in audio related technology has changed the focus to Acoustic Scene analysis using Deep Learning Techniques. The major task in Acoustic Scene analysis is to classify the recorded sound based on the labels used for training the network. Some examples of acoustic scenes include the market, beach, traffic, office, classroom etc. Acoustic Scene Analysis (ASA) or Acoustic Scene Classification (ASC) is the term used for the classification of sound based on the aforementioned situations. Detection and Classification of Acoustic Scenes and Events (DCASE) focus on this ASC by conducting the competition, which was started in the year 2013. So far, every competition has included one or more ASC challenges. In this work, historical overview of earlier studies was provided in the field of ASC before defining a generic framework for ASC. With an emphasis on low complexity deep learning, this article discusses and classifies popular techniques for data preparation, such as feature representations, feature pre-processing, data augmentation, and network architectures for ASC.

Author Keywords: Detection and Classification of Acoustic Scenes and Events

articleTitle: Optimal Five phase Voltage Source design with single DC link
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: There is no end to find truth in our daily. Even in some case, the truth is also undefined. In restructured power systems, many technologies are coming to prove truth. This paper presents analysis and design of single source of DC that can feed two machines which can operate independently. Here power electronic concepts are employed. When number of phases is increased, the solution for driving the machines also changed. In this paper, the stator windings are five phase windings. Here the machines are feed with electric current controlled electric potential DC-AC converter. In order to get independent in controlled performance, it is required to link the stator coils i.e. five phase of two asynchronous machines in series. Here the concept of transposition is also employed. This concept can be applicable to any five phase rotating electrical to mechanical or mechanical to electrical machines. Generally to do this kind, we need six inverters points. But here it is employed with five only. The simulation results are given for new five phase two asymmetrical motor drive in speed and torque mode. The same concept can also employed for higher number of phases in easy way.

Author Keywords: two machines operated independently with single source
Power electronics control of drives applications

articleTitle: Classification of Fraud Websites using Linear regression Algorithm and Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm with Improved Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The purpose of this work is to improve the detection of fraud websites using Novel Linear Regression Algorithm and Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm. Materials and Methods: Novel Linear regression Algorithm and Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm is executed with varying training and testing splits for predicting the detection of fraud websites. This research utilizes Novel Linear regression Algorithm and Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm with various grounding categories to predict the detection of extremist reviews. The data set in this article utilizes kaggle website data csv file repositories and number of samples (N=11053) The Gpower test used is about 85% (g power setting parameters: α=0.05 and power=0.85). Results: Novel Linear regression Algorithm (98.15%) has the increased accuracy over Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm (97.22%) with an independent samples-t-test significance value of p=0.01 (p<0.05) and there exists a statistical significant difference between the two algorithms. Conclusion: When compared to Recurrent Neural Network Algorithm accuracy, Novel Linear regression Algorithm has higher accuracy.

articleTitle: Implementation and Performance Evaluation of Improved Hybrid Deep Learning Approach for Anomaly Detection and Classification in Lung CT Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The goal of this study is to create and test improved enhanced deep learning approaches for anomaly detection and classification in CT images, specifically lung cancer images. The Improved Enhanced Hybrid DL method for detecting lung cancer is presented in the study. It focuses on the detection of lung cancer. The pre-processing steps include histogram equalization, Otsu thresholding, Sobel filtering, and the DOST scheme. The Grey Level Co-occurrence Matrix (GLCM) is then used to prepare the image for morphological feature extraction. The Improved CNN with ranking features is used to analyze the extracted features and trained data, yielding a 98.9% accuracy in identifying lung cancer-affected regions. The MATLAB tool is used throughout, and the proposed models are tested using the Kaggle database of brain and lung images. The findings indicate that the enhanced deep learning approaches are effective at detecting and classifying lung cancer regions in CT images.

articleTitle: Revolutionizing 6G Networks: Large Intelligent Surfaces and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: With the introduction of 6G networks, wireless communication is expected to undergo a paradigm change that will require creative solutions to meet the ever increasing needs for connection, data speeds, and energy efficiency. In the context of 6G networks, this study investigates the revolutionary effects of combining Large Intelligent Surfaces (LIS) and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access (NOMA). Large Intelligent Surfaces are used to improve wireless communication through the optimization of signal propagation, mitigation of interference, and improvement of overall network performance. These surfaces are composed of reflecting elements and smart materials. Meanwhile, simultaneous connections and transmissions are made possible by non-orthogonal multiple access techniques, which greatly increase spectrum efficiency. In order to provide light on the individual and combined contributions of Large Intelligent Surfaces and Non-Orthogonal Multiple Access to the next generation of wireless networks, this article examines the synergistic impacts of their combination. By means of analytical models and simulations,We show that significant improvements in energy efficiency, coverage, and spectrum efficiency are possible. In an era of unparalleled connection demands, the suggested paradigm promises to transform the architecture and functionality of 6G networks and open up new avenues for ultra-reliable, low-latency communication.

articleTitle: Advancements in Remote Sensing: A Comprehensive Analysis of Change Detection Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study presents a study of various change detection methods and techniques for remote sensing applications. The use of change detection techniques allows us to monitor various effects of changes that are occurring in the geosystems due to human or manmade effects. Change detection technique techniques include traditional pixel-based change detection and object-based change detection. With the advancement in artificial intelligence (AI), various other techniques have emerged that provide information about land-use land cover changes. This study provides a piece of brief information on the various methods, techniques, and procedures involved in detecting various changes occurring in the land landcover. Besides various mathematical expressions are also presented for various methods used for change detection purposes.

articleTitle: Examining the Effect of Fault Impedance on the Power System in the Event of Unbalanced Faults
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: A fault is the equivalent of a structural network change broughtby an increase of impedance at the fault location. If the defect impedance is zero, it is referred to as a solid or fixed fault. The power flow solution's results are used to determine the pre-fault bus voltages. From the perspective of the faulted bus, the flawed network is reduced to a circuit that is equivalent to a Thevenin. Thevenin's theorem is applied to obtain changes in the bus voltages. The pre-failed bus voltages and the change in bus voltages are superposed to obtain the bus voltages during the problem. To evaluate the bus voltages under asymmetrical fault scenarios, such as line-to-line, line-to-ground, and double line-to-ground faults with varying impedance values, a conventional 11-bus system is taken into consideration. MATLAB is employed in simulation-related tasks.

articleTitle: Power quality improvement with D-STATCOM using combined LCL-comb filter and optimized PI tuned class topper algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Class Topper Optimized Proportional Integral (CTO-PI) and Synchronous Reference Frame (SRF) based Power Quality (PQ) Improvement has been proposed in this novel. The proposed system enables Distribution Synchronous Static Compensator (D-STATCOM) to provide a variety of additional services, such as reduction of voltage flickers, elimination of harmonics, load balancing, voltage sag, and impulsive and oscillatory transients. Additionally, it actively feeds electricity into the utility grid. D-STATCOM captures the fundamental inphase and quadrature components of current exactly because it uses CTO-PI to function. By introducing high-gain at the third order harmonic, it reduces stationary errors in the 3 ϕ inverter's current control loop. In order to effectively mitigate harmonics in the source current, the proposed LCLComb filter reduces the current harmonics Using SRF, it ensures quick power balance between the inverter unit and the electric grid. For a variety of load types, DSTATCOM's performance is determined to be satisfactory when using the proposed control algorithm. The proposed approach is validated through simulation using MATLAB Simulink software.

articleTitle: A Machine Learning Strategy with Hardware Implementation for Harvesting in Floriculture
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In human daily life after fulfillment of basic needs of flowers and fragrances has been an essential aspect. Floriculture has become one of the attractive and prospective horticulture sec- tors for business and recreation. This demand of floriculture is all over the globe, but particularly in India due to diversified culture floriculturists’ have excellent scope. Developments in Smart or Precision Agriculture (PA) efficient harvest of crops is possible with high yields. This work is focused to reduce the floriculture related problems like human labour, time consumption, ageing of flowers etc and to provide smart solution. A prototype of an autonomous flower cutting robot has been developed and implemented that will reduce the process time and increase the productivity. A smart solution towards the floriculture harvesting using deep learning approach and image processing is proposed. Results in terms of system design and implementation with functional verification has been presented.

articleTitle: Improve the Sustainability of City Transportation Network using Adaptive Public Transport System & Multi-layer Infrastructure
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The need for effective traffic management in rapidly growing metropolitan centers is a pressing issue. The swift augmentation of automobiles on the road in large cities is a serious worry in today’s fast-paced world leading to an overabundance of traffic on the roads. Recently Bengaluru which is ranked the second most congested city in the world experienced one of its worst evenings on September 27, 2023, as vehicles all over the city stood paralyzed amidst extremely heavy traffic. To address congestion in a city like Bengaluru, authorities need to consider implementing effective urban planning strategies, improving public transportation systems, and promoting sustainable modes of transportation. In this paper, we present study of novel framework designed for an intelligent traffic management system, leveraging cutting-edge technologies. The framework is tailored to enhance traditional traffic management systems by integrating these advanced technologies, addressing the challenges associated with traffic management more efficiently. We will present our proposed method which can greatly lessen traffic congestion. The suggested solution discusses the necessity for multi-layer urban transit, adaptive public transport along with messaging dashboards that provide real-time traffic information to surpass the current system.

articleTitle: Application-Specific System-On-Chip Design for Advanced Encryption Standard Cryptography Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper concentrates on the development of System-On-Chip for the Advanced Encryption Standard algorithm. This method includes the transformation of plaintext into cipher text and consists of 4 sub-tasks based on the resolution. In this work, the 128-bit resolution is utilized to perform 10 rounds of transformation with the round key added at every round generated by the key expansion algorithm. Though there are many cryptography algorithms, the AES is simple, secure, faster in operation, and easy to develop compared to the others. The SOC design for the encryption of the AES depends on the synthesizable HDL code development for all 10 rounds of processes with the key expansion algorithm. The LUTs are used for the S-box in the HDL code. The proposed SOC is designed using the Cadence EDA tools by making use of the synthesized HDL code for the proposed methods and analyzed for the VLSI parameters

articleTitle: Fuzzy Logic Based Symmetrical Three Phase Five Level Inverter for Shunt Active Power Filter in Power Quality Improvement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Shunt active filters are the most widely used option for power quality management. A standard three-level, three-phase inverter and a dc link capacitor are the two main components of a shunt active power filter (SAPF), which helps to improve power quality by introducing harmonic-compensating current into the system and removing current distortions brought on by a large non-linear load. But they also have certain disadvantages, such as excessive strain on power switches, issues with the stability of the DC bus voltage, and so forth. Certain of these issues are resolved with the aid of the suggested methodology. An HB inverter with five levels that is created by cascading two three-phase inverters takes the place of the traditional inverter circuit in this topology. Using a shunt active filter is primarily intended to keep the source current sinusoidal regardless of the load that is connected, particularly non-linear loads that result in non-sinusoidal current and Power Quality (PQ) issues. In order to achieve this, the SAPF injects a harmonic elimination current that is in phase opposition to the harmonic current. In order to accomplish this, a Pulse Width Modulation (PWM) control method based on proportional integration (PI) and fuzzy logic controllers (FLC) is developed. To maintain the most recent version of the data, this project uses MATLAB 2021a, and its control parameters are determined by the reference current generated by an algorithm.

articleTitle: A Single DC-source Asymmetrical Multilevel Inverter With Solid State Transformer With New Switching Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Cascaded H-bridge (CHB) MLI have emerged as the preferred choice due to their high quality in output waveforms with low harmonic distortion. However, a key limitation in these inverters lies in the requirement of a dedicated DC source for each bridge. To overcome this challenge, there is a transition towards asymmetrical cascaded H-bridge (ACHB) MLIs, enabling the use of a variable DC source for each bridge. The variability in DC supply is achieved through a high-frequency link. This paper introduces a novel optimized switching technique for asymmetrical cascaded H-bridge (ACHB) MLIs with a single DC input incorporating a high-frequency link (HFL). The effectiveness of the suggested approach in achieving a 27-level asymmetric multilevel inverter is substantiated by experimental outcomes obtained through MATLAB/Simulink simulations.

articleTitle: Embedded Patch Dielectric Resonator Antenna for Ku and K Band Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The antenna focuses on achieving wideband performance in the antenna designed by utilizing the combination of dielectric resonator and an ‘V’ shaped embedded patch. By incorporating a dielectric resonator and an ‘V’ shaped embedded patch, the antenna's bandwidth is extensively enhanced, leading to improved overall performance. A suitable dielectric material is chosen, considering its permittivity and loss tangent to optimize the antenna's bandwidth. Additionally, a ‘V’ shaped embedded patch structure is integrated into the design to further enhance the antenna's performance. The antenna consisting of strip line feed is merged with the ‘V’ shaped patch embedded in between the two substrates. The antenna design is modelled and simulated to analyze key characteristics like the impedance matching, radiation pattern, and gain. The simulations enable the fine-tuning of a dielectric resonator and ‘V’ shaped embedded patch parameters, ensuring wideband operation and optimal performance. The impedance bandwidth of the antenna ranging from 15.6Ghz to 21.98Ghz has thus been partially covering the Ku band (12-18Ghz) and the K band (18- 27Ghz). The antenna proves to have a good VSWR, efficiency and gain over the given range.

articleTitle: Precision Agriculture using Hybrid I-SVM and K-means Clustering to Improve Soil Fertility Level Prediction Accuracy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Global demand for agricultural products will increase due to population expansion. Agriculture plays a major part in the financial system. Precision farming, often known as digital agriculture, and agriculture technology have emerged as new fields of study that use data-centric methods to increase production. The data generated by various sensors in today's agricultural operations allows for a better understanding of both the operation and the surrounding environment. The main goal of this research is to improve agricultural technologies. The yield of crops is predicted with the help of K-means clustering algorithm and Improved Support Vector Machine which includes analysis of the fertility level of soil. Based on previously archived yield data that was obtained from that region, a projection was created. The systems analyze the data, and using pattern mining based on many characteristics, they forecast the crop production. Using data mining techniques, rules are formed for training data classification, and test data predictions are put into practice. To enhance soil fertility level prediction accuracy through the integration of a Hybrid I-SVM (Incremental Support Vector Machine) and K-means Clustering approach which demonstrates exceptional performance, achieving an impressive accuracy rate of 97.7%. This research contributes valuable insights to precision agriculture, offering an advanced tool for accurate soil fertility assessment, crucial for optimizing crop management and agricultural productivity. The outcomes also demonstrate that the model accurately forecasts the phenomena and chooses the appropriate yield class.

articleTitle: Integrating IoT, Computational Analysis, and Genetic Insights for Improved Accessibility and Early Intervention
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The accessibility of lung cancer detection, diagnosis, and treatment for the general public has emerged as a notable obstacle. The emergence of the Internet of Things (IoT) in healthcare offers a promising prospect, especially for the millions residing in distant regions. Nevertheless, conventional approaches in the medical domain, such as computational image technology and clinical analysis, continue to be essential. This research presents a paradigm that combines IoT with analytical and clinical evaluation to tackle this problem. The computational portion employs mathematical morphological image processing techniques to detect afflicted regions, whereas clinical investigation entails genetic analysis of obtained samples. The approach consists of two vital components for patients and doctors, requiring frequent interchange of important information between them. The objective of this research is to improve the effectiveness of current healthcare processes in rural regions.

articleTitle: An Open Access Chest Datasets for Computer– Aided Screening of Chest Diseases
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The human lung is a highly susceptible internal organ that becomes infected due to continuous exposure to airborne particles, chemicals, and infectious organisms. This leads to the most dangerous respiratory diseases occurring, which are the primary causes of disability and death worldwide. Medical imaging methods, such as nuclear medicine techniques, pulmonary and bronchial angiography, computed tomography, magnetic resonance imaging, ultrasonography, and chest radiography, can identify these respiratory diseases. Every day, a vast number of chest reports are generated, containing extensive anatomical and potentially pathological information. However, radiologists and doctors have found that manually identifying and categorizing chest abnormalities is a tedious and time-consuming task. Moreover, interpreting these images often demands highly skilled radiologists, as differentiating between various abnormal conditions of the chest can be challenging. To address this issue and provide a valuable solution, artificial intelligence, and deep learning-based algorithms have demonstrated remarkable performance in object detection and image segmentation. By leveraging these advanced technologies, the process of identifying and classifying chest abnormalities can be streamlined, allowing for faster and more accurate diagnoses. This can significantly improve patient care, reduce the burden on medical professionals, and ultimately enhance the overall effectiveness of medical imaging analysis. This article provides detailed information about the frequently used online available dataset for respiratory pathologies detection e.g. COVID-19, Pneumonia, Edema, Cardiomegaly, Pneumothorax, Lung nodules, and Tuberculosis. This analysis will definitely help researchers to find the online available authentic chest datasets without difficulty for future research.

articleTitle: Extreme Learning Machine for Breast Cancer Diagnosis using cloud computing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Worldwide, breast cancer ranks high among women's leading causes of mortality. The likelihood of mortality from breast cancer can be decreased with early detection and rapid treatment. Among those residing in rural regions with limited access to healthcare, machine learning on the cloud is currently playing a crucial role in illness diagnosis. Machine learning-based diagnostic systems can supplement radiologists' work as secondary readers to ensure accurate illness diagnosis, while cloud-based systems can facilitate remote diagnostics and telehealth services. The potential of artificial neural networks (ANN)-based techniques for illness diagnosis has piqued the interest of numerous academics. Among the many ANN versions, extreme learning machine (ELM) stands out as a promising candidate for tackling a wide range of classification issues. Three distinct areas of study are brought together in the suggested framework of this work: The first area where ELM is used is in the detection of breast-cancer. Next, the gain-ratio feature selection strategy is utilized to remove features that are not significant. Finally, this research offers an ELM-based CC-approach for remote breast-cancer diagnostics. Several cutting-edge technologies for illness diagnosis are contrasted with the cloud-based ELM's performance. The outcomes obtained on the Wisconsin-Diagnostic-Breast-Cancer(WBCD) dataset demonstrate that the ELM technique hosted in the cloud surpasses alternative approaches. When comparing ELM's performance in both the standalone and cloud contexts, the former proved to be superior.

articleTitle: Improving the Total Operating Cost of IEEE 69 Bus System Using Fuzzy Lighting Search Algorithm Compared with Firefly Algorithm by Mitigating the Real Power Loss
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This novel research proposes a comparative analysis of two algorithms named a novel Fuzzy Lighting Search Algorithm (FLSA) and a Firefly Algorithm (FA) for improving the total operating cost in the radial distribution network by optimal allocation of a DSTATCOM and mitigating the real power loss. Novel Fuzzy Lighting Search Algorithm and Firefly Algorithm (FA) are utilized for optimal location and sizing of DSTATCOM in the radial distribution system. The sample size is calculated using Gpower software for two groups and there are 14 samples used in this work. The G power is taken as 0.8. Based on the results obtained FLSA produces better results than FA in terms of total operating cost reduction. The independent sample t test value obtained is 0.003 (p<0.05) which is significant. FLSA-based optimization method provides significantly better total operating cost reduction ($ 9023.3086) than FA-based method ($ 9864.6600).

articleTitle: Matrix theory based stability analysis of a power system
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper outlines a detailed approach to assessing system stability using Eigenvalue analysis, emphasizing the calculation of Eigenvalues and Eigenvectors. The process entails deriving the Jacobian matrix using the Newton-Raphson method for Power Flow analysis. The project concludes with a discussion on the potential advantages of employing Eigen value analysis for stability assessment in power systems.The standard 5-Bussystem is considered to analyze the proposed methodology. MATLAB software is employed for simulation purpose.

articleTitle: Empowering with Curing Drugs in Diabetes Using Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Diabetes is a disease that impacts more number of the citizens in the India. India has the position of second- largest country with diabetic population. According to an estimate, over 74 million of Indians were Identified with diabetes in 2021. It is possible to treat diabetes by providing a drug that will cure the disease. Drug testing is first and foremost essential to avoiding diabetes. Machine Learning plays a crucial part in health care domain by predicting the values based on the previous data. Machine learning algorithms helps for diabetic drug testing which will be helpful for the doctors and providing the suitable drugs for the patients from curing of the diabetes based on hospital readmission. The algorithms used are the Random Forest, Logistic Regression, Decision tree. Compared the accuracy and recall, precision, f-score for all three algorithms. The Electronic health records of the patients need to be collected. This will helpful for the patients from the curing of the diabetes by providing the suitable drugs.

articleTitle: Comparitive Analysis Of Deep Learning Techniques For Prediction of Complex Skin Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Skin cancer is a crucial and dangerous disease It is the disease where detection is become too hard. Finding the disease in early stages is difficult task and one can find it in early stages by using the images. Images helps in classifying which type of cancer it is. Choosing a dataset is very important because the accuracy is depended on the type of dataset (Benign and malignant) which authors have chosen. From many researches the more defected images have better results and good records. Select the deep learning techniques which are going to be implemented. The techniques Vgg-19 and Inception are the models which authors are implementing to Train the models and acquire the accuracies for Vgg-19 85.32% and for inception 98.25% Now plot the graphs and see the data loss and complete the model evaluation. Finally compare the to models choose the highest accuracy acquired model check the obtained and predicted results are same or not. From both model authors got inception as highest accuracy So, inception is the best technique.

articleTitle: Bi-Directional Power Flow Control for Three Phase Grid Tied Converters in Ev Charging Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The expenses associated with conventional energy have increased dramatically in recent times due to factors such as climate change, environmental degradation, and the depletion of fossil resources. Thus, there is an urgent global need to use clean, innovative energy. Worldwide, there is widespread usage of electric cars (EVs) with smart grid technologies. More and more attention has been directed into the Vehicle-to-Grid (V2G) system. The Bi-directional grid-connected AC/DC converter, which enables bilateral power transfer while satisfying grid power quality criteria, is an essential component of the V2G hybrid system. A Bi-directional Power flow control for three phase grid tied converter is presented in this study. It can offer bidirectional power transfer between EVs and the grid in addition to correcting reactive power and lowering power grid volatility. Introducing the V2G system setup and creating the mathematical model for the AC/DC converter are the first tasks. The next step is to propose an analysis of the PI control method and build a controller. D-Q-0 theory finds use in efficiently synchronising the grid and controlling ripple current in the grid current. The basis for the system simulation model is MATLAB/Simulink.

articleTitle: An Innovative Analysis to Improve the Performance by Blocking the Pop-ups of Web Applications with XGBoost Algorithm over K-Means Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The focus of the research is to utilise the XGBoost algorithm in comparison to the K-Means algorithm is to prevent pop-up windows from showing up on a web application. The K-Means Algorithm and the XGBoost Algorithm are two examples of two groups that are used. The sample size for each group is 10, and the significant value of the data set is predicted using SPSS values with an 80% G-power. Their accuracy levels are determined and contrasted using various sample data sizes. Different sample data sizes are used to achieve and compare each accuracy. The difference between these groups has a significance value of 0.001, which is less than 0.05 (p<0.05), indicating that there are statistically significant differences between them. XGBoost Algorithm with mean accuracy of 71.70% and standard deviation is 1.16, K-Means has a mean accuracy of 82.60% and standard deviation is 1.07. When compared to the XGBoost Algorithm, the suggested K-Means algorithm offers greater accuracy.

articleTitle: Intelligent Renewable Energy Forecasting: A Comparative Study of Machine Learning Techniques for Smart Grid Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: With rising energy demand and diminishing supplies of conventional fuels, the significance of renewable sources of power, like wind power has grown. The unpredictability of wind energy output conversely, provides a hurdle. To anticipate wind energy output, this study employs sophisticated machine learning approaches. Support Vector Machine (SVM), Lasso Regression (LR), and the Gradient Boosting Machine (GBM) are among the models used and contrasted. The results emphasize Support Vector Machine's better performance, suggesting the potential for precise forecasts. This study sets the route for Future Studies to Enhance green energy forecasting models, resulting in the construction of more dependable energy systems. Finally, this work is important for generating sustainable energy consumption and fostering a more environmentally friendly future.

Index Terms: Least Absolute Shrinkage And Selection Operator

articleTitle: Cipher - Intelligent Surveillance System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study introduces an Intelligent Surveillance System specifically developed for the purpose of generating captions for images in real-time. The system makes use of sophisticated computer vision and natural language processing methods. The ResNet-101 pre-trained model is used to extract high-level features through a two-step picture encoding method. The caption generation model utilizes LSTM and incorporates an attention mechanism to dynamically prioritize relevant image regions while generating text. Integrating Beam Search improves the quality and variety of captions. This solution greatly improves the understanding of security specialists and analysts by automating the analysis of visual data and providing detailed written explanations. The system's proficiency in producing precise, contextually suitable, and eloquent captions has been proven through meticulous assessments on a wide range of datasets. The results highlight the effectiveness of the system and connecting the fields of computer vision and natural language processing in the area of intelligent surveillance.

articleTitle: A Proposal for Wireless Fetal Monitoring System-Integrating Gyroscopic Positioning and ECG Connectivity
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Fetal monitoring is paramount in ensuring the well-being of both mothers and unborn children during pregnancy. It introduces an innovative and upgraded fetal monitoring device that integrates multiple technologies to provide a comprehensive assessment of maternal and fetal health parameters. The device employs advanced sensors, including a MEMS gyroscope, to precisely measure the position of the fetus in relation to the mother's body. This spatial tracking capability offers a novel dimension to fetal monitoring, enhancing the understanding of fetal movements and positioning. Additionally, the device incorporates electrocardiography (ECG) sensors to monitor both maternal and fetal heartbeats, offering a holistic view of cardiovascular health. The collected data is transmitted in real-time through Bluetooth connectivity to a dedicated smartphone application, leveraging Internet of Things (IoT) capabilities. This enables seamless remote monitoring, empowering healthcare professionals with instant access to critical information for timely decision-making. The user-friendly interface on the mobile application provides a comprehensive display of fetal heart rate, maternal heart rate, and fetal position, enhancing the overall monitoring experience for both medical practitioners and expectant mothers. Ensuring the privacy and security of sensitive medical data, the system implements robust encryption protocols. This modified fetal monitoring device represents a significant stride in prenatal care technology, offering an integrated solution for heartbeat monitoring, spatial tracking, and IoT connectivity.

articleTitle: Design And Development of Deep Learning Model of Chaotic Signal Processing for Efficient Data Encryption
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This project explores the chaotic generation of signals and the encryption and decryption of these signals using a deep learning model. The signal generation involves the use of two map generators: the Chebyshev map generator and the Logistic map generator. The proposed deep learning model can be used to develop new and improved chaotic signal modulation and demodulation schemes for secure and robust data encryption in a variety of applications, such as communication, financial transactions, and military communications. The synchronization of chaotic sequences is necessary for coherent Chaos Shift Keying (CSK) schemes, yet it is still nearly impossible in disruptive environments. In order to overcome this limitation, an LSTM based receiver is utilized for online modulated signal classification after being trained offline via chaotic maps across a limited number of channel realizations.

articleTitle: Power Optimization in TSPC D Flip-Flop Based Counters
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Power optimization in a 4-bit counter is an important area of research that aims to reduce the power consumption of digital circuits while maintaining their performance and functionality. This study evaluates three different D flip-flop implementations at 45nm technology: conventional TSPC, sleeping transistors technique, and modified TSPC. A synchronous 4-bit counter was designed using flip-flops to demonstrate their performance. Comparative analysis revealed that the modified TSPC D flip-flop-based 4-bit counter outperformed both the conventional TSPC and sleeping transistors-based counters in terms of power efficiency. This indicates that the modified TSPC design is the most energy-efficient option among the three, making it a promising choice for low-power applications in 45nm technology.

articleTitle: Style Transfer Using Generative Adversarial Networks for Brain MRI Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Using a specific Generative Adversarial Model known as CycleGAN, the purpose of this research is to provide a method for the generation of synthetic MRI (Magnetic Resonance Imaging) images. Using a GAN, this model will assist us in the creation of a Super resolution picture of an MRI. This will be accomplished by changing and balancing the contract for the original MRI image, which will ensure that the medical industry operates at a high level of efficiency. Increasing the quality of the original MRI scans is the key objective, which will be accomplished by the effective representation of MRI scans by GANs.

articleTitle: Enhanced Fake News Detection using Prediction Algorithms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The advent of web-based media has provided a platform for individuals to express their opinions freely, facilitating easier communication compared to the past. This convenience comes with the risk of deliberate dissemination of misinformation. The ready access to a plethora of online information sources exacerbates the problem, as people may be exposed to and potentially believes false information. It is crucial for us to be aware of and flag such content on social media platforms. Given the rapid generation of information through online media, distinguishing between authentic news and fabrications is challenging without knowing the news source. The spread of fake news can have serious consequences, emphasizing the need for measures to reduce and differentiate between genuine and false messages. Term Frequency measures how often a word appears in a document, indicating its relevance. Inverse Document Frequency assesses the significance of a term in the entire corpus, helping filter out irrelevant words. An examination of spam detection is conducted by employing diverse classifiers, including BERT and RoBERTa to evaluate accuracy and furnish comparative findings.

articleTitle: OLBR: Optimization of Location-Based Routing Protocols in Vehicular Ad Hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The proposed work employs ns-3, SUMO, and NetAnim to create geographical routing in vehicular ad hoc networks (VANETs). The research attempts to assess the performance of three well-known protocols AODV, DSDV, and OLSR in VANET settings. Utilizing SUMO’s realistic mobility models and NS3’s simulation capabilities, the project simulates node communication, protocol behaviour, and vehicle movement. The main purpose is to know how well various routing techniques work in dynamic vehicular situations.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Accuracy of the Long Short Term Memory- Convolutional Neural Networks to detect early stages of Postpartum Depression among new mothers and Comparison with Support Vector Machine Classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The purpose of this research is to improve the accuracy of prediction of postpartum depression in women using Novel Long-Short Term Memory with Convolutional Neural Networks (LSTM-CNN) and comparing it with the Support Vector Machine(SVM) algorithm. In this study, the prediction of postpartum depression was performed using the Novel Long-Short Term Memory with Convolutional Neural Networks (LSTM-CNN) and for comparison Support Vector Machine(SVM) Algorithm was used, each with a sample size of 20 to achieve the desired level of precision and accuracy. The results of the study are displayed in the following table (LSTM-CNN). The mean accuracy of the LSTM -CNN is 77.25% and the Support Vector Machine (SVM) is 72.36%, respectively. The Independent sample t-test has a significance value p=0.04(p<0.05) indicating the study between the LSTM-CNN model and the Support Vector Machine algorithm is statistically significant. Overall, deep learning algorithms have shown promise in predicting Postpartum depression among Women and the LSTM-CNN method achieved a higher accuracy when compared to the Support Vector Machine algorithm.

Author Keywords: Novel Long-Short Term Memory with Convolutional Neural Networks

articleTitle: MOSFET-Driven Passive Cell Balancing: A Low-Cost Approach to EV Battery Longevity and Performance Enhancement
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: To ensure that LiFePO4 batteries on electric vehicles operate safely and dependably, cell balancing is essential for prolonging battery life and safeguarding battery cells. BMS frequently employs passive cell balancing due to its low cost and ease of implementation. Resistors are employed as the balancing element in the passive cell balancing process to get rid of extra charge in the battery. Resistors are required when employing large-capacity batteries, although they are ineffective when utilized with small cells. Effective cell balancing is made possible by the internal resistance of MOSFETs, which is used as a balancing element.Additionally, the temperature is kept at its nominal level, reducing the risk of temperature-related battery damage. The intrinsic resistance of the MOSFET eliminates the need for additional balancing components. By reducing the current through the resistance, power losses are minimized and heat dissipation is also limited. This keeps the battery pack temperature within the nominal range and lessens the risk of temperature-related battery damage.

articleTitle: Design of 25-level Ye-Progression Ladder Inverter using Cross-compiling
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This works presents the generation of AC output using the Ye-Progression based Ladder Inverter for 25-level. The Ladder inverter switches are controlled by the event angle manipulated Pulse Width Modulation signals. Conventionally, the pulse width modulation signals are generated using the overlapping of high frequency carrier wave on the modulating signal. In this method, the event manipulations for the Pulse Width Modulated Signals are digitally evaluated using the Half Height formulation method. The topology utilized for the evaluation is Ye-Progression Ladder Multi-Level Inverter circuit. The control switches for the presented Ye-Progression Ladder based Inverter are driven by the manipulated event angles based Digitized PWM signals for 25 level Ladder Inverter. The VHDL code for the driving DPWM signals are developed in the behavioral style and cross-compiled using the MATLAB Simulink Xilinx block-set tools. The performance analysis for the presented method is validated by using Xilinx Artix 7 FPGA and evaluation for the parameters such as %THD, VPEAK, and VRMS. Also, the IC layout for the generated VHDL based switch control of the proposed Ye Progression Ladder Inverter is designed using the Cadence Tool and analyzed for area, power and delay.

articleTitle: DNN Based Indoor Localization with SGD Optimizer for heterogeneous Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Now a days, localization is a vital perspective in the field of WSN that have been established interest in the bottom line. Recently node localization has been one of the challenging research areas in sensor networks connected with wireless channel. Nevertheless, major localization algorithms focus on GPS based location finding which does not fit for some ubiquitous applications such as health care, elder monitoring, human life detection and so on. The major objective is to design an optimal localization strategy to improve localization precision and further to improve longevity of battery life for nodes of the network.This workproposes Deep neural network based wireless indoor positioning, based on the input samples of RSSI values. As the wireless signals are unpredictable and widely variant, the position estimation plays a crucial role in Wireless Sensor Network (WSN) communication. To deal with this, Deep neural network is pre-trained usingUJindoorloc dataset which is efficient in learning reliable features from a large set of noisy samples and avoids hand-engineering. This research paper compares the localization prediction accuracy with four different cases of Neural Network experimentation such as; Single Node Neural network (NN), Few number of nodes with one hidden layer, More nodes with many hidden layers and lastly, Manual configuration of nodes. It is very much evident that in proposed DNNmore number of hidden layers demonstrates high accuracy and lesser loss in comparison with non-intelligent systems.

articleTitle: E-Sangrahan: A Sustainable Paradigm and comprehensive framework for efficient E-Waste Management towards a Greener Future
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: According to experts, E-Waste is one of the most dangerous environmental concern India is facing. According to ASSOCHAM an industrial body predicts that by 2020, India will generate 5.2 million tons of E-Waste. E-waste stands for Electronic waste that has been discarded. Computers, monitors, and other electronic appliances contain electronic items harmful to nature if not recycled properly. E-waste plays a major role in polluting soil, and air which is caused due to irregular ways of disposing of E-Waste. There are many governments driven initiatives for E-Waste management, but the awareness and the significance of W-Waste management is still not reached to the larger community. The proposed work - E-Sangrahan is an effort to tackle the problems faced while dealing with E-Waste. A web application is developed to handle the E-Waste management process in a much ease and user-friendly way. E-Sangrahan is the future of recycling E-Waste, which helps create a sustainable future. E-Sangrahan offers a dynamic website that is simple to use and everybody can access. The website includes a live user-friendly E-Waste warehouse locator, that helps dispose of E-Waste by yourself. The locator even tells you about the directions to be taken and how to get there by road. The novelty or uniqueness of E-Sangrahan is the fact that the website also consists of a machine learning model that helps people to identify the type of E-Waste it belongs to. The objective of this machine learning model is to remove the confusion between E-Waste items and non-E-Waste items because if any E-Waste item is not recycled, the environmental impact is large. E-Sangrahan would be the next revolution in the theme of E-Waste.

articleTitle: Bridgeless Landsman Converter with Hybrid Control Technique for Power Factor Correction in EV Application
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Electric vehicles (EVs) have emerged to stabilize the transportation sector and move it towards a greener side due to the need for efficient fuel. The power electronics circuits responsible for regulating the voltage during charging of the BES (Battery Energy Storage) must be sufficiently efficient in order to preserve the input power quality (PQ). Conventional electric vehicle (EV) battery chargers typically draw power from an AC source and deliver a highly distorted current through the AC mains. This type of charging relies on the AC mains to provide a significantly distorted current. As a consequence, the conventional system encounters an increase in losses, resulting in several power quality (PQ) metrics, such as input power factor (PF), exhibiting very low values. To address power factor correction, this study introduces a Hybrid Controller Based Bridgeless Landsman converter. The DC voltage generated by the converter is regulated by artificial neural network-based proportional integral (ANN/PI) controllers. By connecting the hysteresis controller to a pulse width modulation (PWM) generator, it identifies and produces accurate output. The effectiveness of the proposed approach is confirmed through MATLAB simulation, demonstrating a state of charge (SOC) efficiency of 60%.

articleTitle: A Review of Trust Models for Flying Ad-hoc Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: FANETs (Flying Ad-hoc networks) are a type of ad-hoc networks that consist of drones communicating with each other and forming a network. Such a network has multiple applications like providing last-mile connectivity for networks like VANETS when either nodes are too far apart or terrain is causing signals to be obstructed. Also, they can be used in areas where a natural disaster has destroyed the network infrastructure to provide connectivity by replacing damaged ground stations. A major issue identified in such networks is the trust of the FANET nodes as the network is highly dynamic and the chances of malicious nodes entering the network are high. As drones have limited processing capability trust models provide a lightweight solution to allow the network to function even with adversarial nodes. This paper describes current research in this field and classifies the different approaches used in the literature.

articleTitle: Logic OR Based Modified Forward Backward Load Flow Method for the Siting and Sizing of DGs in Radial Distribution Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the past few years, the growing demand for power has led to a substantial emphasis on optimizing distribution networks (DNs) along with distributed generations. The optimal placement of distributed generators (DGs) within these networks has become increasingly important, aiming to reduce power losses and mitigate voltage drops effectively. Therefore, the present research explores the efficient sizing and strategic deployment of DGs in distribution networks. Conventional Newton Raphson Load Flow (NR-LF) method is not applicable for the distribution networks with high R/X ratio due to the singularity of Jacobian matrix. Here an efficient and modified Logical OR based Forward Backward Load Flow (MFB-LF) technique is implemented which is based on the simple matrix equations and successfully tested on distribution networks. In the proposed load flow analysis, the Kirchhoff’s Current Law (KCL) and Kirchhoff’s Voltage Law (KVL) phases are combined by a simple matrix and directly finding out the value for bus voltages. The novel Load Flow analysis is conducted on 33-bus radial networks and its results are compared with the Newton Raphson method and standard Forward Backward Load Flow method and the solution to the multi-objective problem is obtained using Mixed Discrete Particle swarm optimization (MD-PSO). A comparative analysis of the optimization results with the weighted sum method is presented across various combinations.

Author Keywords: Comparison with standard Forward Backward Load Flow and Newton Raphson Load Flow

articleTitle: Detection of lung nodules from the CT images with Border Collie Optimization based DCNN classifier
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Cancer, one of the chronic diseases, is the major cause of death at its later stages. Among the various cancer types, lung cancer accounts for the two-third fatal rate which can be identified with the changes observed in the lung nodules. The early detection of these changes can increase the survivability and the detection methods such as imaging modalities help the radiologist to predict manually. This manual prediction sometimes leads to misconceptions, which can change the entire treatment procedure. In order to enhance prediction and survival rate, deep learning methods are implanted in the medical environment in which former methods provide outcomes with certain drawbacks such as less robustness, misclassification, and so on. To provide better lung nodule detection (LND) from computed tomography (CT) images, the optimized Deep Convolutional Neural network (DCNN) model is proposed. The model is optimized with Border collie optimization (BCO) which helps to enhance the classification performance. The features of the model are extracted with the gray level co-occurrence matrix (GLCM) features and VGG-16 based features along with the Centralized Superpixels Segmentation Iterative Clustering (CSSBIC) segmentation that provides enhanced accuracy. The accuracy, sensitivity, and specificity are the performance metrics utilized to evaluate the performance of the BCO optimized DCNN that achieves 92.78 %, 96.64%, and 88.12% respectively.

articleTitle: Enhanced Accuracy and Prediction of Novel Random Forest Algorithm Compared over K-Nearest Neighbor in Software Bug Prediction System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study is intended to provide a novel random forest-based strategy for software bug detection and contrast its efficiency to the conventional K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) technique. The primary purpose is to analyze the accuracy and efficiency of the suggested method in discovering and predicting software defects minimizing the security threats. This study compares the performance of two software bug prediction methods: the K-Nearest Neighbor (KNN) method and a novel random forest-based approach. The publicly available Eclipse Bug Data dataset is used, which contains information on software projects and their associated bug reports, including features such as code complexity, lines of code, and number of developers involved. To calculate the effectiveness of both methods, the dataset is randomly split into two groups of 10 samples each. The KNN method is trained and tested using the first group, while the novel random forest-based approach is trained and tested using the second group. Python and the scikit-learn machine learning package are employed to implement both strategies. To ensure the validity and reliability of the results, the study is conducted with a statistical power (G-power) of 0.85, an alpha level of 0.5, a beta level of 0.2, and a confidence interval of 95%. The experimental findings demonstrated that the suggested random forest-based approach achieved an accuracy of 78.59%, while the KNN method obtained an accuracy of 75.59%. These outcomes indicate that the novel approach outperformed the KNN method, demonstrating its superiority for software bug prediction reducing the security threats. The results were statistically significant values with 0.000 (p<0.05). The analysis reveals that the random forest-based method is preferable for handling high-dimensional data and missing data, both of which are found frequently in software bug prediction.

articleTitle: Maximizing Wheat Crop Productivity with Intelligent Land Analysis and IoT
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Agricultural productivity plays an essential role in global food security, with a special focus on increasing the production of important crops such as wheat. To meet the requirement, the study proposes a novel technique that combines an intelligent land analysis framework with IoT (Internet of Things) technology. The growing global population and the limitations of traditional farming methods in meeting expanding demand create a pressing requirement for such a model.
