Existing methods tend to be limited by a lack of real-time data, resulting in inefficient resource usage and yield losses. The proposed method, on the other hand, merges soil sensors, drones, and satellite images to provide farmers with real-time information on soil moisture, levels of nutrients, and the health of crops. It employs data analytics and machine learning algorithms to provide personalized irrigation, fertilization, and pest control recommendations, allowing for accurate and timely interventions. Field experiments reveal a 20% increase in wheat yield, 15% reduction in water use and 18% reduction in fertilizer usage, demonstrating the effectiveness of the method compared with the existing approach in increasing productivity while saving resources and avoiding environmental impacts.

articleTitle: Moving Node Tracking in Sensory Networks by means of Space Time Adaptive Processing
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Precise localization and tracking of moving or quasi-stationary nodes in a sensory network system, pose a major challenge among researchers all over the world. The purpose of the present research work is to improve on accuracy of estimation and tracking of moving targets or nodes in a wireless sensor network. This paper introduces the concept of constant modulus (CMA) algorithmic method in space time adaptive processing (STAP) to enhance the exactness of direction-of-arrival (DOA) estimation, by determining the frequency and time points of source signals. To begin with, the cost function is minimized by algebraic CMA weight updating beamformer and the estimation problem is transformed to moving target tracking domain in STAP. Then the optimization of the time-frequency distribution matrix is performed. Comparison by simulation results in terms of gradual change of root-mean-square-error (RMSE), and detection probability with signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) and computational complexity with number of array elements clearly illustrates that the proposed method performs better than the standard and popular existing methods at low signal power conditions.

articleTitle: Identification of Disaster Related Tweets for Real-Time Response using Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper presents the identification system for social media tweets about the disaster. A sophisticated machine learning framework is designed to classify tweets as disaster-related or not. In an age where social media platforms serve as real-time information provider during critical events, the ability to identify disaster-related content swiftly and accurately is necessary. Using deep learning techniques for natural language processing, this system represents a significant advancement in disaster identification through social media. The dataset used for training and evaluating the model is taken from Kaggle. This dataset contains a variety of labeled tweets, including essential information such as keywords, locations, and the tweet content itself. Robust data preprocessing techniques are employed to handle missing values, encode categorical variables, and examine the class distribution. These steps ensure the dataset’s compatibility for model training. The core of the Disaster Identification System is in its neural network architecture. It incorporates bidirectional Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) layers, spatial dropout, and dense layers to effectively capture content related information from the tweet content. The model is trained using binary cross-entropy loss and the Adam optimizer, which is a powerful predictive engine. Furthermore, the Disaster Identification System has a real-time prediction function that enables users to input tweets and receive instant assessments of whether the content is disaster-related. This feature has the potential to increase the speed and accuracy of information dissemination during critical events. The Disaster Identification System represents a step for disaster prediction and real-time information filtering. Its application extends beyond disaster management to cover emergency response, public safety, and crisis communication. This paper provides an in-depth exploration of the system’s architecture and capabilities, providing the way for enhanced situational awareness and improved disaster response strategies.

articleTitle: Leveraging Machine Learning for Early Prediction of Lifestyle Diseases: A Data-Driven Approach
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This initiative confronts global challenges presented by lifestyle-related illnesses, including diabetes, heart diseases, and Parkinson’s. Departing from conventional retrospective approaches, the study embraces a data-centric methodology, employing machine learning to analyze varied patient datasets encompassing demographics, lifestyle preferences, genetic predispositions, and biomarkers. The existing healthcare paradigm, reliant on retrospective data, hampers early identification and proactive management of lifestyle diseases. To address this, the study adopts a predictive and preventive model, leveraging machine learning to discern patterns in datasets for early detection and personalized interventions. The project focuses on developing predictive models utilizing techniques such as support vector machines and logistic regression, targeting accuracy rates of 77.27% for diabetes, 85.12% for heart diseases, and 87.17% for Parkinson’s. The overarching aim is to transform healthcare by identifying at-risk individuals before symptoms manifest, contributing to the efficiency of public health systems.

articleTitle: Automated Medical Image Segmentation Using Multi-Scale Convolutional Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Real-time semantic segmentation of medical images, employing convolutional neural networks (CNNs), holds great potential as an approach for the automated segmentation of biomedical images and for facilitating automated diagnosis. Convolutional neural networks (CNNs) have demonstrated high effectiveness across various computer vision tasks, such as image segmentation, object recognition, and scene understanding. However, their performance in the biomedical image segmentation task, particularly in addressing death rate and mental health aspects, is an area that requires further exploration. This paper examines the general performance of numerous current CNN fashions for actual- time clinical picture semantic segmentation. We evaluated the overall performance of the fashions on three real-international datasets of clinical.

articleTitle: Optimizing Inventory using Ensemble Learning Algorithms in Manufacturing Environment
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Managing inventory in a dynamic supply chain that is changing quickly presents special challenges for the inventory. Regression analysis is an effective machine learning technique to optimize inventory, and it helps to explain this challenge. This paper aims to increase demand forecasting precision, minimize carrying costs, and decrease stock outs, which will ultimately increase the supply chain's efficiency and profitability. Effective inventory control is essential to supply chain and corporate operations. Sustaining ideal stock levels lowers carrying costs, lessens stock outs, and boosts overall profitability for companies. In this study, we describe a new approach to inventory level optimization utilizing machine learning, specifically ensemble learning techniques. To address this challenge, we introduce an ensemble learning-based data-driven approach that leverages the strengths of many machine learning models to generate predictions with improved accuracy and inventory management. Lead times, demand projections, historical sales data, and other pertinent data must be gathered for this study. Here we use ensemble learning methods Random Forest to create a model with predictive capabilities that can accurately predict future demand. The efficacy of the method in various industries and scenarios is demonstrated by real-world case studies along with simulations. The study determines the variables causing inventory fluctuations and evaluates their effect on carrying costs by utilizing these regression analyses. The novel approach we take in this paper is Environmental Impact-Based Inventory Optimization in line with real demand and remain competitive in a market that is changing quickly by adopting these cutting-edge strategies, which will ultimately increase profitability and customer satisfaction.

articleTitle: A Novel SSA-AODV Protocol for Efficient Packet Routing in UAV Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Flying Ad-hoc Networks (FANETs) continue to be a dynamic field of research, driven by the need for efficient and adaptive communication in scenarios with rapidly changing network topologies. This paper explores the integration of the Sparrow Search Algorithm (SSA) with the on-demand vector routing, aiming to harness the benefits of SSA to improve routing performance in FANETS. Inspired by the collaborative foraging behaviour of sparrows, SSA introduces a decentralized and adaptive strategy for nodes to intelligently explore routes, adapting to topology changes and optimizing paths. Integrating SSA with the AODV protocol, considering multiple metrics such as energy, congestion, and hop count offers a holistic approach to route optimization. The algorithm tackles the challenges posed by node mobility, network topology changes, and dynamic link conditions. Extensive simulations are conducted on ns-3 platform to evaluate the performance of SSA-AODV against state-of-art protocols in terms of key metrics such as packet delivery ratio, end-to-end delay, routing overhead, energy consumption, and network stability. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of SSA-AODV in improving routing efficiency and reliability, validating the bio-inspired approach in the context of FANETs.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Survey of Healthcare Applications for Web and Mobile Platforms
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Health Care Management System provides the benefits of quick and easy appointment, online booking of medicines, online booking of laboratory tests, where users can choose the doctors they like, or users can share their concerns and book an appointment with the relevant doctor. offers streamlined operations, improved system, training, patient care, cost control and improved profitability. HCMS is easy to use and designed and developed to provide real tangible benefits to both hospitals and patients who receive care at their doorstep. The "Health Care Management System" project includes both a web application and a mobile application that uses NEXT JS as the web application interface and React Native as the user interface, a popular framework that can easily connect to a backend system such as MONGO DB. All the necessary modules and functions are specially built according to the requirements. The entire architecture was flexible for web and mobile applications and built with the latest technology. It covers all the necessary modules of patient registration, medical information, doctor, patient admission, billing, record change, prescription, doctor registration, laboratory registration. The human body is an enormously complex and elaborate structure with millions of functions. Man has deciphered all these complex functions through his research and experiments. Medicines became an important part of research as science and technology developed. Medicine gradually developed into a completely new field of study and research. The health sector initially consists of medical facilities such as hospitals and clinics. As a result, the health sector strives to provide the best medical services to the community.

articleTitle: LoRaWAN-The Technology of Sewage Monitoring and Alerting System
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper proposes a novel approach to sewage monitoring and alert systems by leveraging the capabilities of LoRaWAN (Long Range Wide Area Network) technology, specifically utilizing gas and water level sensors. These sensors can be deployed throughout the sewage infrastructure to collect real-time data on gas levels (such as methane or hydrogen sulfide) and water levels within the sewage network. The collected data is then transmitted wirelessly to a central monitoring station via the LoRaWAN network. The introduction of LoRaWAN into sewage monitoring systems brings several advantages. Firstly, LoRaWAN's long-range capability ensures comprehensive coverage of the sewage network without the need for costly infrastructure installations. This is particularly beneficial in large-scale or geographically dispersed sewage systems. Secondly, LoRaWAN operates on unlicensed frequency bands, minimizing operational costs and reducing dependency on cellular network providers. In conclusion, the integration of gas and water level sensors with LoRaWAN technology offers a transformative solution to enhance sewage monitoring and alert systems. By providing cost-effective, long-range connectivity, real-time monitoring capabilities, and efficient data collection, this approach empowers authorities to proactively manage sewage infrastructure and mitigate potential risks. This project explores the implementation details, challenges, and benefits of utilizing gas and water level sensors with LoRaWAN in sewage monitoring, contributing to the advancement of smart city initiatives and sustainable urban development.

articleTitle: An Approach to Estimate the Measurement for Water Bodies in Satellite Images
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Satellite image processing techniques have become increasingly important for monitoring and analyzing the Earth's surface and its features. Water bodies in particular are of great interest due to their ecological, hydrological, and societal importance. In this paper, it explores the possibility of identifying water bodies from satellite images and calculating their area using various image processing techniques. The use of visible light and microwave sensors as well as the application of image processing techniques such as threshold and segmentation for identifying water bodies. This also uses deep learning architectures such as the U-Net classifier for water body segmentation in satellite images. One approach for image segmentation is the U-Net architecture, which is composed of an encoder network responsible for extracting high-level features from the input image, and a decoder network that generates the segmentation map based on the encoded features. This paper examines how U-Net can be trained on a data set of labeled satellite images to identify water bodies and produce accurate segmentation maps. Finally, this highlights the importance of accurate water body segmentation for various applications such as hydrological modeling, water resource management, and environmental monitoring.

articleTitle: Integration of AI and Cloud-Native Technologies for Personalized Mobile Banking Experiences
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In today's rapidly evolving digital landscape, using Artificial Intelligence (AI) and Cloud-Native Technologies is essential for improving personalized mobile banking experiences. The limitations and errors of existing financial systems necessitate such integration. Existing systems often struggle to adapt to modern consumers dynamic tastes and expectations, resulting in unsatisfactory customer experiences. Identifying the gap, the proposed system revolutionizes mobile banking applications by leveraging AI algorithms such as machine learning and natural language processing within a microservices-based cloud infrastructure. As a result, the proposed system solves the limitations of outdated architectures by providing personalized and efficient services while addressing security issues. The study indicates considerable gains in terms of user pleasure, system scalability, and security robustness through an in-depth evaluation of the results. The results highlight AI's and Cloud-Native Technologies transformational potential in revolutionizing the landscape of tailored mobile banking experiences. The study provides helpful information to financial institutions looking to adopt innovation and fulfill the evolving needs of modern consumers.

articleTitle: Enhancing TCP Congestion Control: A Comparative Analysis, and Algorithmic Modifications using NS2
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The transmission control protocol is essentially a computer network protocol and ensures the reliability of the transmitted data. TCP’s congestion control algorithms support network performance and stability. Network congestion has become a major issue in network analysis. TCP (Transmission Control Protocol) Congestion control algorithms ensure smooth transmission of data across networks. This work examines TCP congestion algorithms. The main objective is to increase its efficiency and modify the algorithm. A detailed performance analysis of the enhanced TCP congestion control algorithms namely Tahoe, New Reno, and Vegas is performed and simulations are used to evaluate its performance under different network conditions such as high latency, constant bit rate (CBR) bandwidth load, and varying traffic loads. Metrics such as latency, throughput, and round-trip time are analyzed under the scenarios using ns-2 simulator.

articleTitle: No-Code Cross-Platform Application Framework for Customizable User Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the era of digital innovation, no-code application development has emerged as a transformative force, democratizing the creation of software solutions. By removing the traditional barriers of coding expertise, no-code platforms empower individuals and businesses to bring their ideas to life efficiently. This innovative study introduces a groundbreaking no-code cross-platform application framework, reshaping traditional approaches to application development. A key feature is its seamless integration of cross-platform capabilities, enabling the creation of applications that effortlessly transcend device boundaries. Built on a user-centric design, the methodology employs a user-friendly web-based form to capture detailed user preferences. The collected data integrates seamlessly with the Flask web framework, creating a cohesive link between user input and the subsequent generation of applications. A distinctive aspect of the framework is its integration with Kivy, a versatile cross-platform application development framework. Through a refined transformation process, user-input data is translated into dynamic cross-platform applications, featuring diverse and customizable user interfaces. Performance evaluations confirm the responsiveness and usability of the generated applications, affirming the effectiveness of the no-code approach. As the study addresses the limitations of the current implementation, it sets the stage for future research endeavors, envisioning the evolution of the no-code landscape. In essence, this research introduces a visionary framework, empowering users to transcend traditional development constraints and offering a glimpse into the future of application design where user customizability, support for user-uploaded media elements, and cross-platform functionality converge seamlessly.

articleTitle: Machine Learning Predictive Models for Autism Spectrum Disorder Using Eye-Tracking Technology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Autism Spectrum Disorder (ASD) is a complex neurodevelopmental condition characterized by a wide range of symptoms and challenges. Early detection of ASD is crucial for timely intervention and improved outcomes. Eye-tracking technology has shown promise in capturing subtle differences in gaze patterns associated with ASD. This research focuses on detecting Autism Spectrum Disorder using machine learning methods to test the applicability of eye-tracking data in children to aid in the early screening of autism. Eye-tracking data is collected during specific tasks, and relevant features are extracted to represent gaze patterns. Deep learning models like convolutional neural networks and various machine learning techniques are employed to analyze these patterns and identify subtle differences associated with ASD to discover the best model for predicting autism. The performance of the proposed ASD detection system is evaluated through rigorous cross-validation and comparison with existing diagnostic tools. The results demonstrate the effectiveness of the eye-tracking paths and a deep learning approach in accurately differentiating individuals with ASD from neurotypical individuals.

articleTitle: Podcast Summarization - A journey through sound
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Podcasts are audio files that are generated by speakers and made available over the internet for streaming or download to listeners. Podcasts have become increasingly popular as a source of entertainment and information. Some podcast shows release new episodes on a regular schedule (daily, weekly, etc.); others irregularly. Some podcast shows feature short episodes of 5 minutes or less touching on one or two topics; others may release 3+ hour long episodes touching on a wide range of topics. Some are structured as news delivery, some as conversations, some as storytelling.The automated creation of podcast audio summaries is proposed to aid in content discovery and help listeners quickly preview podcast content before investing time in listening to an entire episode. The goal is to enhance the user experience, making podcast content accessible to a wider audience by providing key insights of the podcast as audio summaries in the user’s preferred language. The proposed system first transcribes the audio from a podcast using automatic speech recognition (ASR), then summarizes the transcript using abstractive text summarization, and finally returns the audio associated with the text summary in a language of the user’s choice.

articleTitle: Exploring Sustainable Techniques for Traffic Management in Urban Environments
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper presents a pioneering Smart City Framework that intertwines sustainable development principles with smart traffic management strategies. By harnessing cutting-edge technologies, the framework integrates real-time data for the improvement of traffic flow. This involves the enactment of smart traffic signals, dynamic lane management systems, and automated toll collection, collectively contributing to a more efficient urban transportation network. Concurrently, the model places a strong emphasis on sustainable urban practices, incorporating energy-efficient infrastructure, waste reduction through IoT-enabled bins, and the furtherance of green spaces. The integration of information and communication technologies establishes a connected urban ecosystem, enhancing overall resilience and adaptability. Moreover, community engagement and awareness play an important part in the framework, encouraging a role of responsibility among residents towards better living practices. By fostering a holistic and interconnected approach, this model strives to address the intricate challenges of modern urban environments. The ultimate goal is to create smarter, more livable cities that not only prioritize efficiency and technological innovation but also promote environmental sustainability and the well-being of their inhabitants.

articleTitle: Design And Verification Of On-Chip Instruments For Functional Safety
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Functional safety is crucial in automotive engineering, ensuring that vehicles operate reliably and safely even in the face of unexpected malfunctions. It involves systematic identification, assessment, and mitigation of hazards arising from electrical and electronic systems throughout a vehicle's lifecycle, from design to manufacture. Today, designers in the automotive industry focus on increasing software safety, adopting new safety standards, and incorporating advanced safety technologies like machine learning and artificial intelligence. However, ensuring the correct operation of all electronic subsystems is equally important for overall system safety and reliability. On-chip instruments play a vital role in this process as they are specialized circuits embedded within an integrated circuit (IC) that monitor and analyze the IC's internal operations to ensure proper functionality and reliability. Using on-chip instruments (OCIs) to monitor electronic control units (ECUs) is an effective way to improve functional safety in the automobile industry, especially when new technologies are incorporated into the sector. With sensors and processing parts installed, OCIs keep a close eye on factors like voltage, current, temperature, and frequency, and by comparing them to established thresholds, these instruments can effectively detect any abnormalities or deviations from normal operation. This information can then be used to determine whether the system is functioning correctly or requires further investigation.

articleTitle: Innovative FETs in Biosensing Applications: A Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The realm of biosensor technology has seen remarkable progress with the advent of innovative field-effect transistors (FETs) like gate-all-around junctionless field-effect transistors (GAA-JL-FETs), gate-all-around junction-less accumulated mode FETs (GAA-JAM-FETs), GAA-Schottky FETs, and conventional GAA FETs. These FETs have demonstrated superior performance in biosensing applications, leveraging their advanced figure of merits (FOMs) like heightened sensitivity, selectivity, low limits of detection (LOD), and rapid response times. This paper provides a comprehensive review of these advanced FET technologies, drawing comparisons between their sensing performances in various biosensing applications. Further, this paper focuses on each individual FET and its applications in the specific domain of biosensors. This comparative analysis aims to guide future research, fostering the development of more efficient, sensitive, and selective biosensors by leveraging the unique properties of these advanced FETs.

articleTitle: Low Power Area Efficient Adaptive Turbo Decoder Architecture For Wireless NoC
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This research introduces a novel Turbo encoder and Adaptive Turbo decoder model designed to enhance Bit Error Rate (BER) performance across a spectrum of modulation schemes. The study systematically evaluates the model's efficacy in diverse channel environments, including AWGN, Rayleigh, and Rician channels, employing simulations and comparisons with conventional Adaptive Viterbi Decoder and Turbo decoder methods. Results underscore the Adaptive Turbo Decoding (ATD) model's superior BER performance, particularly as iterations increase. The investigation further extends to RF Wireless Network-On-Chip (WiNoC) scenarios, emphasizing the adaptability of ATD for effective error correction. Furthermore, the research explores the implications of ATD in Orthogonal Frequency Division Multiplexing (OFDM) systems, comparing models based on Fast Fourier Transform (FFT), Discrete Wavelet Transform (DWT), and Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform (DTCWT). Notably, the ATD-DTCWT-OFDM model exhibits a substantial reduction in BER, showcasing the potential advantages of Dual-Tree Complex Wavelet Transform for OFDM modulation in acoustic channels with multipath. This research contributes valuable insights into the optimization of communication channels through the application of adaptive decoding techniques.

articleTitle: Virtual Video Game as a Clinical Tool for Psychological Assessment and Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper proposes a very novel and dynamic approach to psychological assessment by utilising virtual video games as a psychometric tool. Traditional methods, such as interviews and surveys, often yield conscious responses, leading to potential inaccuracies. Leveraging the interactive and immersive nature of video games, our research aims to enhance the accuracy and engagement of data collection. We introduce a dynamic scale to quantify player responses, providing a structured framework for systematic assessment. Collected data can be analysed using statistical models or customised by experts to evaluate psychological indicators precisely. This research explores the benefits of virtual video games in improving the accuracy, engagement, and flexibility of psychological assessments, contributing to more effective solutions in clinical psychology.

articleTitle: Automated Detection of Language Disorders in Children Using NLP and Machine Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The purpose of the study is to address the essential need for a more efficient and objective technique for detecting language disorders in children, overcoming the constraints of standard manual evaluation systems. Existing systems, which utilize subjective evaluations and manual scoring, frequently result in lengthy processes and possible errors. To solve these issues, the proposed system automates the identification process by combining Natural Language Processing (NLP) and Machine Learning (ML). The system achieves a breakthrough in accuracy by normalizing text and extracting a comprehensive collection of linguistic features using advanced NLP techniques. The implementation involves difficult data preprocessing, extensive feature extraction, and the application of a cutting-edge Support Vector Machine (SVM) classifier. The proposed system achieves a 15% increase in accuracy, a 12% increase in precision, a 10% increase in recall, and an 11% increase in F1 score over existing systems. The confusion matrices show improved prediction skills, while accuracy across varied linguistic samples demonstrates the system's adaptability. Finally, the proposed system not only speeds up the detection of language disorders but also provides the groundwork for deeper insights into linguistic development, with revolutionary potential in educational and therapeutic settings.

articleTitle: Deep Learning-Based Resource Allocation Algorithms for 6G Networks
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Deep learning-primarily based aid allocation algorithms for 6G networks enable enhanced community overall performance via close to most useful schedulers. those algorithms leverage deep neural network architectures to analyze the physical layer aid allocation undertaking which solves the network utility maximization (NUM) problem. The neural community is educated on the use of various reinforcement learning (RL) techniques, which include Q-learning, to perform correct selections as a scheduler in a given deadline. The community structure consists of two fundamental architectures namely the actor-critic structure and the multi-enter-multi-output (MIMO) structure. The actor-critic architecture makes use of a coverage gradient-primarily based technique and a deep Q-community (DQN) to optimize the utility functions. The MIMO structure uses superior deep-gaining knowledge of techniques, along with convolutional neural networks and lengthy short-time period memory (LSTM) recurrent neural networks for stepped-forward selection scoring and quicker convergence. The deep mastering-based algorithms are shown to enhance the scheduling accuracy and convergence time in evaluation with the present scheduling algorithms in 6G networks and bring a promising performance improvement as compared to the conventional scheduling algorithms.

articleTitle: Patient Clustering Optimization With K-Means in Healthcare Data Analysis
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The technique known as K-Means is used in this study to optimize patient clustering for health care information analysis. Adopting an interpretivist mindset, a deductive method is utilized to improve the algorithm's efficiency and assess its resilience. Secondary data collection is used in descriptive research designs to enable in-depth analysis. The findings emphasize demographically-based patient cohorts, designed algorithms performance, along with algorithmic reliability. Accurate clustering is ensured by validation procedures, and the approach is compared to other approaches in a comparative analysis. Analyzing critically reveals both advantages and disadvantages. Scalability, hybrid models, along with interdisciplinary cooperation are encouraged in the recommendations. Subsequent research endeavors ought to explore sophisticated methodologies, dynamic aggregation, unsupervised machine learning, and ethical implications.

articleTitle: Detection of Cysts in Kidneys by Means of Deep Learning
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Given that they eliminate toxins from the blood and transform bodily waste into urine, the kidneys rank among the body’s most vital organs. They are the two bean- molded organs on the right and left sides of the retroperitoneal space. It is the focal organ of the urinary framework. Numerous neurotic circumstances emerge from the kidneys, going from intense kidney inability to constant kidney infection. Somewhere around 1 out of 10 individuals has this ailment called cyst in the kidney. They are thin-walled, fluid- filled pockets that can develop on or within the kidneys and can take many different forms. The most widely recognized types of kidney cyst infections are cystic kidney sickness and polycystic kidney illnesses. Cysts in the kidneys are connected to serious diseases that hinder kidney capability. Age, examination, and future information forecasting are pivotal in the present robotized world. Utilized as a powerful and deep learning approach are convolutional neural networks. CNN fundamentally centers around examining and learning undeniable-level pictures that can additionally foresee future qualities. ResNet50, InceptionV3, and Xception are the three outstanding CNN models utilized in this venture, which characterize the kidney radiographs into kidneys with and without blisters. A close comparison between the proposed profound learning models is performed, with an exactness of 91% for ResNet50, 84% for InceptionV3, and 94% for Xception.

articleTitle: Collaborative Cryptosystem Framework Enhancing Advanced Digital Signatures
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Within the realm of networks lies a congregation of nodes, each with the central purpose of conveying information from one endpoint to another. Ensuring the security of this information against unauthorized access is a pivotal concern. The concept of cryptography emerged as a response to the imperative of safeguarding crucial data exchanged across vulnerable networks. Encryption, a central facet of cryptography, involves encoding information using a confidential key, thereby enabling only the intended recipient to decipher it. In contrast, cryptanalysis pertains to the unauthorized extraction of information without knowledge of the secret key. The primary challenge encountered in signature-based approaches is the computational burden arising from the utilization of substantial real numbers essential for both the signature and verification processes. This paper introduces an efficient and compact digital signature algorithm with reduced complexity, aimed at ensuring robust secure communication. Proposed a simplified operations to facilitate the signature and verification procedures, akin to how individuals sign legal documents and subsequently authenticate them in the presence of witnesses. The study delves into key generation, signature creation, and verification processes inherent to diverse digital signature methodologies.

articleTitle: Enhancing the Performance of Patch Antenna by Mitigating Mutual Coupling with Modified DGS
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the present venture, a CPW-fed dome shaped monopole radiating elements with 2×2 MIMO configuration is presented. A pate shaped monopole antenna with 4×4 MIMO configuration that can operate in two frequency bands to support Wi-Fi, LTE, Bluetooth, WLAN, Wi-MAX operations is shown in this work. The antenna has a T-shaped remainders for strong isolation and comb shaped gaps in the ground plane to produce binary band response. In both reverberating bands, the measured antenna gain ranges with a radiation effectiveness. The suggested antenna was indicated through fabrication and dimension issues numerous diversity characteristics were assessed, and it was determined that they were suitable for MIMO operations. The fabricated antenna undergoes meticulous validation against results from HFSS software. Concluding the study, the antenna exhibits commendable diversity parameters, making it well suited for MIMO applications. This comprehensive exploration showcases the antenna's versatility, making it a promising contender for advanced communication systems.

articleTitle: Automated Smart Cart for Physically Challenged
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In recent years we have seen a lot of research and development in the fields of automation and embedded systems, with the goal of improving and reducing the labour of the workforce in both industry and public spaces like airports, trains for automatic ticket collection, and metro buses. In this paper a method called automatic tram carrier navigation and the payment system to help build greater automation and assist to the elderly, disabled and blind people is proposed. This approach can be used at all malls, large clothes stores, home appliance stores, etc. It eliminates the need for clients to stand in a long queue, and automatic billing is feasible. Additionally, by providing details on the product, quantity, price, automatic invoicing, etc., it promotes the purchase of goods in shopping malls for blind, elderly, and handicapped customers. To identify the name, price, and quantity of each product, an RFID reader is used to read the EPIC tag ID. The micro-controller receives information from the RFID reader based on the RF signal, which is then used to identify the products and their quantities and prices. The object and any barriers are both detected using the ultrasonic sensor. The load of the trolley to carry the weight is also taken for consideration.

articleTitle: Diabetes Prognosis by the Application of Machine Learning Techniques
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The pancreas's dysfunction is what causes diabetes, a chronic illness. This deficiency results in insufficient or nonexistent production of insulin, subsequently leading to increased blood glucose levels. Diabetes should not be disregarded; individuals with diabetes who do not receive treatment run the risk of developing an extensive array of comorbidities, such as neuropathy, renal complications, cardiovascular disorders, and more. Early detection of this condition possesses the capacity to prevent loss of life and mitigate the severity of subsequent complications. A multitude of artificial intelligence algorithms can be employed to predict diabetes with the intention of achieving this goal. The objective of this project is to design and implement a user-friendly web application that employs more than one machine learning technique to detect diabetes in its early stages with high accuracy. Utilized are both the historical dataset and the necessary preparation procedures. The dataset is now in our possession. The development of a classification model is achieved through the implementation of machine learning techniques that rely on the visual depiction of the attributes present in the dataset. The accuracy is assessed through the utilization of established machine learning techniques, which are subsequently contrasted to determine the most suitable response. Following this, the candidate with the greatest degree of precision is chosen and incorporated into the model for diabetes prediction.

articleTitle: Decentralized Crowdfunding harnessing Ethereum, Smart contracts and Metamask
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In recent years, the increasing need for crowdfunding has become a prominent phenomenon, driven by a variety of factors shaping the contemporary economic landscape. One of the primary catalysts is the surge in entrepreneurial ventures and innovative projects seeking funding outside traditional financing channels. Entrepreneurs and creators, often facing challenges in securing loans or traditional investments, turn to crowdfunding platforms as an alternative avenue to access capital. This study presents a comprehensive methodology for developing a decentralized platform, employing a sophisticated technology stack. The backend is crafted using Solidity for smart contract development, ensuring secure and transparent financial transactions. React and Vite form the frontend to deliver a responsive user interface, complemented by the integration of the MetaMask wallet for a secure user experience. The platform's scalability and cost-effectiveness are enhanced through the incorporation of the Polygon chain. Smart contracts, fundamental to the decentralized architecture, enable trustless execution of financial operations. Alchemy serves as a middleware, optimizing data flows between the frontend and blockchain. This approach has the power to completely transform the crowdfunding process. The incorporation of these technologies benefits the crowdfunding platform by enhancing security, scalability, transparency and user interface, while users experience increased trust, efficiency, and a streamlined process when participating in crowdfunding campaigns. This study is quite promising and helps people overcome the increasing difficulties they experience in the contemporary existing platform and ultimately fosters a more robust and user-centric crowdfunding ecosystem.

articleTitle: Stock Market Prediction through Ensemble of Deep Learning and Machine Learning Models along with Technical Indicators
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Introducing a novel ensemble methodology for stock market prediction that seamlessly combines well-known traditional machine learning algorithms like Support Vector Machines (SVM) and Random Forest with cutting-edge deep learning models like Long Short-Term Memory Networks (LSTM) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The addition of crucial technical indicators, such as Relative Strength Index (RSI), Moving Averages, Bollinger Bands, and Money Flow Index (MFI), further enhances this comprehensive ensemble framework. Through the combination of these several models and the use of the enlightening data that market indicators offer, the method overcomes the constraints of single algorithms. Combining major technical indicators with deep learning and conventional machine learning approaches yields an ensemble model that performs very well in identifying subtle market patterns and making accurate forecasts. Thorough real-world testing demonstrates the efficacy of the ensemble technique. The all-inclusive tool shows its ability to accurately predict stock market movements and offers a strong foundation for negotiating the complexities of financial markets. These findings advance the area of finance by giving academics, investors, and practitioners seeking better decision support in the dynamic and complex world of the stock market a sophisticated and reliable method.

articleTitle: Deep Learning Based Voice Assisted Traffic Sign Detection Using RCNN
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper unravels a groundbreaking system dedicated to detect road traffic symbols within the realm of Advanced Driver Assistance Systems (ADAS). Imagine it was like a technological waltz, where YOLOV5, RCNN, and R-MASK gracefully converge, not merely to improve performance, but to redefine how to perceive and interact with road signs. This combination of deep learning architectures enables real-time object detection, region proposal generation, and instance segmentation, respectively. Additionally, the system integrates voice-based indications for enhanced user interaction, providing real-time alerts and information about the detected signs. The implementation has undergone thorough testing on related datasets, demonstrating successful classification and voice assistance. This comprehensive system aims at enhancing measures for road safety effectively identifying and communicating information about traffic signs within the ADAS framework. The envisioned system performs object detection, sign detection, classification and provides satisfactory results.

articleTitle: An Overview of Distributed Generation System: Considering Optimal Planning and Reliability for EV Charging Stations
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Renewable energy sources have recently come to the attention of researchers and power companies, due to the rising need for electricity. Incorporating renewable sources of energy like solar, wind, battery storage systems, improves the electrical power supply system to some extent, but also raises issues for both customers and utilities because these sources deal with intermittent nature, CO2 emissions, reliability, power quality, and electricity prices, which affect the performance of the system. Additionally, the fueling of generators has a negative impact on the ecosystem, due to CO2 Emissions. Green hydrogen that supports fuel cells and electrolyzes can be used as a distributed generator, bringing the idea of hybrid green power systems used to charge EV fleets, which together reduce greenhouse gas emissions and support the global decarbonization process. In this research paper a comprehensive review of renewable energy-based distributed generation systems is covered for EV charging applications, considering optimal planning and reliability.

articleTitle: Single Snapshot DOA Estimation Based on Compressive Sensing Using Co-Prime Sparse Array
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The concept of compressive sensing (CS) introduces a fresh paradigm applicable to fields where a solution to an underdetermined system of linear equations is required. Direction of arrival (DOA) estimation is one such application, where multiple sources are pinpointed using a sparsity constraint. Compared with uniform linear arrays (ULA), sparse arrays can create a larger aperture and offer a higher degree of freedom (DOF). A coprime array is one type of sparse array, composed of two linear arrays, and it offers numerous DOFs compared to conventional sparse arrays. In this paper, DOA estimation is enhanced by incorporating the coprime array concept with the ULA and integrating it into the CS framework. More specifically, using the coprime array concept, a low-dimensional kernel compresses the received signals from the ULA. Subsequently, these compressed signals are utilized for estimation of high-resolution DOA. Various simulation runs are performed to confirm the superiority of the suggested coprime sparse array, focusing on failure rate,, root mean square error (RMSE), and mean square error (MSE).

articleTitle: Precise Detection of Vitiligo Using Deep Learning Methodology
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Vitiligo is a skin disorder that causes depigmentation. Detecting it early is important for effective management. To detect vitiligo in dermatological photos, this research investigates two machine learning techniques: K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) and Recurrent Neural Networks (RNN). The RNN architecture learns about vitiligo patches through sequence-based learning, while the KNN model uses feature similarity to classify skin lesions. The study uses measurements including accuracy, precision, recall, and F1score to assess how well both approaches perform. According to the findings, RNN is superior at identifying sequential dependencies in dermatological pictures, whereas KNN does a good job of classifying vitiligo patches based on local features.

articleTitle: Low Power PLL Design and Analysis for Medical Applications: A review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: One essential component of many communication and instrumentation domains is a phase locked loop (PLL). This paper discusses the challenges faced in creating a low power phase-locked loop that has many frequency outputs for digital applications. With the development of CMOS technology, the PLL is a crucial component that provides the clocking scheme in many electronic circuits, increasing the need for power reduction. In this paper, low-power PLL technology with good stability is evaluated. The use of biomedical implantable devices with low power, low noise, and long-term performance is primarily motivated by chronic diseases and an ageing population. The above requirements will be met by effective architectural designs. PLLs are dynamic control mechanisms that have the ability to match the phase and frequency of an output signal to that of an input signal. PLLs are employed in a wide range of biomedical applications like signal synchronization and tracking, clock generation and synchronization, frequency synthesis, data Communication and signal conditioning, ultrasound imaging, neuromodulator and brain stimulation, respiratory and cardiac monitoring etc. Applications of PLLs in biomedical fields illustrate their capacity to assure precision, stability, and synchronization, which are essential in medical equipment and systems. There are a number of crucial factors to take into account when building a Phase-Locked Loop (PLL) for medical applications to guarantee that the PLL's performance satisfies the demands of the medical device or application: frequency range, phase noise, lock time, jitter, power consumption, phase margin and stability, noise immunity, area, reliability and compliance, customization are some important factors to take into consideration. The PLL design should be customized to match the specific requirements of each medical application.

articleTitle: A Review Across Diversified Applications of Solar Energy
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Solar energy has emerged as a pivotal source of renewable energy across various sectors, showcasing its versatility and sustainability. This paper presents an encompassing view of solar energy applications in diverse sectors, highlighting its significance and impact. In the residential domain, solar energy systems have revolutionized power generation, offering homeowners an eco-friendly and cost-effective alternative. In agriculture, solar-powered irrigation systems and farm equipment have reshaped traditional practices. Within the industrial, large-scale solar installations power manufacturing processes, reducing reliance on fossil fuels, and minimizing environmental impact. In the commercial sector, solar energy solutions have gained prominence for powering businesses sustainably. This paper sheds light on the diverse applications of solar energy across residential, agricultural, industrial, and commercial sectors, emphasizing its transformative potential in fostering sustainability and reducing carbon emissions. As technological advancements continue to refine solar technologies, the future promises further innovation and widespread adoption, paving the way for a greener and more energy-efficient world.

articleTitle: An Armor-Mounted Antenna with Deflected Ground for sub-6 GHz Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This study presents a wearable arm antenna that is optimised for Sub-6 GHz applications with the goal of overcoming the drawbacks of previous antenna designs. Conventional wearable antennas frequently encounter problems with interference, low bandwidth, and subpar performance. Research suggested antenna incorporates a defective ground structure, which is carefully positioned to improve overall performance and lessen known problems, in order to get around these challenges. This design is novel because it takes a customised approach to solving wearable antenna-related problems. The antenna achieves reduced signal distortions, improved radiation characteristics, and improved impedance matching by incorporating the defective ground structure. The antenna's overall performance and dependability in the Sub-6 GHz frequency range are improved by these developments. Results from simulations and real-world testing confirm that the suggested wearable arm antenna is effective with a gain value of 10 dB. In comparison to traditional designs, the antenna shows increased radiation efficiency, increased bandwidth, and improved signal integrity. The study's findings highlight the presented antenna's potential impact on the development of communication systems in various real-world scenarios and position it as a promising solution for Sub-6 GHz applications in wearable technology.

articleTitle: Analysis of Various Spectrum Approaches to Early Autism Detection
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI) is a rapidly advancing field that could transform several industries, including healthcare. Research on artificial intelligence includes ASD identification. ASD is a neurodevelopmental disorder leading to social communication and interaction difficulties with repetitive behaviours, interests, or activities. Early detection of ASD can lead to earlier intervention and better outcomes for individuals with the disorder. Unfortunately, diagnosing ASD using conventional approaches can be costly and timeconsuming. This paper analyses an effective autism detection approach for early intervention using various assessment tools, screening instruments, and diagnostic approaches commonly employed in clinical and research settings. Also, analysed advancements in technology, such as machine learning and deep learning algorithms for early Autism detection. This analysis synthesizes current research and identifies gaps in the field to better understand early autism detection challenges and opportunities, with the goal of improving interventions and quality of life for ASD patients and their families. The various methods are analysed and compared using different performance metrics such as Accuracy. The Analysis results shows that ASD detection using Mobile Net classifier has performed well compared to other existing methods with an accuracy of 95%.

articleTitle: Glaucoma Screening Using Vessel Segmentation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The presence of glaucoma, a persistent eye ailment resulting in visual impairment, highlights the crucial necessity for timely identification. Historically, the main method for evaluating intraocular pressure (IOP) has been through tonometry. However, this technique can sometimes cause an increase in pressure, which poses a potential risk of harm to the optic nerve. An approach with greater potential involves assessing the optic nerve head in retinal fundus images using three-dimensional fundus photos, although this method is currently not widely accessible and is associated with significant expenses. In order to address these difficulties, the process of identifying glaucoma is increasingly dependent on Vessel Segmentation. This paper presents the application of Vessel Segmentation in the context of glaucoma screening, with a specific emphasis on 2D fundus pictures. The segmentation technique entails categorizing each superpixel as either a disc or a non-disc based on histograms and center-surround statistics for optic disc segmentation. Position information is taken into account for the segmentation of the optic cup. Expert professionals manually define the boundaries of the optic disc and cup to assess the efficacy of the proposed segmentation techniques. The proper determination of the cup-to-disc ratio (CDR), which is essential for diagnosing glaucoma, relies on correctly distinguishing the segmented optic disc and optic cup in color retinal fundus camera pictures.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Review on Switched Capacitor-Inductor DC-DC Boost Converter for PV Applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: This paper presents a comprehensive investigation into the various topologies of DC-DC boost converters designed for optimal integration with photovoltaic (PV) systems. Photovoltaic applications demand efficient energy harvesting and management to maximize the conversion of solar energy into electrical power. The DC-DC topologies include switched coupled inductor, basic inductor, coupled capacitor with coupled inductor with a snubber circuit, active clamp, high step-up, and three-winding dual switches are considered for study. Each topology is analyzed in terms of its suitability for PV applications, considering factors such as efficiency, voltage gain, and reliability. The basic coupled inductor topology is explored as a reference point, providing a foundation for understanding the subsequent advanced configurations. This study explores and compares several prominent boost converter configurations, incorporating advanced techniques to enhance overall performance and efficiency.

articleTitle: Analysis on Efficacy of Clinical Study in Diagnosing Cervical Cancer
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Irrespective of advancement of healthcare- based technologies, a proper diagnosis of cervical cancer is still an impending challenge. With increasing pace of adoption of imaging-based diagnosis, the specimen collected from cervix undergoes various forms of clinical assessment to confirm the presence of cervical cancer followed by staging. During the initial stage of this study, it was noted that research work towards cervical cancer has low pace of progress in contrast to other critical disease investigation. Therefore, this paper contributes towards highlighting the existing approaches of methodologies being used for diagnosis related to its effectiveness with a learning outcome represented with respect to advantages and limitation of each research techniques. The paper also contributes towards identifying the significant research gap to find out that there are various shortcomings in existing scheme which are required to be addressed in order to offer a reliable and cost-effective diagnosis model.

articleTitle: Automation of the recognition of Optical Character Recognition (OCR) in handwritten documents
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Handwritten document analysis has gained significant attention in recent years due to its relevance in various fields such as forensic document examination, historical document preservation, and personal identity verification. This paper presents an innovative approach for the recognition of writing styles in handwritten documents, focusing on analysis at the levels of documents, lines, and words. At the document level, our methodology employs advanced pattern recognition algorithms to capture holistic features, considering overall layout, spacing, and formatting. This enables the identification of distinctive characteristics that define an individual's writing style consistently across multiple pages. Moving to the line level, the proposed approach integrates spatial and temporal information to analyze the dynamics of handwriting within a single line. By exploring variations in stroke thickness, slant, and curvature, the model can differentiate between different writing styles, even when presented with subtle variations. At the word level, a detailed analysis of individual characters and their spatial relationships is conducted. Our system utilizes machine learning techniques to recognize unique patterns within the structure of words, considering factors such as letter connectivity, spacing, and size. To achieve robust recognition, a combination of deep learning and traditional image processing methods is employed. The model is trained on a diverse dataset, encompassing various writing styles, languages, and document types. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed approach in accurately identifying and distinguishing writing styles across different levels of granularity.

articleTitle: Charity with Clarity: Crowd Funding Using Smart Contracts
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Crowdfunding is an online fundraising method originally designed for the public to donate money to support the work of creative people. Crowdfunding uses blockchain technology to provide smart contracts to users. This enables to deliver public services in a safe, transparent and secure way. The mission of this project is to provide an interactive model for performing arts and donations. Both campaign sponsors and donors can create and support campaigns by viewing or submitting approval requests and completing requests through the system. Donors can also see the progress of the money they donate. All transactions will be recorded on the blockchain and stored in blocks. The use of smart contracts in blockchain is very interesting. Without the help of a trusted third party, blockchain-based agreements must be negotiated, executed, and implemented between untrusted participants. It is important to create all the code that will run on the blockchain. Blockchain was first used as the basis for cryptocurrencies but has spread to many other industries in recent years. Blockchain is expected to become the most widely used technology as a green way of doing business online. The biggest problem in today's global economy is that competition is not tightly controlled and some financial reports turn out to be lies. Leveraging the Ethereum smart contract in the field of crowdfunding, this project aims to reduce these concerns, eliminate fraud and allow contracts to be executed completely mechanically by ensuring that the initiative continues within a certain period of time.

articleTitle: ForgeryDetect: AI-driven Deep Fake Identification
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The rise of deepfake videos presents substantial obstacles in guaranteeing the genuineness and reliability of visual media material. This study focuses on the crucial problem of identifying deepfake content by introducing a sophisticated method that combines ResNext CNNs along with LSTM models, utilizing transfer learning approaches. Employed a comprehensive approach by using a wide array of datasets such as FaceForensics++, Celeb-DF, and the Deepfake Detection Challenge. Utilizing transfer learning, a ResNext CNN that has been pre-trained is employed to extract complex features from video frames. This enables the subsequent training of an LSTM layer to identify temporal patterns and distinctive cues that are exclusive to modified videos. The effectiveness of fusion model has been demonstrated through extensive experimentation and validation on these rich datasets. It demonstrates a strong ability to reliably distinguish between authentic and manipulated movies, regardless of the different facial alteration techniques, environmental variables, and complex situations seen in real-life situations. The integration of ResNext-based feature extraction with LSTM-based temporal modeling shows substantial progress in the detection of deepfake videos. The efficacy of approach is highly promising, since it provides both dependability and scalability. This study makes a significant contribution to the field of deepfake identification by offering a powerful collection of techniques to tackle the growing concerns surrounding disinformation and manipulation in visual media.

articleTitle: Multimodal Conversational Bot for Multilingual Personalized Song Recommendation
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Advanced Multimodal Conversational Bot powered by the LLama 2 model, which has 13 billion parameters. The bot can provide personalized song recommendations that are flexible across languages. It uses text, and audio inputs to understand users from different linguistic backgrounds. It accurately assesses the user's mood in multiple languages through sentiment analysis and refines emotional context using image and video analysis. This allows it to offer song recommendations considering the user's mood, preferences, and realtime context, regardless of their chosen language. The bot also handles incomplete or unclear queries in multiple languages, ensuring precise and relevant song suggestions. A custom dataset tailored for music recommendations is used for finetuning, enhancing the bot's ability to provide personalized and contextually relevant song suggestions.

articleTitle: Comparing the Accuracy of Support Vector Machine and Random Forest Algorithms in Predicting Road Accidents
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The central focus of this study revolves around the application of Support Vector Machine (SVM) and Random Forest algorithms for the purpose of traffic incident detection. In contrast to the Ra[1ndom Forest approach, this study pioneers the use of SVM, a novel technique, to identify traffic incidents. The study utilized the G Power calculator to determine the required sample size, which was determined to be 10 participants per group, resulting in a total sample size of 20 individuals. A 90% confidence interval was applied to 90% of the sample data. The analysis of the collected data revealed a noteworthy disparity in accuracy between the two methods. The SVM algorithms exhibited a substantially higher accuracy rate of 92%, while the Random Forest techniques achieved an accuracy rate of 87%. These results bear considerable statistical significance, as indicated by a p-value of 0.01 (p<0.05, Independent sample T-test). In conclusion, the study's findings provide compelling evidence that Support Vector Machines outperform Random Forest algorithms in the realm of traffic accident identification.

articleTitle: A Review of the Repercussions of Mobile Phones and the Internet on Education
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Mobile phones and the Internet are the most popular modern technologies for life organization, especially in the field of education. Rapid advancements in mobile technology have made it possible for Internet-based mobile learning and its impact on education has become a studied concern. Numerous studies have been developed to discover the impacts of mobile, social media and Internet technology on education. The discoveries aided the studies in determining whether these technologies emphatically or contrarily influence the life of students regarding their academic performance. Motivated by this novel, this review paper synthesizes existing articles regarding three perspectives: benefits of technology in education; how mobile phones and the Internet have favored learning and teaching modes; the repercussions of mobile phones and the internet on education. The majority of works accentuate how these technologies unearth various dimensions of learning for students and highlight the obstacles in education. In contrast, the researchers also analyzed the awful academic situations among students created by mobile technology. But the inquiries are limited to the repercussions and impacts of these innovations and do not include any definite suggestions to mitigate the effects. This paper provides various ways for responsible and effective use of these technologies among students.

articleTitle: A Non-Invasive Approach Using Machine Learning and IoT for Health Monitoring
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The rapid progress of technology has brought about a significant transformation in numerous fields, healthcare included. One noteworthy evolution is the fusion of Machine Learning (ML) and the Internet of Things (IoT). This integration has ushered in substantial changes across various domains, with healthcare being a prime example. This paper presents a comprehensive overview of the application of ML and IoT in non- invasive health monitoring. The integration of these technologies has enabled the development of smart healthcare systems that can continuously monitor individuals' health parameters remotely, leading to early detection of abnormalities and timely interventions. This paper discusses the key components, benefits, challenges, and future prospects of smart non- invasive health monitoring using ML and IoT.

articleTitle: Design & control implementation of a bi-level stepper motor drive for a five-axis robot manipulator considering for space applications
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: The paper introduces a comprehensive design and implementation framework for a bi-level power supply stepper motor drive interface, facilitating control of a five-axis robot arm through a computer’s parallel port. Additionally, it describes the development of simulation software used to control the robot arm for PNP (pick and place) operations, specifically for the precise placement of cylindrical metal casings containing uranium pellets into slots with welded small pads. The primary focus of the paper is on designing and implementing a bi-level stepper motor drive tailored for a five-axis robot manipulator. This system integrates a sophisticated stepper motor drive architecture with dual levels of control to improve the precision and efficiency of the robot manipulator’s movements. Advanced features, such as micro-stepping and precise motion control, are incorporated into the design to optimize the performance of the stepper motors. The dual-level control strategy aims to synchronize and coordinate the movements of the five-axis robot manipulator, ensuring smooth and accurate operation. Moreover, the paper discusses the development of specialized control algorithms to further enhance the performance of the stepper motors, enabling precise positioning and movement of the robot arm. These algorithms likely include trajectory planning to ensure efficient movement between points and collision avoidance. The simulation software developed for controlling the robot arm likely includes a user-friendly interface for programming and monitoring the robot’s movements. It may also feature simulation capabilities to test the robot’s movements before implementing them in the physical environment, reducing the risk of errors and optimizing the robot’s performance. Additionally, the paper may delve into the mechanical design considerations of the robot arm, such as the materials used, the range of motion of each axis, and any safety features implemented to protect the robot and its surroundings during operation. In conclusion, the research contributes significantly to advancing the field of robotics by providing a comprehensive solution for designing and controlling a sophisticated robot manipulator. It showcases the integration of hardware and software components to achieve precise and efficient movement for PNP operations in a challenging environment, particularly customized for the nuanced requirements of a five-axis robot manipulator.

articleTitle: An Artificial Intelligence Based Deeplearning Technique for Recognition of Multiple Brain Tumors on MRI Imager
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Brain tumors were devastating ailment found on all continents. Healthy brain tissue is ravaged by tumors, which can spread to other parts of the body. Thereby, rapid tumor cell proliferation could be fatal Manual diagnosis is not able to effectively track and categorize tumor kinds. Early brain tumor detection becomes more important since it may help determine the patient’s condition and prevent harmful outcomes. Early brain tumor detection using Magnetic Resonance Images (MRI) may increase the lifespan of patients. The most widespread kinds of brain cancers were meningioma, glioblastoma, and astrocytoma. In this work, brain malignancies such as meningioma, glioblastoma, and astrocytoma are identified and categorized by employing Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) classifier in Deep Learning (DL). While DL techniques might not need any manual feature extraction while attaining appropriate classification outcomes, prior techniques that used machine learning (ML) required manual feature extraction. The Otsu multi-level thresholding method categorizes the medical images into segments for tumor identification after preprocessing the images for scaling and noise reduction. The Gray Level Co-Occurrence Matrix (GLCM) textural method of analysis is used to generate the features. For tumor type identification, a pre-trained CNN model is employed. It indicates no tumor if there is none. The tumor kind is classified otherwise. In the end, the accuracy of the demonstrated model was 98.31%. The other statistical metrics, such as SSI, PSNR, sensitivity, specificity, and MSE, were calculated and contrasted with the practices currently in application.

articleTitle: An In-depth Examination of Machine Learning Approaches in NIDS: A Comprehensive Review
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Network security is of paramount importance in the ever-evolving landscape of cyber threats. Traditional rule-based Intrusion Detection Systems (IDS) face challenges in detecting sophisticated and evolving attacks. This paper presents a comprehensive survey and analysis of employing machine learning techniques for Network Intrusion Detection Systems (NIDS). It explores the application of various machine learning algorithms, including, but not limited to decision trees, support vector machines, neural networks and ensemble methods in the context of intrusion detection. This survey encompasses the strengths and limitations of different machine learning approaches, their ability to adapt to dynamic network environments and the impact of imbalanced datasets on the performance of machine learning-based NIDS. It provides a comprehensive overview of the current state of Network Intrusion Detection Systems leveraging machine learning techniques.

articleTitle: Smart Traffic Management in Green VANETs: Ant-Inspired Routing Strategies with Local Search Optimization
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: Green Vehicular Ad-hoc Networks (VANETs) are gaining significance in smart mobility because of growing concerns about the environment. The research introduces a novel method for managing traffic in such networks by combining ant-inspired routing methods with local search optimization approaches. The solution, which draws inspiration from the efficient path-finding abilities of ants, facilitates decentralized communication and sharing of traffic data among cars. It allows rapid adaptation to changing traffic circumstances and environmental elements. Local search optimization enhances routing decisions by considering the near vicinity of each vehicle. Extensive simulations demonstrate notable enhancements in traffic efficiency, decreased congestion, and improved energy conservation as compared to conventional routing methods. The suggested solutions also enhance the development of environmentally friendly and enduring transportation networks.

articleTitle: OTFS Modulation Characterizations Over Rapid Fading Channel
publicationTitle: 2024 International Conference on Recent Innovation in Smart and Sustainable Technology (ICRISST)
abstract: In the ever-changing world of mobile wireless communication, the obstacles presented by channels that change over time, affected by multiple signal paths and frequency shifts caused by motion, require creative modulation methods.
